Bava Kamma 80a:4-83a:8: Tanu rabbanan: maase bechasid echad shehaya goneach millibbo, veshaalu larofim, veamru: en lo takkana ad sheyyinak chalav roteach mishshacharit leshacharit. veheviu lo ez vekashru lo bechare hammitta, vehaya yonek mimmenna mishshacharit leshacharit.
Leyamim nichnesu chaverav levakkero, kevan sherau otah haez keshura bechare hammitta – chazru laachorehem, veamru: listim mezuyyayn beveto shel ze, veanu nichnasin etzlo?!
Yashvu uvadku, velo matzu bo ella oto avon shel otah haez. veaf hu bishat mitato amar: yodea ani sheen bi avon ella avon otah haez, sheavarti al divre chaveray.

Amar rabbi yishmael: mibbaale vattim shebbaggalil haelyon hayu bet abba; umippene ma charvu? shehayu marin bachorashin, vedanin dine mamonot beyachid. veaf al pi shehayu lahem chorashim samuch levattehem, sade ketanna hayta umaavirin derech aleha.

Tanu rabbanan: roe sheasa teshuva – en mechayyeyvin oto limkor miyyad, ella mocher al yad al yad. vechen ger shennaflu lo kelavim vachazirim birushshato – en mechayyeyvin oto limkor miyyad, ella mocher al yad al yad.
Vechen mi shennadar likkach bayit velikkach ishsha beeretz yisrael – en mechayyeyvin oto likkach miyyad, ad sheyyimtza et hahogenet lo.

Umaase beishsha achat shehaya benah metzer lah, vekaftza venishbea: "kol mi sheyyavo, eni machzirato", vekaftzu aleha bene adam sheenan mehugganin. ucheshebba haddavar etzel chachamim, amru: lo nitkavvevna zo ella lehagun lah.

Keshem sheamru en megaddelin behema dakka, kach amru en megaddelin chayya dakka. rabbi yishmael omer: megaddelin kelavim kuferin, vachatulim, vekofin, vechuledot senaim – mippene sheasuyim lenakker et habbayit.
May chuledot senaim? amar rav yehuda: shirtza chartza. veikka deamri: charza – dekattine shakay, veraaya bene vavrdine. umay shirtza? demittattiy shakay.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: asinu atzmenu bevavel keeretz yisrael livhema dakka. amar leh rav adda bar ahava lerav huna: didach may?

Amar leh: didan ka meynattera lehu chubba. amar leh: chubba tikberinhu livna. kullehu sheneh derav adda bar ahava la ikkayyaym zara lerav huna mechubba. ikka deamri, amar rav huna amar rav: asinu atzmenu bevavel keeretz yisrael livhema dakka, mikki ata rav levavel.
Rav ushemuel verav assi ikkelau leve shevua habben, veamri la leve yeshua habben. rav la ayel kammeh dishmuel,
Shemuel la ayel kammeh derav assi, rav assi la ayel kammeh derav. amri: man nittarach? nittarach shemuel venete rav verav assi.
Venittarach rav o rav assi! rav – milleta bealma hu daavad leh lishmuel; mishshum hahu maase delatyeh, adbereh rav aleh.
Addehachi vehachi, ata shunara kateh lida deyanoka. nefak rav uderash: chatul – muttar lehorgo, veasur lekayyeymo, veen bo mishshum gazel, veen bo mishshum hashev aveda labbealim.
Vechevan deamrat "muttar lehorgo", may nihu tu "asur lekayyeymo"? mahu detema: muttar lehorgo, issura lekka; ka mashma lan.
Amri: vechevan deamrat "en bo mishshum gazel", may nihu tu "en bo mishshum hashev aveda labbealim"? amar ravina: leoro.
Metivi, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: megaddelin kelavim kuferin, vachatulin, vekofin, vechuledot senaim – mippene sheasuyin lenakker et habbayit! la kashya; ha beukkama, ha bechiuora.
Veha maase derav – ukkama hava! hatam – ukkama bar chivvara hava. veha mivay bae leh ravina!
Devae ravina: ukkama bar chivvara, mahu? ki kamibbaya leh leravina – beukkama bar chivvara bar ukkama; maase derav – beukkama bar chivvara bar chivvara hava.

(14 20 60 – Siman.) amar rabbi acha bar pappa mishshum rabbi abba bar pappa mishshum rabbi adda bar pappa, veamri la: amar rabbi abba bar pappa mishshum rabbi chiyyay bar pappa mishshum rabbi acha bar pappa, veamri la: amar rabbi abba bar pappa mishshum rabbi acha bar pappa mishshum rabbi chanina bar pappa:
Matriin al hachikkuch beshabbat, vedelet hanninelet lo bimhera tippatach, vehallokeach bayit beeretz yisrael – kotvin alav ono afillu beshabbat.
Metivi: ushear pureaniyyot hammitraggeshot uvaot al hatztzibbur – kegon chikkuch, chagav, zevuv, tzira veyattush, veshilluach nechashim veakrabbim – lo hayu matriin, ella tzoakim!

La kashya; kan belach, kan beyavesh. deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: shechin shehevi hakkadosh baruch hu al hammitzrim – lach mibbachutz veyavesh mibbifnim, shenneemar: "vayhi shechin avabuot poreach baadam uvabbehema".

"Vedelet hanninelet lo bimhera tippatach", may hi? mar zutera amar: semicha. rav ashe amar: kol hammeriin lo, lo bimhera metivin lo. rav acha middifti amar: leolam en metivin lo. vela hi, rav acha middifti milleta denafsheh hu deamar.
Vehallokeach bayit beeretz yisrael – kotvin alav ono afillu beshabbat. beshabbat salka datach?!
Ella kidamar rava hatam: omer legoy veose; hachi name, omer legoy veose. veaf al gav daamira legoy shevut hi, mishshum yishshuv eretz yisrael la gezaru beh rabbanan.
Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: hallokeach ir beeretz yisrael, kofin oto likkach lah derech mearba ruchoteha, mishshum yishshuv eretz yisrael.
Tanu rabbanan, asara tenain hitna yehoshua:

Sheyyehu marin bachorashin; umelakketin etzim bisdotehem; umelakketim asavim bechol makom – chutz mittiltan; vekotmim netiot bechol makom – chutz miggerofiyyot shel zayit; umayan hayyotze battechilla – bene hair mistappekin mimmennu; umechakkin beyammah shel teverya, uvilvad shello yifros kela veyaamid et hassefina;

Venifnin laachore haggader, vaafillu besade melea karkom; umehallechim bishvile harshut, ad shettered revia sheniyya; umistallekin letzidde hadderachim mippene yetedot hadderachim; vehattoe ben hakkeramim – mefasseg veole mefasseg veyored; umet mitzva kone mekomo.
Sheyyehu marin bachorashin. amar rav pappa: la amaran ella dakka begassa, aval dakka bedakka vegassa begassa – la. vechol shekken gassa bedakka dela.
Umelakketin etzim missedotehem. la amaran ella behizme vehige, aval bishar etzim – la. vaafillu behizme vehige – la amaran ella bimchubbarin, aval bitlushin – la.
Vaafillu bimchubbarin – la amaran ella belachin, aval biveshin – la. uvilvad shello yesharesh.
Umelakketin asavim bechol makom, chutz missede tiltan. lememra detiltan meallu la asavim? ureminhi: tiltan shealta im mine asavim – en mechayyeyvin oto laakor!
Amar rav yirmeya: la kashya; kan lezera, kan lezirin. lezera – kashu la asavim, demachchashi la; lezirin – mealle la, dechi kayymi bene asavim – mirakkeva.
Ibbaet ema: kan leadam, kan livhema. dechevan delivhema hu dezara, asavim name mibbee la. umena yadinan? amar rav pappa: sharya meshare – leadam, la sharya meshare – livhema.

Vekotmin netia bechol makom, chutz miggerofiyyot shel zayit. pershu rabbi tanchum verabbi biryays mishshum zaken echad: bezayit – kevetza. bekanim uvigfanim – min happekak ulemala. ushear kol hailanot – min ubbo shel ilan, velo min chuddo shel ilan;
Min chadash sheeno ose perot, velo min yashan shehu ose perot; mimmekom sheeno roe et hachamma,
Velo mimmekom shehu roe et hachamma; shenneemar: "umimmeged tevuot shamesh".
Umayan hayyotze techilla – bene hair mistappekin mimmennu. amar rabba bar rav huna: venoten lo damim. velet hilcheta kevoteh.

Umechakkin beyammah shel teverya, uvilvad shello yifros kela veyaamid et hassefina – aval tzad hu birshatot uvemichmarot. tanu rabbanan: barishona hitnu shevatim ze im ze shello yifros kelia veyaamid et hassefina, aval tzad hu birshatot uvemichmarot.
Tanu rabbanan: yammah shel teverya – bechelko shel naftali hayta. velo od, ella shennatal melo chevel cherem bidromah, lekayyem ma shenneemar "yam vedarom yerasha".
Tanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: telushin shebbeharim – bechezkat kol hashshevatim hen omdim, umechubbarim – bechezkat oto hashshevet.

Veen lecha kol shevet veshevet miyyisrael sheen lo bahar uvashshefela uvannegev uvaemek, shenneemar: "penu useu lachem uvou har haemori veel kol shechenav; baarava, vahar, bashshefela uvannegev uvechof hayyam vegomer. vechen atta motze bakkenaanim uvapperizzim uvaemoriyyim shellifnehem, shenneemar: "veel kol shechenav" – alma shechenav hachi havu.

Venifnin laachore haggader, vaafillu besade shehi melea karkom. amar rav acha bar yaakov: lo nitzrecha ella littol hemennu tzeror. amar rav chisda: vaafillu beshabbat. mar zutera chasida shakel umahdar, vaamar leh leshammaeh (limchar): zil shirkeh.
Umehallechin bishvile harshut, ad shettered revia sheniyya. amar rav pappa: vehay didan – afillu tal kashe le.

Umesallekin letzidde hadderachim, mippene yetedot hadderachim. shemuel verav yehuda havo shakli veazli beorcha, hava mistallak shemuel letzidde hadderachim. amar leh rav yehuda: tenain shehitna yehoshua, afillu bevavel?! amar leh: sheani omer, afillu bechutza laaretz.

Rabbi verabbi chiyyay havo shakli veazli beorcha, istallaku letzidde hadderachim. hava ka mefassay veazel rabbi yehuda ben (kenosa) [nekosa] kammayyhu, amar leh rabbi lerabbi chiyyay: mi hu ze shemmare gedulla befanenu?

Amar leh rabbi chiyyay: shemma rabbi yehuda ben (kenosa) [nekosa] talmidi hu, vechol maasav leshem shamayim. ki meto legabbeh, chazyeh. amar leh: i lav yehuda ben (kenosa) [nekosa] at, gezartinhu leshakach begizra defarzela.

Hattoe ben hakkeramim, mefasseg veyored mefasseg veole. tanu rabbanan: haroe chavero toe ben hakkeramim, mefasseg veole mefasseg veyored, ad shemmaalehu lair o ladderech. vechen hu shettoe ben hakkeramim, mefasseg veole mefasseg veyored ad sheyyaale lair o ladderech.
May "vechen"? mahu detema, chavero hu deyada lehecha mesallek – denifsog; aval hu, dela yeda lehecha ka salek – la nifsog, nahdereh (nehdar) [mihdar] be mitzre; ka mashma lan.
Ha deorayyta hu, detanya: hashavat gufo minnayin? talmud lomar: "vahashevoto"!
Deorayyta hu dekae be mitzre, ata hu takken dimfasseg veole mefasseg veyored.
Umet mitzva kana mekomo. ureminhi: hammotze met mutal beisratya, mefannehu limin isratya o lismol isratya. sede vur usede nir – mefannehu lisde vur.
Sede nir usede zera – mefannehu lisde nir. hayu shetehen burot; shetehen nirot; shetehen zeruot – mefannehu lemakom sheyyirtze!
Amar rav bivi: bemuttal al hammetzar; mittoch shennittan lefannoto, mefannehu lechol makom sheyyirtze.
Amri: asara?! hane chad sere havyayn! mehallechin bishvile harshut – shelomo amra.

Kidtanya: hare shekkalu perotav min hassade, veeno manniach bene adam likkanes betoch sadehu – ma habberiyyot omrot alav? ma hanaa yesh lifloni, uma habberiyyot mazzikot lo? alav hakkatuv omer: "mihyot tov al tikkare ra". umi ketiv: "mihyot tov al tikkare ra"? in, ketiv ki hay gavvna: "al timna tov mibbealav, bihyot leel yadcha laasot".

Vetu lekka? veha ikka derabbi yehuda – detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: bishat hotzaat zevalim, adam motzi zivlo lirshut harabbim, vetzovro kol sheloshim; kede sheyyehe nishshof beragle adam uveragle vehema. sheal menat ken hinchil yehoshua leyisrael et haaretz!

Veha ikka derabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka – detanya, rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: tenay bet din hu sheyyehe ze yored letoch sede chavero vekotzetz socho shel chavero lehatztzil nechil shello, venoten lo deme socho shel chavero;

Utenay bet din hu sheyyehe ze shofech yeno umatztzil duveshano shel chavero, venotel deme yeno mittoch duveshano shel chavero; utenay bet din hu sheyyehe ze mefarek et etzav vetoen pishtano shel chavero, venotel deme etzav mittoch pishtano shel chavero; sheal menat ken hinchil yehoshua leyisrael et haaretz!
Bichidae la kaamrinan.
Veha ki ata rabbi avin amar rabbi yochanan: echad ilan hannote letoch sede chavero, veechad ilan hassamuch lammetzer – mevi vekore, sheal menat ken hinchil yehoshua leyisrael et haaretz!

Ella man tana asara tenain shehitna yehoshua – rabbi yehoshua ben levi hu. rav geviha mibbe chetil matne la behedya: rabbi tanchum verabbi biryays amri mishshum zaken echad, umannu – rabbi yehoshua ben levi; asara tenain hitna yehoshua.

Asara takkanot tikken ezra: shekkorin bammincha bashshabbat; vekorin besheni uvachamishi; vedanin besheni uvachamishi; umechabbesim bachamishi bashshabbat; veochlin shum beerev shabbat; veshettehe ishsha mashkemet veofa; veshettehe ishsha chogeret besinar; veshettehe ishsha chofefet vetovelet; vesheyyehu rochlin machazirin baayayrot; vetikken tevila levaale kerayin.
Sheyyehu korin bammincha bashshabbat – mishshum yoshve keranot.

Vesheyyehu korin besheni uvachamishi – ezra tikken?! veha meikkara hava mittakna! detanya: "vayyelchu sheloshet yamim bammidbar velo matzu mayim" – dorshe reshumot amru: en mayim ella tora, shenneemar: "hoy kol tzame lechu lammayim".

Kevan shehalchu sheloshet yamim belo tora, nilu, amdu neviim shebbenehem vetikkenu lahem sheyyehu korin bashshabbat, umafsikin beechad bashshabbat, vekorin besheni, umafsikin shelishi urevii, vekorin bachamishi, umafsikin erev shabbat, kede shello yalinu shelosha yamim belo tora.
Meikkara tikkenu chad gavra – telata pesuke, i name telata gavre – telata pesuke, keneged kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim; ata hu, taykken telata gavre veasra pesuke, keneged asara batlanin.
Vedanin besheni uvachamishi – dishchichi, deatu lemikre besifra.
Vesheyyehu mechabbesin bachamishi bashshabbat – mishshum kevod shabbat.

Vesheyyehu ochlin shum beerev shabbat – mishshum ona; dichtiv: "asher piryo yitten beitto", veamar rabbi yehuda, veittema rav nachman, veittema rav kahana, veittema rabbi yochanan: ze hameshammesh mittato meerev shabbat leerev shabbat.
Tanu rabbanan, chamishsha devarim neemru bashshum: masbia, umashchin, umatzhil panim, umarbe hazzera, vehoreg kinnim shebbivne meayim. veyesh omrim: machnis ahava umotzi et hakkina.
Veshettehe ishsha mashkemet veofa – kede shettehe pat metzuya laaniyyim.
Veshettehe ishsha chogeret besinar – mishshum tzeniuta.
Veshettehe ishsha chofefet vetovelet – deorayyta hi!
Detanya: "verachatz et besaro bammayim" – shello yehe davar chotzetz ben besaro lammayim. "et besaro" – et hattafel livsaro, umay nihu – sear!
Amri: deorayyta – leayyone dilma mikketar, i name meavvas midde, mishshum chatzitza;
Vaata ihu taykken chafifa.
Vesheyyehu rochlin mechazzerin baayayrot – mishshum tachshite nashim, kede shello yitgannu al baalehem.
Vetikken tevila levaale kerayin – deorayyta hu! dichtiv: "veish ki tetze mimmennu shichvat zara, verachatz et besaro bammayim"! deorayyta hu litruma vekadashim; ata hu, tikken afillu ledivre tora.
Asara devarim neemru birushalayim: en habbayit chalut bah; veenah mevia egla arufa; veenah naaset ir hanniddachat;

Veenah mittammea bingaim; veen motziin bah zizin ugezuzetraot; veen osin bah ashpattot; veen osin bah kivshonot; veen osin bah gannot ufardesot – chutz miggannot vevradin shehayu mimot neviim harishonim; veen megaddelim bah tarnegolin; veen melinin bah et hammet.
En habbayit chalut bah – dichtiv: "vekam habbayit asher lo choma latztzemitut lakkone oto ledorotav", vekasavar lo nitchalleka yerushalayim lishvatim.
Veenah mevia egla arufa – dichtiv: "ki yimmatze chalal baadama asher Adonai elohecha noten lecha lerishtah", virushalayim lo nitchalleka lishvatim.
Veenah naaset ir hanniddachat – dichtiv: "arecha", virushalayim lo nitchalleka lishvatim.
Veenah mittammea bingaim – dichtiv: "venatatti nega tzaraat bevet eretz achuzzatchem", virushalayim lo nitchalleka lishvatim.
Veen motziin bah zizin ugezuzetraot – mippene ohel hattumea, umishshum dela littazku ole regalim.
Veen osin bah ashpattot – mishshum shekatzim.
Veen osin bah kivshonot – mishshum kutera.
Veen osin bah gannot ufardesin – mishshum sircha.
Veen megaddelin bah tarnegolin – mishshum kodashim.
Veen melinin bah et hammet – gemara.

En megaddelin chazirim bechol makom. tanu rabbanan: keshetztzaru bet chashmonay ze al ze, haya hurekanos mibbifnim vaaristobbelus mibbachutz. uvechol yom hayu meshalshelim lahem bekuppa dinarin, vehayu maalim lahem temidim.

Haya sham zaken echad shehaya makkir bechochmat yevonit, amar lahem: kol zeman sheoskin baavoda – en nimsarim beyedchem. lemachar shilshelu dinarin bekuppa, veheelu lahem chazir. kevan shehiggia lachatzi hachoma, naatz tzippornav bachoma, venizdazea eretz yisrael arba meot parsa al arba meot parsa.

Beotah shaa amru: arur haish sheyyegaddel chazirim, vearur haadam sheyyelammed et beno chochmat yevonit. veal otah shaa shaninu: maase shebba omer miggannot hatztzerifin, ushete hallechem mibbikat en socher.
Vechochmat yevonit mi asira?! vehatanya: amar rabbi: beeretz yisrael –
Lashon suresi lamma? o leshon hakkodesh, o lashon yevanit! veamar rabbi yose: [b]vavel – leshon arammi lamma? o leshon hakkodesh, o lashon parsi! amri: lashon yevani lechud, chochmat yevanit lechud.

Vechochmat yevanit mi asira?! vehaamar rav yehuda amar shemuel mishshum rabban shimon ben gamliel: "eni olla lenafshi mikkol benot iri" – elef yeladim hayu bevet abba; chamesh meot mehem lamdu tora, chamesh meot lamdu chochmat yevanit; velo nishtayyer mehem ella ani – kan, uven achi abba – beasya!

Amri: shane bet rabban gamliel, shehayu kerovim lammalchut. vechidtanya: hamesapper kome – hare ze middarche haemori. avtulemos bar reuven hittiru lo lesapper kome, mippene shehu karov lammalchut. shel bet rabban gamliel hittiru lahem lesapper bechochmat yevanit, mippene shekkerovim lammalchut.

Lo yegaddel adam et hakkelev ella im ken kashur beshalshelaot kulei. tanu rabbanan: lo yegaddel adam et hakkelev – ella im ken kashur beshalshelet. aval megaddel hu bair hassemucha lassefar, vekoshro bayyom umattiro ballayla.
Tanya rabbi eliezer haggadol omer: hamegaddel kelavim – kimgaddel chazirim. lemay nafka minna? lemekam aleh bearur.
Amar rav yosef bar minyome amar rav nachman: bavel – keir hassemucha lassefar dame. targema: nehardea.

Daresh rabbi dostay demin bere: "uvenucho yomar shuva Adonai rivvot alfe yisrael" – lelammedcha, sheen shechina shora al yisrael pachot mishshene alafim ushene revavot. chaser achat, vehayta ishsha meubberet benehem ureuya lehashelim, venavach bah kelev vehippila, nimtza ze gorem lashshechina shettistallek miyyisrael.
Hahi itteta deallat lemefa behahu beta, nevach ba kalba. amar la mareh: la tistefay minneh, shekili niveh. amara leh: shekila tevutaych veshadya achizre, kevar nad valad.
Berakhot 49b:17-50a:9: Af "barchu", umikkol makom "nevarech" adif, deamar rav adda bar ahava, amri be rav, tenena: shishsha nechlakin ad asara.
I amrat bishlama "nevarech" adif — mishshum hachi nechlakin, ella i amrat "barchu" adif — ammay nechlakin! ella lav shema minna "nevarech" adif. shema minna.

Tanya name hachi: ben sheamar "barchu" ben sheamar "nevarech" — en tofsin oto al kach, vehannakdanin tofsin oto al kach. umibbirchotav shel adam nikkar im talmid chacham hu im lav. ketzad? rabbi omer: "uvetuvo" — hare ze talmid chacham, "umittuvo" — hare ze bur.
Amar leh abbaye lerav dimi: vehachtiv: "umibbirchatcha yevorach (et) bet avdecha leolam"! — bishela shane. bishela name, hachtiv: "harechev picha vaamalleehu"! — hahu, bedivre tora ketiv.
Tanya, rabbi omer: "betuvo chayinu" — hare ze talmid chacham, "chayyim" — hare ze bur. neharbelae matni ippecha, velet hilchata kinharbelae.
Amar rabbi yochanan: "nevarech sheachalnu mishshello" — hare ze talmid chacham, "lemi sheachalnu mishshello" — hare ze bur.
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: veha amrinan "lemi sheasa laavotenu velanu et kol hannissim haellu". amar leh: hatam mochcha milleta, man aved nisse — kudesha berich hu.
Amar rabbi yochanan: "baruch sheachalnu mishshello" — hare ze talmid chacham, "al hammazon sheachalnu" — hare ze bur.

Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: la amaran ella bishlosha, delekka shem shamayim, aval baasara, deikka shem shamayim — mochcha milleta, keditnan: kainyan shehu mevarech, kach onin acharav: "baruch Adonai elohe yisrael elohe hatztzevaot yoshev hakkeruvim al hammazon sheachalnu".
Hosea 11:7-11: Veammi teluim limshuvati veel-al yikrauhu yachad lo yeromem
Ech ettencha efrayim amaggencha yisrael ech ettencha cheadma asimcha kitzvoyim nehpach alay libbi yachad nichmeru nichumay
Lo eese charon appi lo ashuv leshachet efrayim ki el anochi velo-ish bekirbecha kadosh velo avo beir
Achare Adonai yelchu kearye yishag ki-hu yishag veyecherdu vanim miyyam
Yecherdu chetzippor mimmitzrayim ucheyona meeretz ashshur vehoshavtim al-battehem neum-Adonai {s}

Lachen yihyu kaanan-boker vechattal mashkim holech kemotz yesoer miggoren ucheashan mearubba

Kemaritam vayyisbau savu vayyarom libbam al-ken shechechuni
Mishnah Arakhin 2:6-3:4:
En pochatin mishshenem asar leviyyim omdim al hadduchan, umosifin ad leolam. en katan nichnas laazara laavoda ella veshaa shehaleviyyim omdim bashshir. velo hayu omrim benevel vechinnor ella vappe, kede litten teval banneima. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, en olin lamminyan, veen omdim al hadduchan, ella vaaretz hayu omdin, verashehen mibben ragle haleviyyim, vetzoare haleviyyim hayu nikrain: 
Yesh baarachin lehakel ulehachamir, bisde achuzza lehakel ulehachamir, beshor hammuad shehemit et haeved lehakel ulehachamir, baones uvammefatte uvammotzi shem ra lehakel ulehachamir. yesh baarachin lehakel ulehachamir. ketzad. echad sheheerich et hannae shebbeyisrael veet hakkaur shebbeyisrael, noten chamishshim sala. veim amar hare damav alay, noten et shavyo: 
Bisde achuzza lehakel ulehachamir. ketzad. echad hammakdish becholat hammachoz veechad hammakdish befardesot sebasti, noten bezera chomer seorim chamishshim shekel kesef. uvisde mikna, noten et shavyo. rabbi eliezer omer, echad sede achuzza veechad sede mikna. ma ben sede achuzza lisde mikna. ella shebbisde achuzza noten chomesh, uvisde mikna eno noten chomesh: 
Beshor hammuad shehemit et haeved lehakel ulehachamir. ketzad. echad shehemit et hannae shebbaavadim veet hakkaur shebbaavadim, noten sheloshim sela. hemit ben chorin, noten et shavyo. chaval baze uvaze, meshallem nezek shalem: 
Baones uvamfatte lehakel ulehachamir. ketzad. echad sheanas ufitta et haggedola shebbakkehunna veet hakketanna shebbeyisrael, noten chamishshim sela. vehabboshet vehappegam, hakkol lefi hamevayyesh vehammitbayyesh:
Mishnah Arakhin 3:5-4:3:
Bammotzi shem ra lehakel ulehachamir. ketzad. echad shehotzi shem ra al haggedola shebbakkehunna veal hakketanna shebbeyisrael, noten mea sela. nimtza haomer befiv yater min haose maase. shekken matzinu, shello nechtam gezar din al avotenu vammidbar ella al lashon hara, shenneemar (Bamidbar 14), vaynassu oti ze eser peamim velo shamu bekoli: 
Hesseg yad, bannoder. vehashshanim, banniddar. vehaarachim, banneerach, vehaerech, bizman haerech. hesseg yad bannoder, ketzad. ani sheheerich et heashir, noten erech ani. veashir sheheerich et heani, noten erech ashir: 
Aval bakkarbanot eno chen. hare sheamar, karbano shel metzora ze alay. im haya metzora ani, mevi karban ani. ashir, mevi karban ashir. rabbi omer, omer ani af baarachin ken. vechi mippene ma ani sheheerich et heashir noten erech ani, sheen heashir chayyav kelum. aval heashir sheamar erki alay, veshama heani veamar, ma sheamar ze alay, noten erech ashir. haya ani veheeshir o ashir veheeni, noten erech ashir. rabbi yehuda omer, afillu ani veheeshir vechazar veheeni, noten erech ashir: 
Aval bakkarbanot eno chen, afillu aviv met vehinniach lo ribbo, sefinato vayyam uvau veribboot, en lahekdesh bahen kelum:
Mishnah Arakhin 4:4-5:3:
Shanim banniddar ketzad, yeled sheheerich et hazzaken, noten erech zaken. vezaken sheheerich et hayyeled, noten erech yeled. vaarachim banneerach ketzad, ish sheheerich et haishsha, noten erech ishsha. veishsha sheheericha et haish, notenet erech ish. vehaerech bizman haerech ketzad, heericho pachut mibben chamesh venaasa yoter al ben chamesh, pachut mibben esrim venaasa yoter al ben esrim, noten kizman haerech. yom sheloshim, kilmatta mimmennu. shenat chamesh ushenat esrim, kilmatta mimmennu, shenneemar (Vayikra 27), veim mibben shishshim shana vamala im zachar, hare anu lemedim bechullam mishshenat shishshim. ma shenat shishshim kilmatta mimmenna, af shenat chamesh ushenat esrim kilmatta mimmenna. hen. im asa shenat shishshim kilmatta mimmenna lehachamir, naase shenat chamesh ushenat esrim kilmatta mimmenna lehakel. talmud lomar, shana shana, ligzera shava. ma shana haamura vishnat shishshim, kilmatta mimmenna, af shana haamura vishnat chamesh ushenat esrim, kilmatta mimmenna, ben lehakel ben lehachamir. rabbi elazar omer, ad sheyyihyu yeterot al hashshanim chodesh veyom echad: 
Haomer, mishkali alay, noten mishkalo. im kesef, kesef. im zahav, zahav. maase beimmah shel yirmatya sheamra, mishkal bitti alay, vealta lirushalayim, ushekaluha venatna mishkalah zahav. mishkal yadi alay, rabbi yehuda omer, memalle chavit mayim umachnisah ad marpeko, veshokel besar chamor vegidin vaatzamot venoten letochah ad shettitmalle. amar rabbi yose, vechi heach efshar lechavven basar keneged basar vaatzamot keneged atzamot. ella shamin et hayyad kamma hi reuya lishkol: 
Deme yadi alay, shamin oto, kamma hu shave beyad, vechamma hu shave belo yad. ze chomer bannedarim mibbaarachin. vechomer baarachin mibbannedarim, ketzad. haomer, erki alay, vamet, yittenu hayyorshin. damay alay, vamet, lo yittenu hayyorshim, sheen damim lammetim. erech yadi veerech ragli alay, lo amar kelum. erech roshi veerech kevedi alay, noten erech kullo. ze hakkelal, davar shehanneshama teluya vo, noten erech kullo: 
Chatzi erki alay, noten chatzi erko. erech chetzyi alay, noten erech kullo. chatzi damay alay, noten chatzi damav. deme chetzyi alay, noten deme chullo. ze hakkelal, davar shehanneshama teluya vo, noten erech kullo:
Mishnah Arakhin 5:4-6:2:
Haomer, erko shel peloni alay, met hannoder vehanniddar, yittenu hayyorshin. damav shel peloni alay, met hannoder, yittenu hayyorshin. met hanniddar, lo yittenu hayyorshin, sheen damim lammetim: 
Shor ze ola, bayit ze karban, met hashshor venafal habbayit, eno chayyav leshallem. deme shor ze alay ola, o deme vayit ze alay karban, met hashshor venafal habbayit, chayyav leshallem: 
Chayyave arachim, memashkenin otan. chayyave chattaot vaashamot, en memashkenin otan. chayyave olot ushelamim, memashkenin otan af al pi sheen mitkapper lo ad sheyyitratztze, shenneemar (Vayikra 1), lirtzono, kofin oto ad sheyyomar, rotze ani. vechen atta omer begitte nashim, kofin oto ad sheyyomar, rotze ani: 
Shum hayetomim, sheloshim yom, veshum hahekdesh, shishshim yom, umachrizin babboker uvaarev. hammakdish nechasav vehayta alav ketubbat ishsha, rabbi eliezer omer, kesheyyegarshenna, yaddir hanaa. rabbi yehoshua omer, eno tzarich. kayotze vo amar rabban shimon ben gamliel, af hearev laishsha vichtubbata vehaya valah megarshah, yaddir hanaa, shemma yaase kenuneya al nechasav shel ze veyachazir et ishto: 
Hammakdish nechasav vehayta alav ketubbat ishsha uvaal chov, en haishsha yechola ligbot ketubbatah min hahekdesh, velo vaal chov et chovo, ella happode fode al menat litten laishsha ketubbatah ulevaal chov et chovo. hikdish tishim mane vehaya chovo mea mane, mosif od dinar ufode vo et hannechasim hallalu, al menat litten laishsha ketubbatah ulevaal chov et chovo:
Mishnah Arakhin 6:3-7:1:
Af al pi sheamru, chayyave arachin memashkenin otan, notnin lo mezon sheloshim yom uchesut shenem asar chodesh umitta mutztzaat vesandalin utefillin. lo, aval lo leishto velo levanav. im haya umman, notnin lo shene chele ummanut mikkol min vamin. charash, notnin lo shene maatzadin ushete megerot. rabbi eliezer omer, im haya ikkar, notnin lo et tzimdo. chammar, notnin lo et chamoro: 
Haya min echad merubbe umin echad muat, en omrim lo limkor min hamerubbe velikkach lo min hammuat, ella notnin lo shene minin min hamerubbe vechol sheyyesh lo min hammuat. hammakdish et nechasav, maalin lo et tefillav: 
Echad hammakdish et nechasav, veechad hammaarich et atzmo, en lo, lo vichsut ishto, velo vichsut banav, velo vatztzeva shetztzevaan lishman, velo vesandalim chadashim shellekachan lishman. af al pi sheamru, avadim nimkarim bichsutan leshevach, sheim tillakach lo chesut bishloshim dinar, mashbiach hu mane, vechen para, im mamtinim otah laitlis, mashbachat hi, vechen margalit, im maalin otah lakkerach, mashbachat hi, en lahekdesh ella mekomo veshato: 
En makdishin lifne hayyovel pachot mishshete shanim. velo goalin leachar hayyovel pachot mishshana. en mechashshevin chodashim lahekdesh. aval hahekdesh mechashshev chodashim. hammakdish et sadehu vishat hayyovel, noten bezera chomer seorim chamishshim shekel kasef. hayu sham nekaim amukkim asara tefachim o selaim gevohim asara tefachim, en nimdadim immah. pachot mikkan, nimdadim immah. hikdishah shetayim o shalosh shanim lifne hayyovel, noten sela ufundeyon leshana. im amar hareni noten devar shana veshana, en shomin lo, ella noten et kullo keechad:
Mishnah Arakhin 7:2-5:
Echad habbealim, veechad kol haadam. ma ben habbealim leven kol haadam, ella shehabbealim notnim chomesh, vechol adam eno noten chomesh: 
Hikdishah ugealah, enah yotza miyyado bayyovel. gealah beno, yotza leaviv bayyovel. gealah acher o echad min hakkerovim ugealah miyyado, enah yotza miyyado bayyovel. gealah echad min hakkohanim vahare hi tachat yado, lo yomar hoil vehi yotza lakkohanim bayyovel vahare hi tachat yadi, hare hi shelli, ella yotza lechol echav hakkohanim: 
Higgia hayyovel velo nigala, hakkohanim nichnasim letochah venotnim et dameha, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer, nichnasin, aval lo notnin. rabbi eliezer omer, lo nichnasin velo notnin, ella nikret sede retushim, ad hayyovel hashsheni. higgia hayyovel hashsheni velo nigala, nikret retushe retushin ad hayyovel hashshelishi. leolam en hakkohanim nichnasin letochah, ad sheyyigalenna acher: 
Hallokeach sade meaviv, met aviv veachar kach hikdishah, hare hi kisde achuzza. hikdishah veachar kach met aviv, hare hi kisde mikna, divre rabbi meir. verabbi yehuda verabbi shimon omrim, kisde achuzza, shenneemar (Vayikra 27), veim et sede miknato asher lo missede achuzzato, sade sheenah reuya lihyot sede achuzza, yotzet zo, shehi reuya lihyot sede achuzza. sede mikna enah yotza lakkohanim bayyovel, sheen adam makdish davar sheeno shello. kohanim uleviyyim makdishim leolam, vegoalin leolam, ben lifne hayyovel, ben leachar hayyovel:
Mishnah Demai 5:8-11: Hallokeach tevel mishshene mekomot, measser mizze al ze, af al pi sheamru, en adam rashshay limkor tevel ella letzorech:
Measserin mishshel yisrael al shel nachri, mishshel nachri al shel yisrael, mishshel yisrael al shel kutim, mishshel kutim al shel kutim. rabbi eliezer oser mishshel kutim al shel kutim:

Atzitz nakuv, hare ze kaaretz. taram mehaaretz al atzitz nakuv, meatzitz nakuv al haaretz, terumato teruma. mishsheeno nakuv al hannakuv, teruma, veyachazor veyitrom. min hannakuv al sheeno nakuv, teruma, velo teachel ad sheyyotzi aleha terumot umaasrot:
Taram min haddemay al haddemay, middemay al havvadday, teruma, veyachazor veyitrom. min havvadday al haddemay, teruma, velo teachel ad sheyyotzi aleha terumot umaasrot:
Mishnah Demai 6:1-4: Hamekabbel sade miyyisrael, min hannachri umin hakkuti, yechallek lifnehem. hachocher sade miyyisrael, torem venoten lo. amar rabbi yehuda, ematay, bizman shennatan lo meotah hassade umeoto hammin, aval im natan lo missade acheret o mimmin acher, measser venoten lo:
Hachocher sade min hannachri, measser venoten lo. rabbi yehuda omer, af hamekabbel sede avotav min hannachri, measser venoten lo:
Kohen velevi shekkibbelu sade miyyisrael, keshem shecholkin bachullin kach cholkin batteruma. rabbi eliezer omer, af hammaasrot shellahen, sheal menat ken bau:

Yisrael shekkibbel mikkohen umillevi, hammaasrot labbealim. rabbi yishmael omer, hakkartani shekkibbel sade mirushalmi, maaser sheni shel yerushalmi. vachachamim omrim, yachol hu hakkartani laalot uleachlo virushalayim:
Mishnah Demai 6:10-7:1: Ger vegoy sheyyarshu et avihem goy, yachol hu lomar, tol atta avoda zara vaani maot, atta yayin vaani ferot. veim mishshebbau lirshut hagger, asur:

Hammocher perot besureya, veamar mishshel eretz yisrael hen, chayyav leasser. meussarin hen, neeman, shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir. mishshelli hen, chayyav leasser, meussarin hen, neeman, shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir. veim yadua sheyyesh lo sade echad besureya, chayyav leasser:
Am haaretz sheamar lechaver, kach li aguddat yarak, kach li geluskan echad, lokeach setam ufatur. veim amar, shelli ze, veze shel chaveri, venitarvu, chayyav leasser, vaafillu hen mea:

Hammazmin et chavero sheyyochal etzlo, vehu eno maamino al hammaasrot, omer meerev shabbat, ma sheani atid lehaferish machar, hare hu maaser, ushear maaser samuch lo, ze sheasiti maaser asuy terumat maaser alav, umaaser sheni bitzfono o vidromo, umechullal al hammaot:
Mishnah Demai 6:5-9: Hamekabbel zetim leshemen, keshem shecholkin bachullin kach cholkin batteruma. rabbi yehuda omer, yisrael shekkibbel mikkohen umillevi zetim leshemen lemachatzit sachar, hammaasrot labbealim:
Bet shammay omrim, lo yimkor adam et zetav ella lechaver. bet hillel omrim, af limasser. utzenue vet hillel hayu nohagin kedivre vet shammay:
Shenayim shebbatzru et karmehem letoch gat achat, echad measser veechad sheeno measser, hameasser measser et shello, vechelko bechol makom shehu:

Shenayim shekkibbelu sade vaarisut, o sheyyarshu o shennishtattefu, yachol hu lomar, tol atta chittim shebbemakom peloni vaani chittim shebbemakom peloni, atta yayin shebbemakom peloni vaani yayin shebbemakom peloni. aval lo yomar lo, tol atta chittim vaani seorim, tol atta yayin vaani ettol shamen:

Chaver veam haaretz sheyyarshu et avihem am haaretz, yachol hu lomar lo, tol atta chittim shebbemakom peloni vaani chittim shebbemakom peloni, atta yayin shebbemakom peloni vaani yayin shebbemakom peloni. aval lo yomar lo, tol atta chittim vaani seorim, tol atta hallach vaani ettol et hayyavesh:
Mishnah Demai 7:2-5:
Mazgu lo et hakkos, omer, ma sheani atid leshayyer beshule hakkos, hare hu maaser, ushear maaser samuch lo, ze sheasiti maaser asuy terumat maaser alav, umaaser sheni befiv, umechullal al hammaot: 
Poel sheeno maamin levaal habbayit, notel gerogeret achat veomer, zo vetesha habbaot achareha, asuyot maaser al tishim sheani ochel, zo asuya terumat maaser alehen, umaaser sheni baacharona, umechullal al hammaot, vechosech gerogeret echat. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, lo yachsoch, mippene shehu memaet melachto shel baal habbayit. rabbi yose omer lo yachsoch, mippene shehu tenay bet din: 
Hallokeach yayin mibben hakkutim, omer, shene luggin sheani atid lehaferish, hare hen teruma, vaasara maaser, vetisha maaser sheni. mechel veshote: 
Hayu lo teenim shel tevel betoch beto, vehu bevet hammidrash o vassade, omer, shete teenim sheani atid lehaferish, hare hen teruma, veeser maaser rishon, vetesha maaser sheni. hayu demay, omer, ma sheani atid lehaferish lemachar, hare hu maaser, ushear maaser samuch lo, ze sheasiti maaser asuy terumat maaser alav, umaaser sheni bitzfono o vidromo, umechullal al hammaot:
Mishnah Demai 7:6-8:
Hayu lefanav shete chalkalot shel tevel, veamar, maasrot zo vazo, harishona meussaret. shel zo vazo veshel zo vazo, harishona meusseret. maasrotehen maasrot kalkala vachavertah, kara shem: 
Mea tevel mea chullin, notel mea veechad. mea tevel mea maaser, notel mea veechad. mea chullin metukkanim mea maaser, notel mea vaeser. mea tevel tishim maaser, tishim tevel ushemonim maaser, lo hifsid kelum. ze hakkelal, kol zeman shehattevel merubbe, lo hifsid kelum: 
Mi shehayu lo eser shurot shel eser eser kadde yayin, veamar, shura hachitzona achat maaser, veen yadua ezo hi, notel shete chaviyyot lochsan. chatzi shura hachitzona achat maaser, veen yadua ezo hi, notel arba chaviyyot mearba zaviyyot. shura achat maaser, veen yadua ezo hi, notel shura achat lochsan. chatzi shura achat maaser, veen yadua ezo hi, notel shete shurot lochsan. chavit achat maaser, veen yadua ezo hi, notel mikkol chavit vechavit:
Mishnah Ketubot 10:5-11:2:
Mi shehaya nasuy arba nashim umet, harishona kodemet lashsheniyya, usheniyya lashshelishit, ushelishit larviit. harishona nishbaat lashsheniyya, usheniyya lashshelishit, ushelishit larviit, veharviit nifraat shello vishvua. ben nannas omer, vechi mippene shehi acharona niskeret, af hi lo tippara ella vishvua. hayu yotzot kullan beyom echad, kol hakkodemet lachavertah afillu shaa achat, zachta. vechach hayu chotvin birushalayim shaot. hayu chullan yotzot beshaa achat veen sham ella mane, cholkot beshave: 
Mi shehaya nasuy shete nashim, umachar et sadehu, vechatva rishona lallokeach din udevarim en li immach, hashsheniyya motzia mehallokeach, verishona min hashsheniyya, vehallokeach min harishona, vechozrot chalila ad sheyyaasu feshara venehem. vechen baal chov. vechen ishsha vaalat chov: 
Almana nizzonet minnichse yetomim, maase yadeha shellahen, veen chayyavin bikvuratah. yorsheha, yorshe chetubbatah, chayyavin bikvuratah: 
Almana, ben min haerusin ben min hannissuin, mocheret shello bevet din. rabbi shimon omer, min hannissuin, mocheret shello bevet din. min haerusin, lo timkor ella bevet din, mippene sheen lah mezonot, vechol sheen lah mezonot, lo timkor ella bevet din:
Mishnah Ketubot 11:3-12:1:
Machra chetubbatah o miktzatah, mishkena chetubbatah o miktzatah, natna chetubbatah leacher o miktzatah, lo timkor et hashshear ella bevet din. vachachamim omrim, mocheret hi afillu arbaa vachamishsha feamim, umocheret limzonot shello bevet din, vechotevet, limzonot macharti. ugerusha lo timkor ella bevet din: 
Almana shehayta chetubbatah matayim umachra shave mane vematayim o shave matayim bemane, nitkabbela chetubbatah. hayta chetubbatah mane umachra shave mane vedinar bemane, michrah batel. afillu hi omeret achazir et haddinar layyorshin, michrah batel. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, leolam michrah kayyam ad shettehe sham kede shetteshayyer besade bat tisha kabbim, uveginna bat chatzi kav, uchedivre rabbi akiva bet rova. hayta chetubbatah arba meot zuz, umachra laze vemane velaze vemane velaacharon yafe mane vedinar bemane, shel acharon batel veshel kullan michran kayyam: 
Shum haddayyanin sheppichatu shetut o hosifu shetut, michran batel. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, michran kayyam. im ken ma koach bet din yafe. aval im asu iggeret bikkoret, afillu machru shave mane bematayim, o shave matayim bemane, michran kayyam: 
Hamemaenet, hashsheniyya, vehaaylonit, en lahem ketubba velo ferot, velo mezonot, velo velaot. veim mittechilla nesaah leshem aylonit, yesh lah ketubba. almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, mamzeret unetina leyisrael, bat yisrael lenatin ulemamzer, yesh lahen ketubba: 
Hannose et haishsha ufaska immo kede sheyyazun et bittah chamesh shanim, chayyav lezunah chamesh shanim. nisset leacher ufaska immo kede sheyyazun et bittah chamesh shanim, chayyav lezunah chamesh shanim. lo yomar harishon lichshettavo etzli azunah, ella molich lah mezonoteha limkom immah. vechen lo yomru shenehem hare anu zanin otah keechad, ella echad zanah veechad noten lah deme mezonot:
Mishnah Ketubot 12:2-13:1:
Nisset, habbaal noten lah mezonot vehen notnin lah deme mezonot. metu, benotehen nizzonot minnechasim bene chorin vehi nizzonet minnechasim meshubadim, mippene shehi chevaalat chov. happikchim hayu chotvim, al menat sheazun et bittech chamesh shanim kol zeman sheat immi: 
Almana sheamra i efshi lazuz mibbet bali, en hayyorshin yecholin lomar lah lechi levet avich veanu zanin otach, ella zanin otah bevet balah venotnin lah mador lefi chevodah. amra i efshi lazuz mibbet abba, yecholim hayyorshim lomar lah, im at etzlenu yesh lich mezonot, veim en at etzlenu en lich mezonot. im hayta toenet mippene shehi yalda vehen yeladim, zanin otah vehi bevet aviha: 
Kol zeman shehi vevet aviha, gova chetubbatah leolam. kol zeman shehi bevet balah, gova chetubbatah ad esrim vechamesh shanim, sheyyesh beesrim vechamesh shanim shettaase tova cheneged ketubbatah, divre rabbi meir sheamar mishshum rabban shimon ben gamliel. vachachamim omrim, kol zeman shehi bevet balah, gova chetubbatah leolam. kol zeman shehi bevet aviha, gova chetubbatah ad esrim vechamesh shanim. meta, yorsheha mazkirin ketubbatah ad esrim vechamesh shanim: 
Shene dayyane gezerot hayu virushalayim, admon vechanan ben avishalom. chanan omer shene devarim, admon omer shiva. mi shehalach limdinat hayyam veishto tovaat mezonot, chanan omer, tishshava bassof velo tishshava battechilla. nechleku alav bene chohanim gedolim veamru, tishshava battechilla uvassof. amar rabbi dosa ven harekinas kedivrehem. amar rabban yochanan ben zakkay, yafe amar chanan, lo tishshava ella vassof:
Mishnah Ketubot 13:11: Hakkol maalin leeretz yisrael, veen hakkol motziin. hakkol maalin lirushalayim, veen hakkol motziin, echad haanashim veechad hannashim (veechad avadim). nasa ishsha veeretz yisrael vegershah beeretz yisrael, noten lah mimmeot eretz yisrael. nasa ishsha veeretz yisrael vegershah bekappotkiyya, noten lah mimmeot eretz yisrael. nasa ishsha vekappotkiyya vegershah beeretz yisrael, noten lah mimmeot eretz yisrael. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, noten lah mimmeot kappotkiyya. nasa ishsha vekappotkiyya vegershah bekappotkiyya, noten lah mimmeot kappotkiyya:
Mishnah Ketubot 13:2-5:
Mi shehalach limdinat hayyam veamad echad ufirnes et ishto, chanan omer, ibbed et meotav. nechleku alav bene chohanim gedolim veamru, yishshava kamma hotzi veyittol. amar rabbi dosa ven harekinas kedivrehem. amar rabban yochanan ben zakkay, yafe amar chanan, hinniach meotav al keren hatztzevi: 
Admon omer shiva. mi shemmet vehinniach banim uvanot, bizman shehannechasim merubbin, habbanim yorshim vehabbanot nizzonot. uvinchasim muatim, habbanot yizzonu vehabbanim yechazzeru al happetachim. admon omer, bishvil sheani zachar hifsadti. amar rabban gamliel, roe ani et divre admon: 
Hattoen et chavero chadde shemen, vehoda vakkankannim, admon omer, hoil vehoda vemiktzat hattaana, yishshavea. vachachamim omrim, en zo hodaa mimmin hattaana. amar rabban gamliel, roe ani et divre admon: 
Happosek maot lachatano ufashat lo et haregel, teshev ad sheyyalbin roshah. admon omer, yechola hi shettomar, illu ani fasakti leatzmi, eshev ad sheyyalbin roshi. achshav sheabba fasak alay, ma ani yechola laasot, o chenos o fetor. amar rabban gamliel, roe ani et divre admon:
Mishnah Ketubot 13:6-10:
Haorer al hassade vehu chatum aleha veed, admon omer, yachol hu sheyyomar, hashsheni noach li veharishon kashe hemennu. vachachamim omrim, ibbed et zechuto. asaah siman leacher, ibbed et zechuto: 
Mi shehalach limdinat hayyam veavda derech sadehu, admon omer, yelech bakketzara. vachachamim omrim, yikne lo derech bemea mane, o yifrach baavir: 
Hammotzi shetar chov al chavero, vehalla hotzi shemmachar lo et hassade, admon omer, yachol hu sheyyomar, illu hayiti chayyav lecha, haya lecha lehippara et shellecha keshemmacharta li et hassade. vachachamim omrim, ze haya fikkeach shemmachar lo et hakkarka, mippene shehu yachol lemashkeno: 
Shenayim shehotziu shetar chov ze al ze, admon omer, illu hayiti chayyav lecha, ketzad atta love mimmenni. vachachamim omrim, ze gove shetar chovo veze gove shetar chovo: 
Shalosh aratzot lannissuin, yehuda, veever hayyarden, vehaggalil. en motziin meir leir umikkerach lichrach. aval beotah haaretz, motziin meir leir umikkerach lichrach, aval lo meir lichrach velo mikkerach leir. motziin minnave haraa lenave hayyafa, aval lo minnave hayyafa lenave haraa. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, af lo minnave raa lenave yafa, mippene shehannave hayyafa vodek:
Mishnah Kilayim 1:1-2:
Hachittim vehazzunin enan kilayim ze vaze. hasseorim veshibbolet shual, hakkussemin vehashshifon, happol vehassappir, happurkedan vehattofeach, ufol hallavan vehashsheuim, enam kilayim ze vaze: 
Hakkishshut vehammelaffon, enam kilayim ze vaze. rabbi yehuda omer, kilayim. chazeret vachazeret gallim, ulshin veulshe sade, kereshim uchereshe sade, kusbar vechusbar sade, chardal vechardal mitzri, udelaat hammitzri veharmutza, ufol mitzri vehecharuv, enam kilayim ze vaze:
Mishnah Nedarim 1:1-3: Kol kinnuye nedarim kindarim, vacharamim kacharamim, ushevuot kishvuot, unezirut kinzirut. haomer lachavero, muddarni mimmecha, mufrashni mimmecha, meruchakni mimmecha, sheeni ochel lach, sheeni toem lach, asur. menudde ani lach, rabbi akiva haya chochech baze lehachamir. kenidre reshaim, nadar benazir, uvekarban, uvishvua. kenidre chesherim, lo amar kelum. kenidvotam, nadar benazir uvekarban:

Haomer lachavero, konam konach, konas, hare ellu chinnuyin lekarban. cherek cherech, cheref, hare ellu chinnuyin lecherem. nazik naziach, paziach, hare ellu chinnuyin linzirut. shevuta, shekuka, nadar bemota, hare ellu chinnuyin lishvua:

Haomer lo chullin lo ochal lach, lo chasher, velo deche, tahor, vetame, notar, ufiggul, asur. keimmera, kaddirin, kaetzim, kaishshim, kammizbeach, kahechol, kirushalayim, nadar beechad mikkol meshammeshe hammizbeach, af al pi shello hizkir karban, hare ze nadar bekarban. rabbi yehuda omer, haomer yerushalayim, lo amar kelum:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 3:4-5:
Ketzad. tavshil shello bashel kol tzarko vechammin shello huchammu kol tzarkan o tavshil shebbashel kol tzarko vechol zeman shemmitztammek hu yafe lo en mashhin oto al gabbe haesh beshabbat af al pi shehunnach mibbeod yom gezera shemma yachte baggechalim kede lehashelim bishshulo o kede letzammeko. lefichach im garaf haesh o shekkissa esh hakkira beefer o binoret pishtan haddakka o sheammu haggechalim shehare hen kimchussot beefer o shehissikuha bekash o bigvava o biglale behema dakka shehare en sham gechalim boarot hare ze muttar lishhot aleha. shehare hissiach dato mizze hattavshil veen gozrin shemma yachte baesh: 
Bamme devarim amurim bechira shehevlah muat. aval hattannur af al pi sheggaraf haesh o kissa beefer o shehissikuhu bekash o vigvava en mashhin betocho velo al gabbav velo somchin lo tavshil shello bashel kol tzarko o shebbashel kol tzarko umitztammek veyafe lo. hoil vehevlo cham beyoter eno massiach dato vechoshshim shemma yachte bezo haesh hammeuta af al pi shehu esh kash ugevava o mechussa:
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 1:10-13:
Ad ematay chayyav lilmod tora ad yom moto shenneemar <small>(Devarim 4 9)</small> "ufen yasuru millevavcha kol yeme chayyecha". vechol zeman shello yaasok belimmud hu shocheach:
Vechayyav leshallesh et zeman lemidato. shelish battora shebbichtav. ushelish battora shebbeal pe. ushelish yavin veyaskil acharit davar mereshito veyotzi davar middavar vidamme davar ledavar veyavin bammiddot shehattora nidreshet bahen ad sheyyeda heach hu ikkar hammiddot veheach yotzi haasur vehammuttar vechayyotze bahen middevarim shellamad mippi hashshemua. veinyan ze hu hannikra gemara:
Ketzad. haya baal ummanut vehaya osek bimlachto shalosh shaot bayyom uvattora tesha. otan hattesha kore beshalosh mehen battora shebbichtav uveshalosh battora shebbeal pe uveshalosh acherot mitbonen bedato lehavin davar middavar. vedivre kabbala bichlal tora shebbichtav hen uferushan bichlal tora shebbeal pe. vehainyanim hannikraim pardes bichlal haggemara hen. bamme devarim amurim bitchillat talmudo shel adam aval kesheyyagdil bechachma velo yehe tzarich lo lilmod tora shebbichtav velo laasok tamid battora shebbeal pe yikra beittim mezummanim tora shebbichtav vedivre hashshemua kede shello yishkach davar middivre dine tora veyifne kol yamav laggemara bilvad lefi rochav sheyyesh belibbo veyishshuv dato:
Ishsha shellamda tora yesh lah sachar aval eno kischar haish. mippene shello nitztavvet. vechol haose davar sheeno metzuvve alav laasoto en secharo kischar hametzuvve sheasa ella pachot mimmennu. veaf al pi sheyyesh lah sachar tziuu chachamim shello yelammed adam et bitto tora. mippene sherov hannashim en datam mechuvvenet lehitlammed ella hen motziot divre tora ledivre havay lefi aniyyut datan. amru chachamim kol hamelammed et bitto tora keillu limmedah tiflut. bamme devarim amurim betora shebbeal pe aval tora shebbichtav lo yelammed otah lechattechilla veim limmedah eno kimlammedah tiflut:
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 1:5-8:
Leolam yilmod adam tora veachar kach yissa ishsha sheim nasa ishsha techilla en dato penuya lilmod. veim haya yitzro mitgabber alav ad shennimtza sheen libbo panuy yissa veachar kach yilmod tora:
Meematay aviv chayyav lelammedo tora. mishsheyyatchil ledabber melammedo <small>(Devarim log 4)</small> "tora tzivva lanu mshe" u<small>(Devarim 6 4)</small> "shema yisrael", veachar kach melammedo meat meat pesukim pesukim ad sheyyihye ben shesh o ben sheva hakkol lefi buryo. umolicho etzel melammed hattinokot:
Haya minhag hammedina likkach melammed hattinokot sachar noten lo secharo. vechayyav lelammedo besachar ad sheyyikra tora shebbichtav kullah. makom shennahagu lelammed tora shebbichtav besachar muttar lelammed besachar. aval tora shebbeal pe asur lelammedah besachar shenneemar <small>(Devarim 4 5)</small> "ree limmadti etchem chukkim umishpatim kaasher tzivvani Adonai" vegomer ma ani bechinnam lamadti af attem lemadtem bechinnam mimmenni vechen keshettelammedu ledorot lammedu bechinnam kemo shellemadtem mimmenni. lo matza mi sheyyelammedo bechinnam yelammedo besachar shenneemar emet kene. yachol yelammed laacherim besachar. talmud lomar <small>(Mishlei 23 23)</small> "veal timkor". ha lamadta sheasur lo lelammed besachar af al pi shellimmedo rabbo besachar:
Kol ish miyyisrael chayyav betalmud tora ben ani ben ashir ben shalem begufo ben baal yissurin ben bachur ben shehaya zaken gadol shettashash kocho afillu haya ani hammitparnes min hatztzedaka umechazzer al happetachim vaafillu baal ishsha uvanim chayyav likboa lo zeman letalmud tora bayyom uvallayla shenneemar <small>(yehoshua 1 8)</small> "vehagita bo yomam valayla":
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 3:1-3: Bishlosha ketarim nichteru yisrael. keter tora vecheter kehunna vecheter malchut. keter kehunna zacha bo aharon shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 25 13)</small> "vehayta lo ulezaro acharav berit kehunnat olam". keter malchut zacha bo david shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 89 37)</small> "zaro leolam yihye vechiso chashshemesh negdi". keter tora hare munnach veomed umuchan lechol yisrael. shenneemar <small>(Devarim log 4)</small> "tora tzivva lanu moshe morasha kehillat yaakov". kol mi sheyyirtze yavo veyittol. shemma tomar sheotam hakketarim gedolim mikketer tora. hare hu omer <small>(Mishlei 8 15)</small> "bi melachim yimlochu veroznim yechokku tzedek" <small>(Mishlei 8 16)</small> "bi sarim yasoru". ha lamadta shekketer tora gadol mishshenehem:
Amru chachamim mamzer talmid chacham kodem lechohen gadol am haaretz shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 3 15)</small> "yekara hi mippeninim". mikkohen gadol shennichnas lifnay velifnim:
En lecha mitzva bechol hammitzvot kullan shehi shekula keneged talmud tora ella talmud tora keneged kol hammitzvot kullan shehattalmud mevi lide maase. lefichach hattalmud kodem lemaase bechol makom:
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 3:11-13: Maala gedola hi lemi shehu mitparnes mimmaase yadav. umiddat chasidim harishonim hi. uvaze zoche lechol kavod vetova shebbaolam hazze velaolam habba shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 128 b)</small> "yegia kappecha ki tochel ashrecha vetov lach" <small>(mishna avot 6 4)</small> "ashrecha baolam hazze vetov lach laolam habba" shekkullo tov:

En divre tora mitkayyemin bemi shemmarpe atzmo alehen. velo beellu shellomdin mittoch iddun umittoch achila ushetiyya. ella bemi shemmemit atzmo alehen umetzaer gufo tamid velo yitten shena leenav uleafappav tenuma. amru chachamim derech remez <small>(Bamidbar 19 14)</small> "zot hattora adam ki yamut beohel" en hattora mitkayyemet ella bemi shemmemit atzmo beohole hachachamim. vechen amar shelomo bechachmato <small>(Mishlei kad 10)</small> "hitrappita beyom tzara tzar kochecha". veod amar <small>(Kohelet b 9)</small> "af chachmati amda li" chachma shellamadti beaf hi amda li. amru chachamim berit keruta shekkol hayyagea betorato bevet hammidrash lo bimhera hu meshakkeach. vechol hayyagea betalmudo betzina machkim shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 11 b)</small> "veet tzenuim chachma". vechol hammashmia kolo bishat talmudo talmudo mitkayyem beyado. aval hakkore belachash bimhera hu shocheach:

Af al pi shemmitzva lilmod bayyom uvallayla en adam lamed rov chachmato ella ballayla. lefichach mi sheratza lizkot becheter hattora yizzaher bechol lelotav velo yeabbed afillu echad mehen beshena vaachila ushetiyya vesicha vechayyotze bahen ella betalmud tora vedivre chachma. amru chachamim en rinna shel tora ella ballayla shenneemar <small>(Eicha b 19)</small> "kumi ronni vallayla". vechol haosek battora ballayla chut shel chesed nimshach alav bayyom shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 42 9)</small> "yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo uvallayla shiro immi tefilla leel chayyay". vechol bayit sheen nishmaim bo divre tora ballayla esh ochalto shenneemar <small>(iyyov 20 26)</small> "kol choshech tamun litzpunav teachlehu esh lo nuppach". <small>(Bamidbar 15 lo)</small> "ki devar Adonai baza" ze shello hishgiach al divre tora kol ikkar. vechen kol sheefshar lo laasok battora veeno osek o shekkara veshana uferash lehavele olam veheniach talmudo uzenacho hare ze bichlal boze devar Adonai. amru chachamim kol hamevattel et hattora meosher sofo levattelah meoni vechol hamekayyem et hattora meoni sofo lekayyemah meosher. veinyan ze meforash hu battora, hare hu omer <small>(Devarim 28 47)</small> "tachat asher lo avadta et Adonai elohecha besimcha uvetuv levav merov kl" <small>(Devarim 28 moach)</small> "veavadta et oyvecha". veomer <small>(Devarim 8 b)</small> "lemaan annotcha" <small>(Devarim 8 16)</small> "lehetivcha beacharitecha":
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 3:4: Haya lefanav asiyyat mitzva vetalmud tora. im efshar lammitzva leheasot al yede acherim lo yafsik talmudo. veim lav yaase hammitzva veyachazor letalmudo:
Niddah 13b:13-14: Gemara chereshet — ihi tivdok lenafsha! detanya, amar rabbi: chereshet hayta bishchunatenu, lo dayya shebbodeket leatzmah, ella shechavroteha root umarot lah!
Hatam — bimdabberet veenah shomaat, hacha — besheenah medabberet veenah shomaat, keditnan: cheresh sheddibberu chachamim bechol makom — eno shomea veeno medabber.
Proverbs 6:17-22: Enayim ramot leshon shaker veyadayim shofchot dam-naki
Lev choresh machshevot aven raglayim memaharot larutz laraa
Yafiach kezavim ed shaker umeshalleach medanim ben achim {p}
Netzor beni mitzvat avicha veal-tittosh torat immecha
Behithallechcha ׀ tanche otach beshochbecha tishmor alecha vahakitzota hi tesichecha
Proverbs 6:23-26: Ki ner mitzva vetora or vederech chayyim tochchot musar
Lishmorcha meeshet ra mechelkat lashon nochriyya
Ki vead-ishsha zona ad-kikkarlachem veeshet ish nefesh yekara tatzud {p}
Proverbs 6:27-31: Hayachte ish esh becheko uvegadav lo tissarafna
Im-yehallech ish al-haggechalim veraglav lo tikkavena
Ken habba el-eshet reehu lo yinnake kol-hannogea bah
Lo-yavuzu laggannav ki yignov lemalle nafsho ki yirav
Venimtza yeshallem shivatayim et-kol-hon beto yitten
Proverbs 6:32-7:2: Noef ishsha chasar-lev mashchit nafsho hu yaasenna
Lo-yissa pene chol-kofer velo-yove ki tarbe-shochad {p}
Beni shemor amaray umitzvotay titzpon ittach
Shemor mitzvotay vechye vetorati keishon enecha
Proverbs 7:3-7: Emor lachochma achoti at umoda labbina tikra
Lishmorcha meishsha zara minnochriyya amareha hechelika
Ki bechallon beti bead eshnabbi nishkafti
Vaere vappetayim avina vabbanim naar chasar-lev
Shabbat 69b:4-7: Amar rav huna: haya mehallech badderech o bammidbar veeno yodea ematay shabbat, mone shishsha yamim umeshammer yom echad. chiyyay bar rav omer: meshammer yom echad, umone shishsha. bemay kamippalgi — mar savar kivriyyayto shel olam, umar savar keadam harishon. metivi: haya mehallech badderech veeno yodea ematay shabbat meshammer yom echad leshishsha. may lav, mone shishsha umeshammer yom echad?! la, meshammer yom echad umone shishsha.

I hachi "meshammer yom echad leshishsha" — "meshammer yom echad umone shishsha" mibbee leh. veod, tanya: haya mehallech badderech o bammidbar veeno yodea ematay shabbat, mone shishsha umeshammer yom echad, teyuveta derabbi chiyyay bar rav! teyuveta.

Amar rava: bechol yom vayom ose lo kede farnasato [bar mehahu yoma]. vehahu yoma lemut?! deaved meetmol shete farnasot. vedilma meetmol shabbat havay! ella kol yom vayom ose lo parnasato, afillu hahu yoma. vehahu yoma bemay minnechar leh? bekiddusha veavdalta.

Amar rava: im haya makkir miktzat hayyom sheyyatza bo, ose melacha kol hayyom kullo. peshita! mahu detema: kevan deshabbat la nafek, bemaale shabbeta [name] la nafek. vehay, i name bechamsha beshabbeta nafek — lishtere leh lemebad melacha tere yome — ka mashma lan zimnin demashkach sheyyayrta umikkere venafek.
Yevamot 63b:13-64a:2: Katuv besefer ben sira: "ishsha tova mattana tova levalah", uchetiv: "tova bechek yere elohim tinnaten". "ishsha raa tzaraat levalah", may takkanteh — "yegarshenna veyitrappe mitztzarato". "ishsha yafe ashre balah, mispar yamav kiflayim".

"Haelem enecha meeshet chen pen tillached bimtzudatah. al tet etzel balah limsoch immo yayin veshechar, ki betoar ishsha yafa rabbim hushechatu, vaatzumim kol harugeha". "rabbim hayu pitze rochel". "hammargilim lidvar erva kenitzotz mavir gachelet. kichluv male of — ken battehem meleim mirma".

"Al tetzar tzarat machar, ki lo teda ma yeled yom. shemma machar ba veenennu, nimtza mitztaer al haolam sheen shello". "mena rabbim mittoch betecha, velo hakkol tavi betecha". "rabbim yihyu dorshe shelomecha. galle sod leechad mealef".

Amar rabbi assi: en ben david ba ad sheyyichlu kol hanneshamot shebbagguf, shenneemar: "ki ruach millefanay yaatof uneshamot ani asiti". tanya, rabbi eliezer omer: kol mi sheen osek bifriyya ureviyya — keillu shofech damim, shenneemar: "shofech dam haadam baadam damo yishshafech", uchetiv batreh: "veattem peru urevu".

Rabbi yaakov omer: keillu memaet haddemut, shenneemar: "ki betzelem elohim asa et haadam", uchetiv batreh: "veattem peru vegomer". ben azzay omer: keillu shofech damim umemaet haddemut, shenneemar: "veattem peru urevu".

Amru lo leven azzay: yesh nae doresh venae mekayyem, nae mekayyem veen nae doresh, veatta nae doresh, veen nae mekayyem. amar lahen ben azzay: uma eese shennafshi chashka battora, efshar laolam sheyyitkayyem al yede acherim.

Tanya iddach, rabbi eliezer omer: kol mi sheen osek bifriyya ureviyya — keillu shofech damim, shenneemar: "shofech dam haadam", usemich leh: "veattem peru vegomer". rabbi elazar ben azarya omer: keillu memaet haddemut. ben azzay omer vechulei. amru lo leven azzay: yesh nae doresh vechulei.
Tanu rabbanan: "uvenucho yomar shuva Adonai rivvot alfe yisrael" —

Melammed sheen hashshechina shora al pachot mishshene alafim ushene revavot miyyisrael. hare shehayu yisrael shene alafim ushene revavot chaser echad, veze lo asak bifriyya ureviyya — lo nimtza ze gorem lashshechina shettistallek miyyisrael?!

Abba chanan amar mishshum rabbi eliezer: chayyayv mita, shenneemar: "uvanim lo hayu lahem", ha hayu lahem banim — lo metu. acherim omrim: gorem lashshechina shettistallek miyyisrael, shenneemar: "lihyot lecha lelohim ulezaracha acharecha", bizman shezzaracha acharecha — shechina shora, en "zaracha acharecha" — al mi shora? al haetzim veal haavanim?!
Zevachim 61b:8-62a:7: Tenan hatam: ucheshealu bene haggola – hosifu alav arba ammot min haddarom vearba ammot min hammaarav, kemin gamma. may tama? amar rav yosef: mishshum dela safak.

Amar leh abbaye: hasheta mikdash rishon, dichtiv beh: "yehuda veyisrael rabbim kachol asher al sefat hayyam" – sefek; mikdash sheni, dichtiv beh: "kol hakkahal keechad arba ribbo" – lo safek?! amar leh: hatam esh shel shamayim mesayyaytan, hacha en esh shel shamayim mesayyaytan.
Ki ata ravin, amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi mishshum bar kappara: shitin hosifu. meikkara sevur: "mizbach adama" – shehu atum baadama.
Ulevassof sevur: shetiyya kaachila, umay "mizbach adama" – shehu mechubbar baadama; shello yivnennu lo al gabbe kippim
Amar rav yosef, lav hayeynu detanya: "vayyachinu et hammizbeach al mechonato" – shehiggiu lesof middotav? vehachtiv: "hakkol bichtav miyyad Adonai alay hiskil"!
Ella amar rav yosef: kera ashkach uderash – "vayyomer david: ze hu bet Adonai haelohim, veze mizbeach leola leyisrael" – ki bayit; ma bayit shishshim amma, af mizbeach shishshim amma.
Bishlama bayit – minnachra tzurato; ella mizbeach – mena yadi?

Amar rabbi elazar: rau mizbeach banuy, umichael hassar haggadol omed umakriv alav. verabbi yitzchak nappacha amar: efro shel yitzchak rau, shemmunnach beoto makom. verabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: mikkol habbayit kullo herichu reach ketoret, mishsham herichu reach evarim.

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: shelosha neviim alu immahem min haggola – echad sheheid lahem al hammizbeach, veechad sheheid lahem al mekom hammizbeach, veechad sheheid lahem shemmakrivin af al pi sheen bayit.

Bematnita tana, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: shelosha neviim alu immahen min haggola – echad sheheid lahem al hammizbeach veal mekom hammizbeach, veechad sheheid lahem shemmakrivin af al pi sheen bayit, veechad sheheid lahem al hattora – shettikkatev ashshurit.
Zohar, Miketz 6: Vayyar yaakov ki yesh shever bemitzrayim vayyomer yaakov levanav vegomer. ribbi chiyyay patach veamar, (zecharya 12:1) massa devar Adonai al yisrael neum Adonai note shamayim veyosed aretz veyotzer ruach adam bekirbo. hay kera it leistakkala beh. massa devar Adonai, bechol hanne atar dekaamar massa, massa ammay. ella, bechol atar deihu al dina dishar ammin veamar massa, letav. bechol atar deihu al yisrael veamar massa, levish.

Bechol atar deihu al dina dishar amin, letav. begin demassa matula ihu. kivyachol matula ihu aleh dekudesha berich hu, shalom deammin ovde kochavim umazzalot. vechad itgezar dina alayyhu maavar minneh hahu matula deihu savil alayyhu. bechol atar dedina itgezar alayyhu deyisrael, veamar massa, kivyachol matula ihu aleh dekudesha berich hu. ubbegin kach massa mehay gisa, umehay gisa, matula ihu.

Kevan deamar note shamayim veyosed aretz, ammay itzterich veyotzer ruach adam bekirbo. vechi la havena yade deihu yotzer ruach adam. ella leachazaa darga yedia, dechol ruchin venishmatin dealma, behahu darga kayymin.

Ribbi shimon amar, hay kera kashya, i amar veyotzer ruach adam vela yattir yaot, aval bekirbo mahu. ella raza ihu bitren sitrin, deha mehahu nahar denagid venafik, mittamman nafke ufarche nishmatin kullehu, veitkenishu beatar chad. vehahu darga ihu yotzer ruach adam bekirbo. vehay keitteta deitabbera min dechura, vehahu velada tzarat lah bimaha. ad deitztayyer kolla betziyyura shelimu bimaha. kach veyotzer ruach adam bekirbo, bekirbo kayyma. ad deitbere bar nash bealma veyahiv leh.

Davar acher, veyotzer ruach adam bekirbo, bekirbo deadam mammash. begin dechad itbere var nash, vekudesha berich hu yahav leh nishmateh, venafik laavira dealma. hahu rucha divgavveh, la ashkach gufa leitpashsheta begavveh, vekayyma besitra chad begavveh.

Vechad bar nash itpashat gufeh, hahu rucha itpashshat, veyahiv beh chela, vechen kegavvna degufa itrabbe, hachi rucha yahiv chela beh, leittakkefa bar nash bahadeh. uvegin kach yotzer ruach adam bekirbo mammash.
Vei tema yotzer ruach adam mahu, begin dehahu rucha, itzterich chela dilela yattir leistayya bahadeh. veal da kudesha berich hu ihu yotzer ruach adam bekirbo, veyahiv leh siyyua bevar nash.

Ta chaze, kad hahu rucha itzterich siyyua, kegavvna deihu hahu bar nash, uchegavvna dehahu gufa ittakkan, hachi name hahu rucha metaknin leh, veosfin leh rucha leittakkena. veda hu yotzer ruach adam bekirbo.

Veta chaze, kevan deitavid yosef meavoy, yaakov avid hahu tosefet rucha dehava leh, veistallekat minneh shechinta. levatar ma ketiv, (Bereshit 45:27) vattechi ruach yaakov avihem. vechi ad hasheta mit hava. ella hahu tosefet rucha istallak minneh shechinta, vela hava begavveh. begin deitzvona dehava beh garma leh, (vei garma leh ha) (sefer acher dela) la hava rucheh bekiyyumeh. uvegin kach vattechi ruach yaakov avihem.
Vehacha (ketiv vayyar yaakov), dead kean la itbassar, mena hava yada. ella vayyar yaakov, dechama lechol dayyre ara deazle lemitzrayim, umayytan ibbura (hada hu dichtiv vayyar yaakov).
Ribbi yitzchak amar, ta chaze, david malka zacha leitchabbera baavahan, veyarit ducheteh begavvavyyhu. hada hu dichtiv, even maasu habbonim hayta lerosh pinna.

(Nidpas vaere lo 1) ribbi yesa veribbi chizkiyya havu azle mikkappotkiyya lelod, vehava immehon chad yuday bematul dekaftira dechamra, ad dehavu azle, amar ribbi yesa leribbi chizkiyya, aftach pumach veema chad milla meinun mile maalyayta deorayyta, deat amer bechol yoma kamme butzina kaddisha.

Patach veamar, (Mishlei 3:17) deracheha darche noam vechol netivoteha shalom. deracheha darche noam, illen archin deorayyta. deman deazil bearche deorayyta, kudesha berich hu ashre aleh neimuta dishchinta, di la taade minneh lealmin. vechol netivoteha shalom, dechullehu netivin deorayyta kullehu shelam, shelam leh leela, shelam leh letatta. shelam leh bealma den, shelam leh bealma deate.

Amar hahu yuday, isira (asetarea) bekistera behay kera ishtakkach, amru leh, minayin lach. amar lon, meabba shemana, veolifna hacha behay kera milla (tava). patach veamar, hay kera bitren gevavnin ihu, uvitren sitrin. kare beh derachim, vekare beh netivot. kare beh noam, vekare beh shalom. man derachim, uman netivot. man noam, uman shalom.

Ella deracheha darche noam. hayeynu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 43:16) hannoten bayyam darech, deha bechol atar deikre beorayyta derech, hu orach peticha lecholla. kehay archa, deihu petiach lechol bar nash. kach deracheha darche noam, ilen derachim deinun petichan meavahan, decharan beyamma rabba, vealin begavveh, umeinun orchin mitpattechin lechol evar ulechol sitre alma.

Vehay noam, hu neimu denafak mealma deate. umealma deate naharin kol butzinin, umitparshan lechol evar. vehahu tivu vehahu nehora dealma deate, deyankin (nusach acher deyartin) avahan, ikre noam. davar acher, alma deate ikre noam, vechad itar alma deate, kol chedu vechol tivu vechol nehorin vechol cheru dealma itar, uvegini kach ikre noam.

Veal da taninan, chayyayvin degehinnom, beshata deal shabbatta, nayychin kullehu, veit lehu cherut venayycha. beshata denafik shabbatta, it lan leitara chedu illaa alana, denishteziv mehahu onasha dechayyayvaya deitdanu (sefer acher daahaderav) mehahi shata ulehala. veit lan leitara velema, (Tehillim 90:17) vihi noam Adonai elokenu alenu. da hu noam illaa, chedu (sefer acher cheru) decholla, veal da deracheha darche noam.

Vechol netivoteha shalom, man netivoteha. illen inun shevilin denafkin milleela, vechullehu nakit lon berit yechiday, deihu ikre shalom, shelama deveta. veail lon leyama rabba, kad ihu betukefeh, ucheden yahiv leh shelama. hada hu dichtiv vechol netivoteha shalom (ad kan). ta chaze, yosef berit shalom hava, vehava bemitzrayim malka, veshallit al ara. veyaakov begin deistallak minneh shechinta, la hava yada.

Veim kol da, yaakov hava leh tavra, begin lemizban ibbura bemitzrayim. vechama deihu tevira al tevira, deyechatun benoy lemitzrayim. vayyomer yaakov levanav lamma titrau, begin dela tachamun gufayychu, ella kirevin, keguverin delet lon sava.
Amar ribbi chizkiyya, vadday raza hacha. deha bechol zimna detzaara ihu bealma, la bae bar nash, leachazaa garmeh beshuka, begin dela yittafes bechovoy. veal da amar lamma titrau, veha ittemar.

Davar acher vayyar yaakov ki yesh shever bemitzrayim, ibbur mammash. deha kudesha berich hu al da shaddar kafna bealma, begin lenachata leyaakov uvenoy letamman, veal da chama bene ara, dehavu mayytin mittamman ibbur.

Vayyar yaakov ki yesh shever bemitzrayim, beshata demit yitzchak, atu yaakov veesav lemiflag. veesav nafak mechulakeh deara umikkolla, veyaakov deyisbol galuta yittol kolla. veal da chama hahu tevira dehava leh bemitzrayim, hu uvenoy lemisbal galuta. veal da vayyomer yaakov levanav lamma titrau. mikkame dina dilela, dela yishtakkach alayychu mekatrega. vayyomer hinne shamati ki yesh shever bemitzrayim redu shamma. ha ukemuha 210, chusheban da havu yisrael bemitzrayim:
Zohar, Vayetzei 12: (Bereshit 28:20) vayyiddar yaakov neder lemor im yihye elohim immadi vegomer, amar ribbi yehuda kevan dechol hay avtach leh kudesha berich hu, ammay la heemin, deamar (Bereshit 28:20) im yihye elohim immadi vegomer. ella, amar yaakov, chelma chalamna, vechelmin minnayyhu keshot uminnayyhu la keshot, veim yitkayyem ha yedana dechelma keshot hu, veal da amar im yihye elohim vegomer, kema dechalamna, vehaya Adonai li lelohim, ana ehe mashich birchan mimmabbua denachala decholla, leatar da deikre elohim.

Ta chaze yisrael deihu beemtzaita, kolla natil hu bekadmita mimmekora decholla, ulevatar deyimte leh, minneh, nagid veamshich lehay atar, mashma dichtiv, vehaya Adonai li bekadmita, ulevatar kolla lelohim. kema deelohim, yehe natir veavid li, kol illen tavan, uf ana ehe mashich leh meatar dili kol inun birchan, veyitchabbar kishra decholla beh. ematay, (Bereshit 28:21) veshavti beshalom el bet avi, kad ehe yativ bedarga dili, veehe yativ bedarga deshalom letakkena bet avi, veshavti veshalom dayyka, keden vehaya Adonai li lelohim.

Davar acher veshavti veshalom el bet avi, detamman hu ara kaddisha, tamman ishtelim. vehaya Adonai li lelohim. beatar da, asallek (istallak) middarga da ledarga ochora kedka yeut, vetamman eflach pulechaneh.

Ribbi chiyyay patach veamar, (Tehillim 65:4) divre avonot gavru menni peshaenu atta techapperem. ha kera kashya, delav sofeh resheh, velav resheh sofeh. ella david baa al garmeh, ulevatar baya al kolla. divre avonot gavru menni. amar david, ana yadana begarmay dechavna, aval kamma chayyayvin inun bealma, deitgabberu chovayyhu alayyhu yattir minni. hoil vechen, li ulehon, peshaenu atta techapperem.

Ta chaze, beshata dechayyayvin saggiin bealma, inun salkin, ad hahu atar desifre dechayyayvaya itpattechu, kema deat amer, (Daniel 7:10) dina yativ vesifrin petichu, vehahu sefer (dina ala kayyeyma), (nusach acher leella meresheh dedavid ihu) begine kach, divre avonot gavru menni, veal da peshaenu atta techapperem.

Yaakov, kegavvna da begin kach la hemin, i tema dela hemin bekudesha berich hu, la. ella, dela hemin beh begarmeh, dilma yechuv, vehahu chova, yimna leh, dela yetuv bishlam veyistallak netiru minneh, uvegin kach, la hemin begarmeh. vehaya Adonai li lelohim, afillu rachame, kad ituv bishlam, ashavve lekovli ledina, begin (sefer acher deha) deana palach kammeh tadir.

Amar ribbi acha, amar yaakov, hasheta la itzterichna ledina, kad ituv levet abba, itkelilna bedina veetkashshar beh. amar ribbi yose, lav hachi, ella amar, hasheta im yihye elohim immadi, dina itzterichna lenatra li, ad deituv bishlam levet abba, aval kevan deituv bishlam, itkelilna rachame bedina, veetkashshar bekishshura mehemna, leachlala kolla kechad. (Bereshit 28:22) vehaeven hazzot asher samti matztzeva yihye bet elohim. deha keden yehe kolla kishshura chada, vehay even itbarcha mimina umismala, itbarcha meela umittatta, begin (da) deetten maasra mikkolla.

Amar ribbi abba, ha ketiv, (Bereshit 28:11) vayyikkach meavni hammakom. vei tema deavna da, illaa (al) kamma (147 amud bet) avnin leatar motaveh, lemishre alayyhu, (nusach acher hay dichtiv) veha ketiv vehaeven hazzot asher samti matztzeva, (nusach acher elyona mibbae leh). begin (nusach acher kevan) deamar (Bereshit 28:22) en ze ki im bet elohim, hacha arim lah kamma illaa, begin detala kol shevacha deze bah, deen ze lekayyayma (letatta) ki im bet elohim. veshappir. veal da asher samti matztzeva ketiv.

Yihye bet elohim lealmin, bet elohim, bet Adonai mibbae leh, kema deat amer, (ezra 1) lechonen et bet Adonai. vechen (Tehillim 122:1) bet Adonai nelech. ella, atar deve dina ihu mitteren sitrin illain, missitra deyovla, deihu elohim chayyim. umissitra deyitzchak elohim.

Amar ribbi elazar, yovla, af al gav dedinin (nafkin) mitarin minah, vechullehu rachame (vedinin), kol chedu minah nafkin, vehu chedvavta (sefer acher vehu chayravetaa) decholla. ella bet elohim, sitra dedina kashya, i letav, besitra (deyovla) dismala, itar beh rechimuta, kema deat amer, (Shir hashshirim 2:6) semolo tachat leroshi. i levish, besitra dismala, itar beh dina kashya, kema deat amer, (Yirmeyahu 1:14) mitztzafon tippatach haraa al kol yoshve haaretz, vadday bet elohim. ribbi shimon amar, bet elohim hayeynu dichtiv, (Tehillim 48:3) kiryat melech rav. it melech setam, veit melech rav, vadday alma illaa, melech rav ihu, veda hu (sham) kiryat melech rav.
Zohar, Vayetzei 15: Davar acher (Bereshit 28:10) vayyetze yaakov mibbeer shava vayyelech charana, ribbi abba patach veamar, (Tehillim 106:3) ashre shomre mishpat (sham) ose tzedaka bechol et. ashre shomre mishpat, zakkain inun yisrael, dekudesha berich hu yahav lon orayyta dikshot leishtaddala vah yemama velele. deha kol man deishtaddal beorayyta, it leh cheru mikkolla, cheru min mota dela yachla leshalletaa aleh, veha ukemuha. begin dechol man deishtaddal beorayyta veitachid bah, itachid beilana dechayye. vei arpe garmeh meilana dechayye, ha ilana demota sharya aloy, veitachid beh. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 24:10) hitrappita beyom tzara tzar kochecha. hitrappita, i arpe yedoy meorayyta.

Beyom tzara tzar kochecha, may tzar kochecha. tzar koach ko, deha ihi tadir limina. unetiru dilah tadir al bar nash kad azil beorchoy deorayyta, ucheden dache leh lara levar dela yikrav legabbeh debar nash, vela yachil lekatrega leh. vechad bar nash aste mearchoy deorayyta veitrappe minnah, keden tzar koach ko, begin dehahu ra, deihu semala shallit aleh devar nash, vedache leh lehay ko levar, ad dedachik leh atar beaku.

Davar acher tzar kochecha, dechad bar nash achid bearche deorayyta, itrachim leela veitrachim letatta, urechima dekudesha berich hu havi, kema deat amer, (Shmuel b 12:24) vaAdonai ahavo, dehava rechimoy dekudesha berich hu, verachim leh. vechad bar nash aste mearche deorayyta, keden tzar koach ko, tzar dileh, umare devavu ihu legabbeh, veshallit aloy hahu deikre ra. ad dimkatreg beh behay alma, uvealma deate.

Ta chaze, hay ra deihu yetzer hara, shallit al alma bechamma sitrin. vechamma shaltanu it leh bealma, veihu chivya takkifa dechav beh adam, vechashlin beh bene alma, umashche leh alayyhu, ad deappik lon nishmatayyhu.

Veta chaze, kad ihu shallit, shallit al gufa. (338 lecha 172 amud bet) vechevan deal gufa shallit, nishmata nafka minneh, begin degufa istaav, venishmata salka. vela shallit aleh ad denatil reshu. vechamma inun deatyayn missitreh, veshaltin al alma. veha taninan dechol ovadin dealma deitavidu, veshalte behu, veit leh memannan veshammashin, kullehu shammashin beovadin dealma.

Veal da ihu ketz dismala, veha (62 amud bet) ukemuha, deit ketz limina, veit ketz lismala, vehay ketz dismala, ihu ketz kol basar. ketz kol basar ikre, ketz kol rucha la ikre, veraza demilla, da ihu ketz (kol basar) veda ihu ketz, da ketz al (62 amud bet) bisra veda al rucha. begin kach, da penimi veda chitzon. da yemina, veda semala. da kaddisha, veda mesaava. veha ukemuha.

Veta chaze, raza illaa kaddisha dimhemnuta, raza dealma didchura vealma denukeva, vechol kiddusha dekaddishin beh, vechol raze dimhemnuta mehacha nafku. vechol chayyin vechol cheru vechol tavin vechol nehorin mehacha inun, vechol birchan vetalle nidvan vechol rechimu dirchimuta kolla missitra da, raza dedarom.

Missitra detzafon mitpashte dargin, ad demata letatta kastufa dedahava, besitra mesaava, lichlucha dimsaav, veachid lehay leela veachid lehay letatta, vehacha mizdavvge dechar venukeva kechada, veinun rochev nachash, raza didchar venukeva, veraza da azazel.

Umehacha mitparshin dargin, venafkin kamma sitrin lealma, demitpashtin mehacha, veshaltin al alma, vechullehu sitre mesaava, veravrevin memannan go alma. ta chaze, esav kad nafak lealma, kuleh sumeka kevarda, besaara kegavvna desair, umittamman allufin memannan teresin (sefer acher teresar) deshaltin bealma, veha ukemuha.

Ta chaze, (Tehillim 106:3) ashre shomre mishpat, denatre mehemnuta dekudesha berich hu, begin dekudesha berich hu, ihu mishpat. uvae leh levar nash lenatra dela yiste leorcha ochora, ella dihe natir mishpat, begin dekudesha berich hu ihu mishpat, dechol archoy mishpat.

(Tehillim 106:3) ose tzedaka bechol et, vechi bechol et yachil bar nash lemebad tzedaka. ella, man deyishtaddal beorchoy deorayyta, veavid tzedaka im inun deitzterichu lah, dechol man deavid tzedaka im miskena, asge hahi tzedaka leela vetatta.

Ta chaze, man deishtaddal bitzdaka, hahi tzedaka deavid, salik leela, umata leela lehahu atra deyaakov, deihu reticha illaa. veamshich birchan lehahu atar, mimmabbua dechol mabbuin. umehahi tzedaka, amshich vearbe birchan lechol inun tattae, ulechol retichin ulechol chelin, vechullehu itbarchan veittosfan nehorin, kedka yeut. begin dechullehu ikru et, veda hu dichtiv, ose tzedaka bechol et.
Ta chaze, bezimna dehavu yisrael beara kaddisha, inun havu mashche birchan milleela letatta, vechad nafku yisrael meara kaddisha, alu techot reshu ochora, uvirchan itmenau mealma.

Ta chaze, yaakov hava techot reshu kaddisha, kevan denafak meara, al birshu ochora, vead la al techot reshu ochora, itgeli aleh kudesha berich hu bechelma, vechama kol ma dechama, veazlu immeh malachin kaddishin, ad deyativ al bera. vechevan deyativ al bera, seliku maya legabbeh, vechen hava moshe, demittamman izdammenat leh itteteh. raza demilla, bera la salka, ella kad chama kishra dileh leitchabbera bahadeh.

Veamar ribbi abba, kol hane kerae kashyayn ahadade, bekadmita ketiv, (Bereshit 28:10) vayyetze yaakov mibbeer shava vayyelech charana, velavan becharan hava yativ, ammay natil mittamman, dichtiv (Bereshit 29:1) vayyissa yaakov raglav vayyelech artza bene kedem. uminnalan divcharan hava diyyureh delavan, dichtiv, (Bereshit 29:4-Adonai) vayyomer lahem yaakov achay meayin attem vayyomru mecharan anachnu. vayyomer hayedatem et lavan ben nachor vayyomru yadanu. mashma dediyyureh delavan, becharan hava.

Ella, yaakov amar, ana baina lemeal bishchinta, begin divina leizdavvevga. abba kad itnasiv veshadar leavda, ashkach ena demaya, ucheden izdammenat leh leabba itteta. veha beatar da, la ashkachna la ena vela bera vela mayya, umiyyad vayyissa yaakov raglav vayyelech artza beni kedem, vetamman izdammenat leh bera, kidkaamaran, veizdammenat leh itteteh.
Ribbi elazar amar, charan tamman hava vadday, vehay bera bechakla hava. dei lav hachi, ammay ketiv, (Bereshit 29:12) vattaratz vattagged leaviha, ella begin dehava samich lemata.

Veamar ribbi elazar, yaakov deizdammenat leh al bera itteta, ammay la izdammenat leh lea, deha kayyma leh leyaakov kol inun shivtin. ella lea, la vaa kudesha berich hu lezavvga leh leyaakov beitgalleya, dichtiv, (Bereshit 29:25) vayhi vabboker vehinne hi lea, (mikkelal) deha kodem lachen la itgalleya milla.

Vetu, begin leamshacha ena velibba deyaakov beshappiru derachel, lemebad diyyureh tamman, uveginah izdavvevgat leh lea, veokimat kol inun shivtin. bamme yada yaakov man hi rachel. ella deinun rayayn amru leh, dichtiv, (Bereshit 29:6) vehinne rachel bitto baa im hatztzon.
Zohar, Vayetzei 23: (Bereshit 30:14) vayyelech reuven bime ketzir chittim vayyimtza dudaim bassade. ribbi yitzchak patach veamar, (Tehillim 104:24) ma rabbu maasecha Adonai kullam bechachma asita mala haaretz kinyanecha. hay kera ukemuha, bechamma atar. ella, man yachil lemimne ovadoy dekudesha berich hu. deha kamma chelin umashshiryayn, meshanyayn da min da, delet lon chushebna. vechullehu bezimna chada, kemarzefa deappik zikin lechol sitrin bezimna chada. kach kudesha berich hu, appik kamma zinin umashshiryayn meshanyayn da min da, delet lon chushebna vechullehu bezimna chada.

Ta chaze, bedibbura uverucha kechada, itavid alma, dichtiv (Tehillim 33:6) bidvar Adonai shamayim naasu uveruach piv kol tzevaam. bidvar Adonai, da dibbura. uveruach piv, da rucha. da vela da la azil, veitkelil da beda, venafik minayyhu kamma chelin lechelin, umashshiryayn lemashshiryayn, vecholla bezimna chada.

Ta chaze kad baa kudesha berich hu lemivre almin, appik chad nehora setimaa. demin hahu nehora, nafkin venaharin kol inun nehorin deitgalleyayn. umehahu nehora, nafkin veitpashshetu veitavidu shear nehorin veihu alma illaa.

Tu, itpashshat hay nehora illaa, veavid umana, nehora dela nahir, veavid alma tattaa. uvegin deihu nehora dela nahir, bae leitkashshera leela, bae leitkashshera letatta, uvekishshura diltatta, itkashshar leitnehara bekishshura dilela.
Vehay nehora dela nahir, bekishshura dilela, appik kol chelin umashshiryayn lezinin saggiin, hada hu dichtiv ma rabbu maasecha Adonai kullam bechachma asita vegomer.

Vechol ma di veara, hachi name leela. velet lach milla zeera behay alma, dela talyay bemilla ochora illaa deitpakkeda aleh leela, begin dechad itar hay letatta, itar hahu deitpakkeda aleh leela, decholla itachad da beda.
