Ta chaze ketiv, (Bereshit 30:14) teni na li middudae benech. lav dudaim olidu lah lerachel, ella kudesha berich hu ka gilgel milla al yede deinun dudaim. begin deyippuk yissashchar, deachid beorayyta yattir mikkullehu shivtin. begin deha rachel achida beh beyaakov, la shavkat leh legabbe lea. hada hu dichtiv (Bereshit 30:15) hameat kachtech et ishi, uchetiv lachen yishkav immach hallayla tachat dudae benich.

Inun garmu deyippuk yissashchar lealma, begin desalik recha deorayyta, kamme kudesha berich hu, hada hu dichtiv (Shir hashshirim 7:14) haddudaim natnu reach vegomer. uchetiv, (Bereshit 30:16) vayyishkav immah ballayla hu. hu (124 amud bet) vadday, veha ukemuha, dealma illaa. hu, desatim vela galya, begin deha orayyta mealma (86 amud bet) illaa nafkat.

Uvechol atar, alma illaa. hu, dela itgalleya, veha ittemar, (Bamidbar 18:23) veavad hallevi hu, begin leamshacha minneh birchan lecholla, veyissashochar beh itachid, veal da karinan etz hachayyim, ilana deinun chayyin illain, deikre hu velo atta.

Vei tema deillen dudaim patchu meaha derachel. lav, deha ketiv, (Bereshit 30:22) vayyishma eleha elohim vayyiftach et rachamah, kudesha berich hu, vela milla ochora. begin deinun dudaim, af al gav dechela dilhon leela. behahu chela dilhon, la itmanne pekida divnin, deha benin bemazzala talyayn, velav bemilla ochora.
Vei tema deha inun lemaggana itberiu, lav, deha afillu lemilla da, siyyua inun leinun demitakkeve, velav inun akaran, vela itgezar alayyhu ella bemazzala.

Sitre tora vayyelecha reuven bime ketztzir chitim vayyimtztza dudaim basade vegomer. tenan, kos shel beracha la ittebarcha, ella vistar yemina. uvegin kacha, beod deittear yemina legabbe kos shel beracha, semala la tesayyea tamman. deha yemina ashkach illa behahu kos, leitteara legabbe alma illaa.
Vesittera da, vayyelecha reuven, da sitra dedarom. begin kacha digleh baddarom, deihu resha litteresar techumin, vetiuveteh distar darom, leashkacha illa vetikrova lematronitta levarcha lah.

Ma ketiv, vayyimtztza dudaim basade, azal lechappesa bechol inun genizin dilah, veashkach behay sade inun dudaim, vealayyhu ittemar (Shir hashshirim 7:14) haddudaim nattenu reach, veinun teren (152 amud alef) keruvim, deinun tikkunin dilah, leitteara ittearu leela, deha bechol inun tikkunin dehay sade, lett tikkuna deyittear legabbe ela, bar keruvim.

Setar darom emattay ittear legabbah, leashkacha illa levarcha lah. bime ketztzir chitim, bezimna dippeligatt chulak shelala leuchelusaha, vechullehu chatztzede chakla. miyyad vayyave ottam el lea immo, salik recha, veittearu dilhon legave alma illaa, alma deittekasseya, begin deittear (nusach acher deyittear) birchan lealma tattaa.

Vechad ittebarcha, inun dudaim naktin veyahavin lechol almin, dichtiv, (Shir hashshirim 7:14) haddudaim nattenu reach veal petachenu kol megadim. kad inun nattenu reach, hahu recha nakit leh setar darom leitteara legabbe alma illaa, miyyad al petachenu kol megadim, vechol tuva la chasir (sefer acher mikkolla) mealma.

Alma tattaa la ittear legabbe alma illaa, ella kad inun dudaim yahavin recha limina, kevan deinun yahavin recha limina, vimina ittear legabbe alma illaa, miyyad alma tattaa ittear leshaala ma deitztzetricha. ma ketiv, (Bereshit 30:14) vattomer rachel el lea teni na li middudae benicha, hav li birchan mehahu ittearu, deinun dudaim deittear legabbe setar yemina.

Keden alma illaa bechedva, beshiashu, attiv legabbah, veamratt hameat kachtecha ett ishi, keimma legabbe beratta. vi hachi baala dealma illaa yaakov ihu. lav hachi, ella tiuveta deabba tadir, lav ihu, ella legabbe beratta dena, (deihi) dehay batt, rechimu dileh legabbah tadir, begin deihi batt yechidaa ben shitt benin, ulechol inun shitt benin, palig lon chulakin unevazbezan umattenan, velah la palig, velett lah yerutta kelum, veal kol da, ihu ashgach bah betiuveta urechimu yattir mikkolla.

Birchimu dileh kara lah batt, la sappik leh da, vekara lah achott, la sappik leh da, kara lah em beshum immeh, la sappik leh da, kara lah bishmeh, dichtiv, (iyyov 28:12) vehachachma meayin timmatztze, chachma vday. veal da, alma illaa amratt legabbah, hameat kachtecha ett ishi, dechol rechimu dileh ittemshacha lacha legabbacha veal da. beshaashuo urechimu imma legabbe beratta.

Ma attivatt ihi, (Bereshit 30:15) lachen yishkav immacha hallayla. bechol attar, lachen, shevua ihi. yishkav, mahu yishkav. ella shechiva bechol attar tikkuna denukeva legabbe dechura, leoola vah tziyyura deattevavn kullehu, veda ihu yishkav, yish kav. ysh da ihu alma illaa, (sefer acher 22 raza) raza deorayyta nekuda temira, deittear legabbah 22 attevavn, veda hu yishkav, 310 alma deatte, dichtiv, (Mishlei 8:21) lehanechil ohavay yesh. 22 nekuda illaa deail kol 22 attevvn. raza dechol orayyta.
Veda hu yishkav, yishkav immacha yaakov la ketiv, ella yishkav immacha. hahu temira deittechaze leitteara legabbacha, vecholla beittearu deinun (dechullehu) dudaim, vcholla ketiv birchimu.

(Bereshit 30:16) vayyavo yaakov min hasade baerev. vayyavo yaakov, da tippeerett kaddisha, mehahu sade denakit kol birchan, dichtiv beh (Bereshit 27:27) asher beracho Adonai. baerev, ammay baerev, ela baerev, dichtiv, (Bereshit 24:63) vayyetztze yitztzechak lasuach basade lippenott erev. bezimna deittear yitztzechak avoy legabbe hay sade, venakit leh, deha yitztzechak la ittear legabbe hay sade, kevan deistallak yaakov mittamman baerev, shavik hay sade leyitztzechak avoy, veihu salik behahu zimna legabbe ela.

Ma ketiv, (Bereshit 30:16) vattetztze lea likratto. imma illaa legabbe bera yechida. vattomer elay tavo, techott gadpay levarcha lacha, uleravava lacha betappenukin veiddunin illain. ha idan raava veinnuga lemehav lacha nayycha derucha illaa, legabbe hahu sade, ad la yittokkad betukepa deyitztzechak.

Kevan denakta leyaakov techott gadpaa, keden (sham) vayyishkav immah ballayla hu. hu. desattim mikkolla. hu. dechol birchan vechol kiddushin nappeke mittamman. yaakov la ketiv ella hu. man deittechaze leitteara legabbah.

Vead dela zammin legabbah techott gadpaha, man denakit inun kaddishan (kedushan) uvirchan la ittemle minnekuda temira, hahu alma illaa. veal da dudaim mitteare kolla, vecholla kegavvna deraza illaa. reuven may reuven, kudesha bericha hu shavvi shemahan beara, dichtiv (Tehillim 46:9) lechu chazu mippealott Adonai asher sam shammott baartz. (ad kan sitre tora).

(Bereshit 30:16) vattetze lea likrato vattomer elay tavo vegomer. hay milla chatzifuta ihu. lav ihu hachi, ela mehacha olifna, invevtanuta delea, dela amra kamme achatah middi, veihi akdimat leorcha, veamra leh bachashay, veoda leh. deha virshuta derachel hava, dichtiv, (sham) ki sachor secharticha, merachel netilat reshu, uvegin dela yavish beenaa derachel, amra leh levar vela beveta.

Vela od ella pitcha mishkena delea (levar), nafkat levar, veayylat leh leyaakov befitcha dilvar, ad la yeul lemishkena derachel. may tama, begin dela tema milla kamme derachel, vela tachtzif kamme achataha. vela od, ella amra lea, i yeul yaakov bemishkena derachel, lav din hu leafkeh mittamman, begin kach akdimat leh levar.

Vechol hay lamma, ella lea rucha dekudesha itarat bah, veyadat dechol hanne shivtin illain, kullehu kaddishin, yifkun minnah, vedachkat shata, bachavivuta lekudesha berich hu, uvegin kach hi karat lon shemahan, beraza dechachmeta.

Rabbi chiyyay verabbi yose, havu azle beorcha, amar ribbi yose lerabbi chiyyay, bechol zimna (deanan) deazlinan beorcha, velaenan beorayyta, kudesha berich hu marchish lan nissin, vehasheta orcha da arich lan, nitassak beorayyta, vekudesha berich hu yizdavvevg bahadan.

Patach ribbi chiyyay veamar, (Shemot 12:18) barishon bearbaa asar yom lachodesh baerev tochlu matztzot, uchetiv, (dabeham 16) shivat yamim tochal alav matztzot lechem oni, lechem ani ketiv, hay milla itaru bah chavrayay. aval ta chaze, kad havu yisrael bemitzrayim, havu birshuta ochora. kad baa kudesha berich hu lekarva lon legabbeh, yahav lon atar delechem oni. lechem ani, man ani. da david malka, dichtiv beh (tehillim 46) ki ani veevyon ani.

Vehay lechem oni ikre matztza, nukeva bela dechura, miskenuta have, itkerivu legabbe matztza bekadmita, kevan dekarivu lon yattir, ayyil lon kudesha berich hu bedargin ochoranin, veitchabbar dechura benukeva. ucheden, matztza kad itchabberat bidchura ikre mitzva betosefet vav, hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 30:11) ki hammitzva hazzot. begini kach, matztza bekadmita, ulevatar mitzva.

Ad dehavu azle, shemau chad kala deamar, tufesra dekatnnun, akiman beorcha, setu leela, la techotun bekusetra dekitra diltatta. amar ribbi yose, shema minah, dekudesha berich hu bae lenatra orchin. seliku leela, vealu bechad tura, ben tinnarin takkifin, amru, hoil vekudesha berich hu baa beorcha da, milla nechome o nissa (tarchesh) itrechish lan.

Azle, yatve gabbe bekie detinnara. salik lon chad bar nash, tevavhu, amar ribbi yose man ant. amar meanshe arka ana, amar leh, vetamman it bene nasha, amar in, vezarin vechatzdin, minnayyhu bechezu ochora meshanyayn minnay, vesalikna gabbayychu, leminda minnayychu, ma shemeh deara deattun bah.

Amar leh, eretz, begin dehacha eretz hachayyim sharya, dichtiv, (iyyov 28:5) eretz mimmenna yetze lachem, mehay yetze lechem, bishar ara la yetze lachem, vei nafik, lav mishshivat hamminin. addehachi al leatreh. tevavhu, amru vday kudesha berich hu bae leitara lan bemilla.

Amar ribbi chiyyay, vadday al hay kera deamarta, dachirna deolifna missavay, chad milla illaa. befesach, deyahav lon kudesha berich hu leyisrael lechem da, meara dechayye, ulevatar lechem min hashshamayim, lechem da, veha okimna milla.

Tu hava amar, devar nash, kad nafik lehay alma, la yada middi, ad deatim nahama. kevan deachil nahama, itar leminda uleishtemoda. kach kad nafku yisrael mimmitzrayim, la havu yade midde, ad deatim lon kudesha berich hu lechem mehay eretz, dichtiv eretz mimmenna yetze lachem, ucheden alu yisrael, leminda uleishtemoda leh lekudesha berich hu. vinuka la yada, vela ishtemoda, ad detaim nahama dehay alma.

Yisrael la yadu, vela ishtemodu bemillin dilela, ad deachlu lechem illaa, ucheden yadu veishtemodu behahu atar uvaa kudesha berich hu deyindeun yisrael yattir, behahu atar deitchaze lehay eretz. vela yachilu, ad detaamu lechem, mehahu atar, uman ihu, shamayim. dichtiv, (Shemot 16:4) hinni mamtir lachem lechem min hashshamayim, ucheden yadu veistakkalu behahu atar, vead deachlu lechem mehahu atar, (sefer acher vead dela achlu lechem meillen atre) la yadu middi vela ishtemodu.

Ata rabbi yose uneshakeh. amar, vadday al da itar lon kudesha berich hu behay, veal da sheruta deyisrael leminda, lechem hava. kamu veazlu, ad dehavu azlu, chamu tere darmusekin, chad dechar vechad nukeva. amar ribbi yose, let lan milla bealma, dela have dechar venukeva, vechol ma di veara, hachi name beyamma.

Patach ribbi yose veamar, (Bereshit 30:16) vayyavo yaakov min hassade baerev vattetze lea likrato vegomer, vattetze lea likrato, mena yadat. ha amru degaa chamara, velea yadat, venafkat leh, vegarim leh denafak minnah yissashchar. hada hu dichtiv yissashchar chamor garm, al tikre garm, ella garam dechamara garma leh. amrat lea, vadday yadana dei yeul yaakov bemishkena derachel, let li leafaka leh, ella orich leh hacha, veyeul bemishkani.
(Bereshit 30:16) ki sachor secharticha bedudae beni, may bedudae beni, begin denicha leh leyaakov al da, deillen mesayyin leolada. veyaakov hava yada, demilla la kayyma baddudaim, ella leela.

Patach veamar, (Tehillim 113:9) moshivi akeret habbayit em habbanim semecha halleluya. amar ribbi chiyyay rucha dekudesha kaamar, moshivi (154 amud alef) akeret habbayit, da rachel. em habbanim semecha, da lea. moshivi akeret habbayit, da alma tattaa. em habbanim semecha (haleluyah), da alma illaa, begine (154 amud alef) kach halleluya.

Amar ribbi yehuda, kol illen shivtin, tikkunin diltatta inun, vechullehu kegavvna dilela. ta chaze, ki sachor secharticha, lenasva minneh gufa uman ihu tora. sachor secharticha, lecha, legufach mammash. sachor secharticha, leolada deyukenach.

Mehacha, man delae beorayyta, achsin alma deate veachsin achsanta deyaakov. achsin alma deate, dichtiv yissashchar yesh sachar, (Yirmeyahu 31:16) ki yesh sachar lifullatech. uchetiv, (Mishlei 8:21) lehanechil ohavay yesh veotzrotehem amalle.

(Bereshit 30:20) ki yaladti lo shishsha vanim. amar ribbi chizkiyya, illen ela vetatta vearba sitrin dealma. uman dearich beechad, bae leh leamlacha lekudesha berich hu leela vetatta, ulearba sitre dealma, vehayeynu echad.

Amar ribbi chizkiyya, ketiv, (Shir hashshirim b) al hare vater, uchetiv, (Shir hashshirim 8) al hare vesamim, man inun hare vesamim. illen shit benin delea, deachlalan shit ochoranin, veinun teresar, veinun shit. begin (241 amud alef) dechol chad kalil bechavreh, velea alayyhu, lekayyma (Tehillim 113:9) em habbanim semecha halleluya.

Veal da ketiv, (Devarim 22:6) lo tikkach haem al habbanim, begin deihu alma deitkasseya, vela itgalleya, veal da (sham) shallach teshallach et haem veet habbanim tikkach lach. begin deihu alma deitkasseya, vela itgalleya kelal.

Veet habbanim tikkach lach, hayeynu dichtiv, (Devarim 4:32) ki sheal na leyamim rishonim vegomer (sham) ulemiktze hashshamayim vead ketze hashshamayim. vechol hanne, ikrun hare vesamim, mikkan uletatta ikrun hare vater, (29 amud bet) dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:10) umishsham yippared, vehaya learbaa rashim, ture defiruda.

Amar ribbi yesa, bene hashshefachot keshiru kishrin, (154 amud alef) arba kishrin deitzterichu letikkuna. veamar ribbi elazar, divgin kach nafke levar inun kishrin, veaf al gav dechullehu chad, umikkan ulehala kullehu chad, beorach meshar. veal da, kullehu shivtin salkin besahaduta dilela, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 122:4) sheshsham alu shevatim shivte yah edut leyisrael lehodot leshem Adonai.
Zohar, Vayetzei 38: (Bereshit 30:38) vayyatztzeg et hammaklot asher pitztzel barhatim vegomer. patach rabbi elazar veamar, (Mishlei 9:12) im chachamta chachamta lach velatzta levaddecha tisa. im chachamta chachamta lach, ta chaze, vavy leinun chayyayve alma, dela yadin vela mashgichin bemille deorayyta. vechad inun mashgichin bah, begin delet lon suchletanu, millin deorayyta damyayn beenayyhu keillu kullehu male rekanya, velet behu toalta. vecholla begin deinun rekanin middata vesuchletanu. deha kol mile deorayyta, kullehu millin illain veyakkirin. vechol milla umilla ketiv bah (Mishlei 3:15) yekara hi mippeninim vechol chafatzim lo yishvu vah (beorayyta).

Vechol inun tippeshin, atimin delibba, kad chaman mille deorayyta, la day lon dela yade, ella deinun amre, deinhu millin pegimin, mille delet behu toalta. vavy lon, kad yitba lon kudesha berich hu, elbona deorayyta, veyitanneshun onasha demarde bemarehon.

Ma ketiv beorayyta, (Devarim 32) ki lo davar rek hu mikkem, vei ihu rek mikkem ihu, deha orayyta kolla, malyay mikkol avanin tavin umargelan yakkirin, mikkol tavin dealma. kema deat amer vechol chafatzim lo yishvu vah, vehech yemrun deihi rekanya.

Ushelomo malka amar, im chachamta chachamta lach, dechad yitchakkam bar nash beorayyta, toalta dileh ihu. deha beorayyta la yachil leosafa afillu at achat. velatzta levaddecha tissa, deha orayyta, la yiggara mishshivchaha kelum, veletzanuta, dileh ihu, veishtaar beh leovada leh mehay alma umealma deate.

Ta chaze, kad atvavn illain, mitchabberan kullehu behay darga, sofa dechol dargin kaddishin illain, veitmalleya minnayyhu, veitbarcha mealma illaa. keden, hay darga kayyma leashkaa lechullehu adarin, kol chad vechad kedka chaze leh, vechol chad vechad itshake min dina verachame.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv, vayyatztzeg et hammaklot asher fitztzel barhatim vegomer, deyaakov baa leatkana tefilla shel arvit, uleanhara lesihara, uleashkaa ulevarcha lah mikkol sitrin, dichtiv vayyatztzeg et hammaklot. illen dinin ugevuran denafke miggevura dilela.

Veyaakov kad baa leatkana lehay darga, salik lechol inun dinin ugevuran minah, veokim lon barhatim, beinun rehatim arba, dekayyme techot hay (Bamidbar 21:18) beer chafaruha sarim, deitmalyay meinun nachalin umabbuin illain. begin dechad nafkin mayin mehay beer kaddisha, illen arba natle kolla. veal da ikrun rehatim, umittamman atyayn kolla lemishte. veinun dinin ugevuran, kullehu kayyme tamman, lenatla lechol chad vechad kedka chaze leh.

Asher tavona hatztzon lishtot lenochach hatztzon, illen lokovel illen. vayyechamna, may vayyechamna. dechad mitatteran bedina, mitchammemin behahu dina, veazlin veshatin bealma, umeayyne bearchehon divne nasha, hen letav hen levish.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv batreh, (Bereshit 30:39) vayyechomu hatztzon el hammaklot, begin deinun maklot havu mitchammeman, umashgichin bedini alma, veitpakkedan aleh, veitdanu beni nasha alayyhu, kema deat amer (Daniel 4:14) bigzerat irin pitgama umemar kaddishin sheelta vegomer.

Ribbi chiyyay patach veamar, (Tehillim 63:9) davka nafshi acharecha bi tamcha yeminecha, hay kera it leistakkala beh, davka nafshi acharecha, begin dedavid malka, hava mitdebak nafsheh tadir, avatreh dekudesha berich hu. vela chayish lemillin ochoranin dealma, ella leitdabbeka nafsheh ureuteh beh, vechevan deihu hava mitdebak bekudesha berich hu, (kudesha berich hu) hava tamich beh vela shavkeh. mikkan, levar nash kad ata leitdabbeka bekudesha berich hu, kudesha berich hu achid beh, vela shavik leh.

Davar acher davka nafshi acharecha, leitattera dargeh leela, deha kad itdabbak hahu darga (sefer acher dileh itbarcha vechad itgalyay) bedargin illain lesalka batrayyhu, keden yemina achid beh lesalka leh, ulechabbera leh, bechibbura chad kedka yeut, kema deat amer, (Tehillim 139:10) vetochazeni yeminecha, uchetiv (Shir hashshirim 2:6) vimino techabbekeni, veal da bi tamcha yeminecha.

Vechad achid beh bekudesha berich hu, keden ketiv, (sham) semolo tachat leroshi vimino techabbekeni. veihu yichuda chad vechibbura chad, vechad ihu chibbura chad, keden itmalleya hahu darga dileh veitbarcha.

Vechad itmalyayn kol inun rehatin, itmalyayn learba sitrin dealma, vechullehu adarayay ishtakkeyayn, kol chad vechad lesitreh. vechad ata yaakov leatkana hay darga, barir leh sitra dimina, deitchaze leh, vesitra ochora dela itchaze leh itparshat mineh. kema dichtiv, (Bereshit 30:40-41) vayyashet lo adarim levaddo velo shatam al tzon lavan. levaddo, hava bilchodoy, dela yishtammesh betaavavn ochoranin divsitrin ochoranin. zakkaa chulakhon deyisrael, dealayyhu ketiv, (Devarim 14:2) ki am kadosh atta laAdonai elohecha uvecha bachar Adonai vegomer.
Veta chaze, yaakov ihu tushebcha deavahan, veihu kelala dechullehu, uvegin deihu kelala decholla, begin kach ihu kaim leanhara lesihara, deyaakov ihu kaim leatkana litfillat arvit.

Vechol hahu tikkuna, ihu kedka chaze leh, (keden) kol inun sitrin kaddishin kullehu betikkuna atkin besitroy, veafrish chulakeh, mechulaka dishar amin. illen sitrin illain kaddishin bikdushsha illaa. veillen sitrin mesaavin, bimsaavan dimsaavuta.

Veha okimna, dichtiv vayyashet lo adarim levaddo. vayyashet lo, deatkin (leh) tikkunin limhemnuta. levaddo, kema deat amer, (sham) uvecha vachar Adonai lihyot lo leam segulla mikkol haammim. velo shatam al tzon lavan, dela shavve chulakeh veadveh immehon.

Veal da yaakov shelimu deavahan, atkin raza dimhemnuta, veafrish chulakeh veadveh, mechulaka veadva dishar ammin. veal da ketiv, (dabeham 4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom.

Ribbi abba amar, zakkaa chulakhon deyisrael, deinun illain al ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, begin dedarga dilhon leela, vedargin deammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot letatta, illen besitra dikdusha, veillen besitra dimsaava, illen limina, veillen lismala.

Kevan deitcharav be makdesha, ma ketiv, (aykaheb) heshiv achor yemino mippene oyev, uvegin kach ketiv, (Tehillim 60:7) hoshia yemincha vaaneni. usemala itgabbar umesaava ittakkaf, ad deyivni kudesha berich hu be makdesha, veyatkin alma al tikkunoy, vihadderun milleh kedka yeut veyitavar sitra mesaava min alma. veha ittemar, dichtiv (zecharya 3) veet ruach hattuma aavir min haaretz vegomer, uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 25:8) billa hammavet lanetzach vegomer.

Veyishtaar kudesha berich hu bilchodoy, kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 2:11) vehaelilim kalil yachalof, uchetiv, (sham) venisgav Adonai levaddo bayyom hahu. hu bilchodoy, kema dichtiv, (Devarim lak) veen immo el nechar, begin deyishtetze chela mesaava mealoma, vela yishtaar leela vetatta. ella kudesha berich hu bilchodoy, veyisrael lefulechaneh, am kaddish, veyitkere kaddish, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 4:3) vehaya hannishar betziyyon vehannotar birushalam kadosh yeamer lo kol hakkatuv lachayyim birushalami. ucheden yehe malka yechiday, leela vetatta, veamma yechidaa lefulechaneh, kema dichtiv, (divre hayamim 1 17:21) umi keamcha yisrael goy echad baaretz.
Zohar, Vayishlach 1: Vayyishlach yaakov malachim vegomer. ribbi yehuda patach (Tehillim 91:11) ki malachav yetzavve lach lishmarcha bechol derachecha, hay kera ukemuha chavrayay, deha beshata devar nash ate lealma, miyyad izdamman bahadeh yetzer hara deihu mekatreg leh levar nash tadir kema deat amer, (Bereshit 4:7) lappetach chattat rovetz. may chattat rovetz, da yetzer hara.

Vedavid hachi name karyeh chattat dichtiv, (Tehillim 51:5) vechattati negdi tamid, begin deihu avid leh levar nash kol yoma lemechote kamme mareh, veyetzer hara da la itade mibbar nash miyyoma deityelid bar nash lealmin. veyetzer hattov ate levar nash miyyoma deate leitdakkaa.

Veematay ate bar nash leitdakkaa kad ihu bar telesar shenin, keden izdavvavg bar nash betarvavyyhu chad mimina vechad missemala, yetzer tov limina veyetzer ra lismala. veillen inun teren malachin mammash memannan, veinun mishtakkechin tadir bahadeh devar nash.

Ate var nash leitdakkaa, hahu yetzer hara itkafya kammeh veshallit yemina al semala. vetarvavyyhu mizdavvevgin lenatra leh levar nash bechol archoy dehu avid. hada hu dichtiv ki malachav yetzavve lach lishmarcha bechol derachecha.

Ribbi elazar mokim leh lehay kera beyaakov, dekudesha berich hu azmin bahadeh malachin mashshiryayn memannan. begin deha ihu ate shelim beshivtin illain kullehu shelemin kedka yeut, kema deittemar (dichtiv) veyaakov halach ledarko vayyifgeu vo malache elohim veittemar. vehacha kevan deishteziv minneh delavan veha itperash minneh keden izdavvevgat immeh shechinta veatu mashshiryayn kaddishin lesachara leh, ucheden vayyomer yaakov kaasher raam vegomer. umeinun malachin shaddar leh leesav hada hu dichtiv vayyishlach yaakov malachim, malachim mammash havu vadday.

Patach ribbi yitzchak veamar ketiv, (Tehillim 35:5) chone malach Adonai saviv lireav vaychalletzem, ha ukemuha. aval beatar chad ketiv ki malachav yetzavve lach, malachav saggiin, vehacha chad dichtiv chone malach Adonai saviv lireav vaychalletzem. ella ki malachav yetzavve lach, illen shear malachin. malach Adonai saviv da shechinta, kema deat amer, (Shemot 3:2) vayyera malach Adonai elav belabbat esh mittoch hassene. uvegin kach chone malach Adonai saviv lireav, laakafa leh bechol sitrin begin leshezava leh. vechad shechinta sharya begavveh devar nash, kamma mashshiryayn kaddishin kullehu izdammenu letamman.

Ta chaze, kad david malka ishteziv meachish melech gat keden amar hay, begin dishchinta sachara leh veishteziv minnayyhu meachish umeammeh kol inun deatkifu (nusach acher daakaypav) beh, ma ketiv, (Shmuel 1 21:14) vayyitholel beyadam, ammay vayyitholel, vayyishtaggea mibbae leh, kema deat amer, (sham) ki hevetem et ze lehishtaggea alay.

Ella ahadar al hahu milla deamar david bekadmita dichtiv, (Tehillim 73:3) ki kinneti bahollim vegomer. amar leh kudesha berich hu chayyecha adayin ant itzterich lehay, kevan deal leve achish veatkifu beh, ma ketiv vayyitholel beyadam, keinun hollim dekanne bekadmita, ucheden atya shechinta vesharya sacharaneh dedavid.

Vei tema shechinta la sharya ella (baachasenateh) beachsanteh, deihi ara kaddisha. vadday la sharya begin (deyankin) linaka minnah, aval laagana sharya. vehacha kad ata yaakov mibbe lavan kullehu mashshiryayn kaddishin sacharan leh vela ishtaar bilchodoy.

Amar ribbi chizkiya i hachi (sefer acher dechullehu mashshiryayn kaddishin oto bahehah ushechinta bahadeh), ammay ketiv vayyivvater yaakov levaddo vegomer. amar ribbi yehuda begin deail garmeh lesakkana, vehava chame lehahi sakkana beenoy, inun itparshu minneh, ucheden amar katonti mikkol hachasadim umikkol haemet, illen inun mashshiryayn kaddishin deitparshu minneh.

Ribbi yitzchak amar begin leshavka leh im hahu memanna deesav devirshuta illaa hava ate. veillen azle lememar shirata demata zimnayyhu leshabbacha leh lekudesha berich hu behahi shata, ulevatar ahadaru, hada hu dichtiv katonti mikkol hachasadim umikkol haemet asher asita et avdecha vegomer, veatta hayiti lishne machanot. machane shechinta, vechol beteh, (sefer acher machane chad hava dichtiv machane elohim ze), lishni machanot, dehava shelim michol sitrin mitteren chulakin chivvavr vesumak.

Ribbi elazar amar, ha ittemar, hahu lelya shuletanuta desitra deesav hava. behahi shata deha ketiv (Bereshit 1:14) yehi meorot chaser, uvegin kach vayyivvater yaakov levaddo, deishtaar yaakov deihu shimsha bilchodoy, deitkasya sihara min shimsha. veaf al gav dintiru (sefer acher veim kol da netiru) dekudesha berich hu la itade minneh mikkol vachol, veal da lo yachol lo, dichtiv vayyar ki lo yachol lo.

Istakkal limina vechama leavraham. istakkal lismala vechama leyitzchak. istakkal begufa vechama deitkelil missitra da veitkelil missitra da, keden vayyiga bechaf yerecho. bechad ammuda desamich legufa deihu levar min gufa.

Uvegin kach chone malach Adonai saviv lireav vaychalletzem, akkif leh bechol sitroy begin leshezava leh, vechad shara shechinta begavveh (sefer acher legabbeh) kamma chelin umashshiryayn atu bahadeh, umeinun malachin shaddar legabbeh deesav:

Vayyishlach yaakov malachim, amar ribbi abba vechi ammay itar ihu legabbeh deesav, vetav hava leh leishtuke minneh. ella amar yaakov yedana deesav chayyish leh likara deabba ulealam la argiz kammeh, veha yedana hoil veabba kayyaym la mistafina minneh, aval hasheta (hoil deabba kaim beena laatapeyys (leitpayysa)) immeh, miyyad vayyishlach yaakov malachim lefanav.

Vayyishlach yaakov malachim. ribbi shimon patach veamar, (Mishlei 12:9) tov nikla veeved lo mimmitkabbed vachasar lechem, hay kera al yetzer hara ittemar, begin deihu mekatrega tadir legabbe bene nasha, veyetzer hara ihu arim libbeh ureuteh devar nash begaavata veazil avatreh mesalsel saareh uveresheh ad deihu itgae aleh umashich leh laggehinnom.

Aval tov nikla, hahu dela azil avatreh deyetzer hara vela itgae kelal umaich rucheh velibbeh ureuteh legabbe kudesha berich hu, ucheden hahu yetzer hara mithappech leeved lo, dela yachil leshaltaa aloy, vehahu bar nash shallit aloy kema deat amer, (Bereshit 4:7) veatta timshal bo.

Mimmitkabbed, kema deamaran deihu okir garmeh mesalsel besaareh itgae berucheh, veihu chasar lechem, chasar mehemnuta kema deat amer, (Vayikra 21:17) lechem elohav vegomer (Vayikra 21:6) lechem elohehem hem makrivim vegomer.

Davar acher tov nikla (vaavad lo), da yaakov demaich rucheh legabbeh deesav. begin dilvatar leheve eved lo veyishlot aloy veyitkayyaym beh (Bereshit 27:29) yaavducha ammim veyishtachavu lecha leumim vegomer, vaadayin la hava zimneh kelal. ella begin desalik leh yaakov levatar yomaya, veal da hava miyyad nikla. ulevatar hahu deihu mitkabbed yehe eved lo, hahu deihu chasar lechem yehe avda lehahu deyahavu leh rov dagan vetirosh.

Ta chaze, al da begin deyada yaakov deitzterich leh, hasheta ithappach leh nikla. veyoter chachma vaakimu avad beda, mikkol ma deavad legabbe deesav. deilu hava yada esav chachma da yiktil leh legarmeh vela yete leda, aval kolla avad bechachmeta, vealeh amra channa (Shmuel 1 2:10) Adonai yechattu merivav vegomer veyitten oz lemalko vegomer:

rashi: Ufaratzta. vechazakta, kemo vechen yifrotz:
ohc: Venivrechu vecha kol mishpechot vegomer. shekken matzinu baaram shennitbarchu vo, keamram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 70) veze leshonam: shekkodem ba yaakov hayu meduchakim lammayim, vechevan shebba nitbarchu vammayim, vechen gam ken bemitzrayim meet sheyyarad nitbattela gezerat haraav, venitbarchu leraglo.

Veamro uvezarecha, shekkol zeman shehaya bet hammikdash kayyam hayta birkat shivim ummot vekiyyumam beemtzaut yisrael, shehayu makrivin shivim parim bechag (socha noah:), uvaggaluyyot gam ken kiyyum haummot usemichatam hi yisrael, dichtiv (Shir HaShirim 1:6) "samuni notera et hakkeramim" vegomer:

Uvederech remez kol happarasha tirmoz inyan haadam, uchemo shehitchilu lomar bah razal (zohar chelek 1 147): vayyetze yaakov hi hannefesh betzetah meolam haelyon, venikra yaakov al shem yetzer hara hakkaruch baakevav.
Veamro mibbeer shava – makom shemmimmennu yatzu hanneshamot yikkare beer mayim chayyim, vshava yirmoz el shevuat Adonai asher tishshava hannefesh betzetah shello taavor al devar tora (nidda 30:).
Veamro vayyelech charana – al derech amram zichronam livracha (sanhedrin tze:) ki yetzer hara yikkanes baadam betzeto merechem immo, dichtiv (Bereshit 4:7) "lappetach" vegomer.
Veamro vayyifga bammakom, ki tzarich haadam lehitpallel laAdonai shehu mekomo shel olam, shello yaazvennu beyado.
Veamro vayyalen sham ki va hashshemesh, shetztzarich lehitnaheg ken ad lechto meolam hazze kesheyyaariv shimsho, vehu amram zichronam livracha (avot 2:4): "al taamen beatzmecha ad yom motcha".

Veamro vayyikkach meavne hammakom al derech amram zichronam livracha (berachot 5:) veze leshonam: amar rabbi shimon ben lakish, leolam yargiz adam yetzer hattov vechulei, veim lav yaasok battora, dichtiv (tehillim 4:5) "imru vilvavchem". vehu amro "meavne hammakom", perush binyano shel olam shehem divre tora. gam yityaches lahem avne hammakom shebbahem niskal venirgam yetzer hara vechochotav, vehu amram zichronam livracha (sota ka.) tora matztzelet miyyetzer hara ben bizman sheosek bah ben bizman sheeno osek bah.
Veamro vayyasem meraashotav yechuvvan al derech ma sheamar rabbi shimon ben lakish: im lo nitztzecho – yikra keriat shema sheal hammitta, shenneemar "al mishkavchem" (tehillim 4:5).

Veamro vayyishkav bammakom hahu yechavven lema shessiyyem rabbi shimon ben lakish: lo nitztzecho – yizkor lo yom hammita, vehu amro vayyishkav shechiva hayyedua bammakom hayyadua, derech kol haaretz, bet moed lechol chay.

Veachar kol hattenaim hallalu muvtach hu sheyyenatztzeach hayyetzer hara, umeatta mevassero hakkatuv sheyyihye rauy leanaf meanfe hannevua sheyyiggale Adonai elav bachalom yedabber bo, vetze ulemad chalomotav shel Rabbi elazar ben arach hammuvaim besefer hazzohar (chelek 1 139 vabezaher chodesh lecha lecha ko:).

Vehassullam hu sod nefesh adam, veleheyot shebbetzet nefesh meadam beshachvo lo teaker behechlet miggufo shel adam ella chelek mimmenna bagguf, vehu amro mutztzav artza vechelek maggia hashshamayma, vehaed al ze kesheyyihye haadam yashen yakitz al yede hitnoaut hagguf hayyashen, veim nefesh haadam nifreda vehalcha lah lo targish behitnoaut hagguf, ella vadday ki mutztzevet artza veroshah maggia hashshamayma, perush sheen mafsik benah uven hashshamayim, kevan sheyyetzer hara baadam ayin, taggia hanneshama lashshamayim.

Veamro malache elohim olim vegomer, yirmoz el bechinat maasim tovim asher yishtaddel adam baolam hazze, veyaale beemtzautah orot elyonim beshoresh nishmatan, vehem nikraim bedivrehem zichronam livracha (zohar chelek 1 18) mayin nukebin, lahem yikkare malache elohim. vechen hu bemishnat chasidim (avot perek 4) haose mitzva achat kana lo peraklit echad, uvaalot ellu yerdu mayin dechurin, ki behitorrut hattachtonim yitorru mayim haelyonim lehashepia orot noraim besod nishmato, vehu amro veyordim bo.

Veamro vehinne Adonai nitztzav, perush shemmimmadrega zo yaale lannevua atzmah, velo bachalom yedabber bo ella tiggale alav hashshechina. velaze timtza sheamru zichronam livracha (282 hilchot teshuva perek 5) al yisrael shello hushelal echad mehem mehannevua, vechullan muchsharim ledavar ze:

rashi: Yariti. kemo yara vayyam, keze shehu yore hachetz:
Leechav. hem banav shehayu lo achim, niggashim elav letzara ulemilchama (Bereshit Rabba):

Vatteled zilpa. bechullan neemar herayon chutz mizzilpa, lefi shehayta vachura mikkullan vetinoket beshanim veen herayon nikkar bah; uchede lerammot leyaakov, netanah lavan lelea, shello yavin shemmachnisin lo et lea, shekkach minhag litten shifcha haggedola laggedola uketanna lakketanna:
Machanayim. shete machanot, shel chutza laaretz shebbau immo ad kan veshel eretz yisrael shebbau likrato (70 tanchuma 80 vayyishlach):
Lo nuchal. lehashekot, lefi shehaeven gedola:
Vegallu. ze meturgam viganderun, lefi shehu leshon atid:
Tzon rabbot. parot veravot mishshear tzon:
Ushefachot vaavadim. mocher tzono vedamim yekarim velokeach lo kol elle:

Vayyizkor elohim et rachel. zachar lah shemmasra simaneha laachotah veshehayta metzera shemma taale begoralo shel esav, shemma yegarshenna yaakov lefi sheen lah banim, veaf esav harasha kach ala belibbo kesheshshama sheen lah banim; hu sheyyissed happayyat haadmon kevat shello chala, tzava lekachtah lo venitbehala:
ohc: Vayyizkor elohim vegomer. maggid hakkatuv ki hagam sheala zichronah lefanav, od hutzercha litfilla, keamro "vayyishma eleha" vegomer:
Od yodia hakkatuv ki Adonai zocher et chasidav mibbeli sheyyitzaku elav, laze amar vayyizkor vegomer veachar kach vayyishma vegomer, lomar shekkodem shehitpallela ala zichronah lefanav yitbarach:

rashi: Kearye yishag. od yishag lahem kearye sheyyetzu min haggaluyyot veyelchu acharav:
Veyecherdu vanim miyyam. "veyitkanneshun galvavta mimmaarav" (targum yonatan):
targum: Batar pulechana dayya yehachun memreh kearya demachle are hu yechli veyitkanshun galvata mimaarva:

rashi: Asaf. hichnisah bemakom shello terae, vechen esof cherpatenu (Yeshayahu 4), velo yeasef habbayta (Shemot 9), asfu nagham (Yoel 4), virechech lo yeasef (Yeshayahu 60) – lo yittamen:

Cherpati. shehayiti lecherpa sheani akara vehayu omrim alay sheeele lechelko shel esav harasha. veaggada: kol zeman sheen laishsha ben, en lah bemi litlot sirchonah, mishsheyesh lah ben tola vo: mi shibber keli ze? bincha. mi achal teenim ellu? bincha:
Al birkay. ketargumo vaana erabbe:

Veibbane gam anochi. mahu gam? amra lo zekencha avraham hayu lo vanim mehagar vechagar matnav keneged sara, amar lah zekenati hichnisa tzaratah levetah, amra lo im haddavar hazze meakkev, hinne amati:
Veibbane gam anochi. kesara:
ohc: Vattomer hinne amati vegomer. dikdeka lomar amati kodem shehizkira biato eleha, velo amra "bo el amati" kemo sheamra sara kemo shepperashti (Bereshit 16:5), nitkavvena lomar sheachar sheyyavo eleha lo tikkare amatah od. velaze amar achar kach "vattitten lo bilha shifchatah leishsha", ishut yesh lo bah uvaneha bene chorin. uchemo chen asta lea shennatna lo leishsha veneekar mizzilpa shem shifcha.
Uma shemmatzinu lesara (Bereshit 16:3) shehizkira gam ken shem ishut al hagar, sheviratah betziddah bema sheddikdeka lomar tevat "lo", veayyen ma shekkatavti sham ma shello amra ken rachel.

Uma shettimtza shemmazkir hakkatuv (Bereshit 30:7) achar kach "bilha shifchat rachel" vegomer, perush shehayta shifchat rachel. gam yechavven hakkatuv sham lehazekir shevach hatztzidkut shennatnu haimmahot levaalehen. velo chash hakkatuv letaut, shessamach heyot haddavar mevoar bakketuvim hakkodmim, veayyen ma shekkatavti befarashat vayyeshev (Bereshit 37:2).

rashi: Elohe avraham. kodesh (Bereshit Rabba):
Velohe nachor. chol:
Elohe avihem. chol:
Hayachte ish. hayishav ish gechalim beshippule vegadav velo yissarfu?! kol leshon chatiyyat gechalim leshon sheiva hu kemashmaah: keshemmemalle hakkeli betoch hammedura:
targum: Dilma sayem bar nasha nura veuveh (bechuveh) ulevusheh la yakid:

rashi: Tena et nashay vegomer. eni rotze latzet ki im birshut:
Malu yamay. sheamra li immi, veod malu yamay, shehare ani ven 84 shana veematay aamid 12 shevatim? vezehu sheamar veavoa eleha, vehalo kal shebbakkallim eno omer ken? ella leholid toladot amar ken:
ohc: Vayyomer yaakov [vegomer] hava vegomer. taam amro veavoa eleha vehu lashon bilti nachon letzaddiko shel olam, yitbaer al derech ma shekkatav rambam perek Adonai mehilchot ishut: "hare at mekuddeshet li bimlacha zo sheeese immach" veasa – enah mekuddeshet vechulei, shekkol hassachar milve vehamekaddesh bemilve enah mekuddeshet ad kan. laze amar "hava" vegomer, vehattaam lefi shello kaniti otah bema sheavadti vetzarich ani liknotah bevia, shehaishsha niknet bevia, vehu amro veavoa eleha ki baavoda lo kana shehaya milve, vehamekaddesh bemilve enah mekuddeshet.

O yomar al ze hadderech: halo timtza sheamra rachel "halo nachriyyot nechshavnu lo ki mecharanu" (Bereshit 31:15), vechatav rambam (hilchot mechira perek 7) bedin lokeach avadim vekarkaot bemilve, af al pi sheen haddamim bammetziut kana, ad kan. vehu amro hava et ishti perush: kevar hi ishti, ki ani sover keharambam, umetziut shellefanenu din mecher yesh bo, uchevar zachiti bah hagam sheen haddamim beayin. uma sheani omer lecha "hava" – lo ligmar hakenaa, shekkevar kenuya hi, ella lavo aleha kederech kol haaretz. vehu amro veavoa eleha lishlol middato leval yachshov sheadayin lo kenaah.

rashi: Vattekanne rachel baachotah. kinnea vemaaseha hattovim, amra illule shetztzadka mimmenni lo zachta levanim (Bereshit Rabba):
Hava li. vechi kach asa avicha leimmecha? vehalo hitpallel aleha:
Meta anochi. mikkan lemi sheen lo vanim shechashuv kammet (Bereshit Rabba):
ohc: Vattere rachel vegomer. dikdek lomar leyaakov ki hu bachun sheeno akar, uvaze en litlot bo ella bah. veomer vattekanne baachotah, perush, letzad shehi achotah umin hassetam tidme bemizgah vetivah eleha, vezo yalda vezo lo. sheim lo hayta achotah, hayta tola lomar ki taam shello yalda hu letzad shello hushvu hammezagim vechaddome:

Od yirtze beamro leyaakov, ki ikkar hakepadatah hi leheyoto yaakov, sheim haya adam acher sheeno mefursam betzidkut hayta tola bo, shehattaam hu (Tehillim 125:3) "ki lo yanuach shevet haresha al goral hatztzaddikim" leheyotah hi tzaddeket, veze haya sibbat meniat haherayon, ma sheen ken heyoto yaakov tzaddik muvhak, laze nitkannea baachotah shezzachta laze.

rashi: Zeved tov. ketargumo:
Yizbeleni. l bet zevul (Melachim 1 8 13), 438 belaaz, bet mador, meatta lo tehe ikkar dirato ella immi sheyyesh li vanim keneged kol nashav:
Happaam yillave ishi. lefi shehaimmahot neviot hayu, veyodot shev shevatim yotzim miyyaakov ved nashim yissa, amra, meatta en lo fitchon pe alay, shehare natalti kol chelki babbanim (birvot 60):
Al ken. kol mi shenneemar bo al ken merubbe beuchlosin, chutz millevi shehaaron haya mechalle bahem:

Kara shemo levi. bechullam ketiv vattikra, veze chatav bo kara, veyesh mia beelle haddevarim rabba sheshshalach hakkabba gavriel vehevio lefanav vekara lo shem ze, venatan lo 24 mattenot kehunna, veal shem shellivvahu vemattanot kerao levi:
Bechar haggamal. leshon karim uchesatot, ketargumo baavita degamla, vehi mardaat haasuya kemin kar; uveeruvin (daf 16) shaninu hikkifuha baavitin, vehen avite gemallim, 317 belaaz:
Vayyishma elohim el lea. shehayta mitavva umechazzeret leharebot shevatim:
ohc: Vayyishma elohim. maggid shehitpallela laAdonai.

Od yirtze ki hevin veyada kavvanatah bammaase, shehu letachlit mitzva veahavatah behakkadosh baruch hu uvemitzvotav. vekilkela hashshura bemaase ze, gam Adonai kilkel hashshura, ki kefi hashshura lo hayu olim lah ella arbaa, vattahar vatteled ben chamishi yoter mehashshura uven shishshi, midda keneged midda.

rashi: Nakod. menummar bachavarburot dakkot komo nekuddot, 362 belaaz:
Vetalu. leshon telaim – chavarburot rechavot:
Chum. shachum, dome leadom, 506 belaaz; leshon mishna shachamatit venimtzet levana, leinyan hattevua:

Vehaya sechari. otan sheyyivvaldu mikkan ulehabba nekuddim uteluim baizzim ushechumim bakkesavim, yihyu shelli, veotan sheyyeshnan achshav, haferesh mehem vehafekidem beyad banecha, shello tomar li al hannoladim meatta ellu hayu sham mittechilla, veod, shello tomar li, al yede hazzecharim shehen nekuddim uteluim teladna hannekevot dugmatan mikkan vaelach:
ohc: Haser mishsham vegomer. middevarav muchach ki lo yihye lechelko ella nekuddim uteluim bakkesavim uvaizzim vechum bakkesavim, aval akuddim enam lechelko, umimma sheamar hakkatuv besamuch mashma shellakach gam haakuddim:

Venire ki yaakov bitnao lo ratza sheyyittol bechelko akuddim. vetaamo hu ki im yikkach gam haakuddim yitztarech lahasiro gam ken mitztzon lavan, umeatta en siman halloven bechol hatztzon leyachmenna hatztzon elav vahare hu yagea larik, ki lo ala al dato shel yaakov lerammot lavan beshum ofen baolam, vechashav shebbeemtzaut heakod yimmatze sheyyechemu hatztzon laledet gam ken hannakod vehattalu shehu lokeach leatzmo. uchemo chen timtza sheamar hakkatuv (Bereshit 30:40) "vayyitten pene hatztzon el akod" vehayu yoldot nekuddim uteluim vehachum sheyyechemu el hannimmur, veharammay lavan nitchakkem ledaat zo venatal hakkol akod nakod vetalu, od nitchakkem vehesir kol asher lavan bo, tippachna atzmotav ki lo chen haya hattenay, sheim ken minnayin yetzu akod o nakod o talu, umeatta paka secharo shel yaakov. mittaam ze nitchakkem yaakov lakachat sechar tarcho vayyatztzeg hammaklot velakach leatzmo gam haakuddim, ki mimma shehesiram lavan gilla dato ki beelle chelek yaakov, vehu amro (Bereshit 30:39) "vatteladna hatztzon akuddim nekuddim uteluim" vechol sheloshet hamminim bechelko shel yaakov, veal lavan neemar (Mishlei 5:22) "uvechavle chattato yittamech".

rashi: Im ani. hare im meshammesh bilshon asher, kemo ad im dibbarti devaray:
Leraa. leraa i atta over, aval atta over lifrakmatya:
Od oshivcha voohalim. achrit mittochcha sochare mirma veoshivcha voohalim, aamid mittochcha talmidim oskim battora:
Kime moed. kime moed harishon shehaya "yaakov ish tam yoshev ohalim" (Bereshit 25:27):
targum: Vaana Adonai elahach deappektach meara demitzrayim od otvinach bemashkenin keyome kadam:

rashi: Im gilad aven. im ba lahem shever veones, hem garmu leatzmam, ki ach shav hayu, uvaggilgal shevarim zibbechu laavoda zara:
Gam mizbechotam. rabbim kegallim sheal talme saday, talme saday hi maanit hammacharesha keruya telem:
targum: Im begilad havo anusin beram bevet gilgela torin letaavan dabbachu af agorehon asgiu kegarin al techume chakla:

rashi: Rakkot. shehayta sevura laalot begoralo shel esav uvocha, shehayu hakkol omrim shene vanim lerivka ushete vanot lelavan, haggedola laggadol vehakketanna lakkatan (bava batra 123):
Toar. hu tzurat happartzuf, leshon yetaarehu vassered: (Yeshayahu 44, 13), kavenapeash 109:
Mare. hu ziv kelaster:
ohc: Veene lea rakkot vegomer. en rauy lesapper hakkatuv genay hatztzaddeket em habbanim shivte yah chas veshalom, ella nitkavven lehodia sheen metziut lelavan lehachelifam ki meshunnet hayta lea merachel, ki lea millevad shello hayta yefefiyya ella sheod lah sheeneha rakkot vehu anaf mikkiur hagguf, verachel lo millevad shello haya bah kiur ella shehayta yefat toar vifat mare, umeatta hare ninalu bifne lavan ofen harammaut uvatlu rammautav.

Yefat toar vifat mare. perush sheyyesh shete bechinot bayyofi: haachat bechol perat uferat, kemo shettomar haenayim, haaf, harakka, tzavvar, vetze ulemad mimma shepperat shelomo hammelech beshir hashshirim; uvechina sheniyya hi kelalut happanim uchelalut hagguf. laze amar "yefat toar vifat mare", shehayu perateha kol echad yafe bifne atzmo vegam bederech hitkabbetzutam yachad.
Od yirtze yefat toar kemashmaah, vifat mare shehaya lah chen sheyyitavve lah kol roah.
(3) Vayyar yaakov vegomer vayyomer Adonai el yaakov. tzarich ladaat ma kesher veshayyachut lishne mikraot hallalu:

Achen kavvanat hakkatuv hi lehakedim shene devarim shemmissibbatam asa yaakov ma sheasa shebbarach belo yediat lavan, shezzulat ze lo haya holech belo yediat lavan, o adayin haya mitakkev sham yamim. vehu sheim lo raa pene lavan vedivrehem sheamru, hagam shebbaa elav hannevua lalechet, haya holech bidiat lavan ki lo nimkar yaakov leeved lo velirtzono haya immo. ella letzad divre vanav ufene lavan meshunnot haya chash sheyyigzol mimmennu kol yegio, vehu sheamar levassof (Bereshit 31:31) "ki yareti pen tigzol" vegomer. veim lo hayta baa elav hannevua lalechet, hagam shehaya shomea divre bene lavan, lo haya memaher lalechet beoto zeman ad sheyyitchakkem lakachat retzono beorech hayyamim az yippared mimmennu, veyeshev sham yamim. beofen meemtzaut shene devarim: divre bene lavan veshinnuy panav vedivre Adonai, laze asa kol haamur bainyan, laze semacham hakkatuv yachad.

rashi: Anochi immach. lefi shehaya yare meesav umillavan:
Ad asher im asiti. im meshammesh bilshon ki (gittin 90):

Dibbarti lach. letzarkecha vealecha; ma shehivtachti leavraham al zaro, lecha hivtachtiv velo leesav, shello amarti lo ki yitzchak yikkare lecha zara ella ki veyitzchak, velo kol yitzchak, vechen kol li ulecha velo velahem hassemuchim etzel dibbur meshammeshim leshon al, veze yochiach, shehare im yaakov lo dibber kodem lachen:
Asa. kanas, kemo vayyaas chayil vayyach et amalek (Shmuel 1 14):
Kemaritam. kaasher bau leeretz maritam vehayu seveim, az:
Savu vayyaram libbam. kemo "vayyarem bammatte" (Shemot 7:20), leshon 'merim. davar acher: vayyaram bechan vayyigba hu atzmo:
targum: Kad zantinun sevau misba veraem libbehon al ken shevaku lehon yat pulechani:

ohc: Vayyaavod yaakov berachel vegomer. taam amro berachel, perush, haya mefarsem bishat avoda ki bead rachel haya oved vehi lo chelef avodato millavan, gam mefarsem lishlol lea leval yishshachach haddavar vetihye kefira beno uveno.

rashi: Sevavuni. kevar vechachash uvemirma efrayim uvet yisrael, malche aseret hashshevatim vechol haam, aval yehuda odennu rad im el, moshel od beyirat elohim. rad kemo (Bamidbar 24:19) "veyerd miyyaakov", od malchehem im hakkadosh baruch hu:
targum: Asgiu kadamay kadvin devet efrayim uvenichlehon devet yisrael udevet yehuda havo matkefin befulechana ad digla ama deelaha mearahon veinun dahavo falchin kadamay bevet makdasha mitkeran ama kadisha bechen havo kayamin:

rashi: Hen. l kabbalat devarim:
Lo yehi chidvarecha. halevay shettachpotz bechach:
Ach atzmi uvesari. meatta en li leaspecha habbayta, hoil veen beyadcha chelum, ella mippene kureva atappel becha chodesh yamim, vechen asa, veaf zo lo lechinnam, shehaya roe tzono:
ohc: Vayyomer lo vegomer ach atzmi vegomer. perush, atzmo veeno atzmo, ki hiskil sheeno mibbechinato, shello tidme babbechina ki lavan choshech velo or, velaze diyyek beamro ach atzmi lemaet. veulay sheddiyyek bechinot shebbahem yidme elav shehem etzem uvasar, lo hannefesh.

Od yechavven lehashiv al ma shennitkavven lehodio ki ish chacham hu, veamar lo ach atzmi perush, miut mimma shehu, al derech amram zichronam livracha (bava batra 110.) rov habbanim domim, vechol dome lo yishve lannidme bechol chalakav mibbeli hishshaarut chelek echad. ulema shepperashti befasuk (Bereshit 27:43) "berach lecha el lavan" vegomer ki hu yaamod lehatztzilo mide esav, umin hassetam sipper yaakov haddevarim lelavan, laze heshiv shekken yaase shehu atzmo uvesaro, uchemo (Iyov 14:22) sheach besaro alav yichav kemo chen al yaakov, im yavo esav vehikkahu nafsho teeval. veamar ach lemaet shello yistakken alav.

Vayyeshev immo chodesh vegomer. heerich lo zeman ulay yitgalle bemeshech hazzeman kinyanav, uchesheraa ki en tikvat mamon berer hanehagato immo. od, lefi shennatan enav bo leavdo helim ayin mimmennu sheloshim yom vaavado bahem chinnam, veachar kach hitna immo lattaam asher avaer bidvarav. od nitkavven livchon oto hayatzliach bedarko, vetimtza ki miyyom shennichnas etzlo heevido, vechen hu omer "vaavadtani chinnam", ha lamadta shekkevar avado veraahu ki hu ish matzliach.

rashi: Vehaeven hazzot. kach tefaresh vav zo shel vehaeven: im taase li et elle, ani eese zot:

Vehaeven hazzot asher samti matztzeva vegomer. ketargumo ehi falach alah kodam Adonai, vechen asa veshuvo mippaddan aram; kesheamar lo kum ale vet el (sham 35 14) ma neemar sham? vayyatztzev yaakov matztzeva vayyassech aleha nesech:
ohc: Vehaeven hazzot vegomer. yerae ki hi zo even hashshetiyya (Zohar 1:72) shehizminah lammikdash, umatzinu lo shehizmin atze shittim lammishkan bammidbar (tanchuma teruma). veulay sheyyechavven Adonai beamro "veasu li mikdash" (Shemot 25:8) leshon mezumman, perush ma shekkevar huzeman, ki hammishkan vegam bet hammikdash bishnehem hizminam yaakov, "veshachanti betocham" chozer el shete hachanot ellu.

rashi: (Achoti at. karvenna elecha):
Umoda. karov, kemo "boaz modatenu" (Rut 3:2) – kerovenu. kelomar: karvenna etzlecha tamid:
targum: Emar lechachmeta achati ant umodata keri livyuneta:

rashi: Veanochi Adonai elohecha. velo haya lecha limrod bi:
targum: Vaana Adonai elahach deasaktach meara demitzrayim veelaha bar mini la teda ufarik let ela ana:

rashi: Veatta belohecha tashuv. behavetachato uvemishanto shehu mavtichacha atta yachol lismoch vetashuv elav, rak "chesed umishpat shemor" (Micha 6:8) umuvtach atta lekauot leyisho tamid:
targum: Veat befulechana delahach titkef chisda vedina tar usevar lefurekana delahach tedira:

rashi: Haod lanu. lamma neakkev al yadcha millashuv? kelum anu meyachalot lirash minnichse avinu kelum ben hazzecharim:
ohc: Haod lanu vegomer. kaflu lomar chelek venachala, lirmoz shene devarim: haechad hu chelek hannogea lahem birushshat immam shekkevar meta, vehashsheni nachalat avihem. vehechlitu sheen lahem tochelet mishshenehem, veharaya – "halo nachriyyot nechshavnu lo", kevar shemmecharanu, ze lecha haot sheen anu etzlo bemadregat banim, umimmela yetzav alehen leval yirshu bo. hagam shebbemishpete haggoyim efshar shehabbanot yirshu, veon yochiach, uchemaase rabban shimon ben gamliel vaachoto (shabbat 116:).
Veamro vayyochal gam achol – shete achilot: achat yerushshat ketubbat immam, vehashsheniyya ma sheavad yaakov arba esre shana baadam.

Vayyignov vegomer al beli vegomer. kashe ech yutzdak lomar elav shehu boreach, sheomer "al beli higgid lo ki voreach". veulay shehakkavvana hi shennitchakkem yaakov keshessipper lelavan kol maasav vehanehagotav, helim mimmennu armat habbericha, vehosif lishlol otah mimmennu bema shehaya shoel mimmennu leshallecho. baze haya matzdik lavan ki lo yivrach kelal, sheim lo chen lamma haya shoel mimmennu sheyyeshallechehu, uvaze ganav libbo. vehu amro vayyignov vegomer, uvamme ganav? al sibbat shello higgid lo besippur maasav ki yaarim livroach kesheyyitztarech livroach. uvaze matzinu taam beikkar hodaat katuv ze, shebba lomar taam shebbo hissig habbericha, ki zulat ze haya noten lev lavan lishmor oto millivroach beeze ofen sheyyihye, ella shegganav libbo uvaze matza hachana leesof kol asher yesh lo uvarach veen yodea, vehu sheamar samuch laze "vayyivrach hu vechol asher lo" vegomer, vehaven:

Vayyomer lavan tov titti vegomer. tzarich ladaat leeze inyan amar ken lavan. gam ech yutzdak lomar tov titti lach mittitti vegomer im acher lo yaavod, veulay sheshshiker lavan baze veramaz lo ki yesh acher sheyyaavod kemo chen bead rachel. veod kashe ech yutzdak lomar "titti" leshon mattana, kevan shehu oved baadah sheva shanim shehu kede dameha, ki halo teda shehakkone eved ivri shesh shanim yaavod, vahare hu natan shavyo bead shovi rachel. od tzarich ladaat amro sheva immadi shehu sefat yeter.

Achen machshavto haraa nikkeret mittoch devarav, ki nitkavven lerammot latet lo lea kemo sheasa achar kach, velaze hikdim ledabber elav kaddevarim haelle. veze hu shiur devarav: tov titti otah lach, amar leshon mattana lishlol ki en ze mecher lomar lo levassof hen otah kaniti mimmecha, kemo shekken amar "halo verachel" vegomer (Bereshit 29:25), uchemo sheavaer sham beezrat hashshem. vechash sheyyavin yaakov shebbetorat mattana muchletet hu notnah, ulevassof yavo alav betaanat hava sechar sheva shanim sheavad. laze amar ki haavoda sheoved immo tihye bead ma shebbocher bo yoter meish acher, veze hu shiur hakkatuv tov titti otah lach veevchar becha letzad ma sheatta oved immi, mittitti otah leish acher belo avoda, uleolam en ze shavyah shel rachel velo bivchinat mecher hu machnisah.

Veamro sheva immadi matne alav sheyyeshev immo velo yarchik nedod veyaavod merachok, ella immo yeshev kol zeman haavoda shettihye enav pekuchot al avodato. od heerim lomar elav sheyyeshev immo ad olam, uchemo shehitna (Shemot Rabba 1:33) yitro im moshe velo hutzrach lehashebio al haddavar mippene shehem devarim hanniknim baamira. veyitro shehutzrach lehashebio lemoshe, nitkavven lechayyevo afillu titratztze tzippora lalechet hishbio al dato lashevet et haish. vetaana zo haya bedato liton keneged yaakov kesheyyitztarech, velaze tzivva Adonai elav (Bereshit 31:24) "hishshamer lecha pen tedabber im yaakov", veyaakov lo asa shemira laze, ki divre lavan dibberam elav bederech chibba al ze hadderech, ulemi etten bitti tov mimmecha, shev beni immadi, perush ki anashim achim anachnu, ulevavo lo ken yachshov.

rashi: Veammi teluim limshuvati. keshehanneviim melammedim otam lashuv elay, teluim hem im lashuv im lo lashuv; bekoshi yeshuvun elay:

Veel al yikrauhu yachad lo yeromem. veel haddavar asher alav yikrauhu hanneviim yachad, lo yerommuhu ammi velo yeot laasoto. veyesh mefaresh "veel al yikrauhu" – pegaim kashim yifgeum, veel kemo "yesh leel yadi" (Bereshit 31:29), veen zot, shehare nakud befattach, veim haya veel shem davar haya nakud betzere. veyonatan tirgem: "bemara kashya yitarun", asa el (62: al) leshon 'kashe, veli nire shepperashti kahogen:
Yachad lo yeromem. "kachada la yehakkun bekoma zekufa" (targum yonatan):
targum: Veami feligin lemetav leoraychi uvimroa kashya yitarun kachada la yehachun bekoma zekufa:

rashi: Happaam ode. shennatalti yoter mechelki, meatta yesh li lehodot:
Vedibbarti al hanneviim. lehochiach etchem ulehachazir etchem lammutav:
Uveyad hanneviim adamme. nireti lahem bechamma dumeyot (Yechezkel 1:26). davar acher: adamme lahem devaray al yede meshalim kede leyashshevam al shomehem:
targum: Umallet im neviyaya vaana nevuan asgeti uveyad neviyay shelachet:

rashi: Kenaan beyado mozne mirma. attem semuchim al bitzachem, sheattem socharim verammaim, veal ashrechem attem omrim: "ach asharti" (Hoshea 12:9), velo eevod et hakkadosh baruch hu:
targum: La tehevyan ketagarin devidehon moznavan denachil lemenas rachmin:

rashi: Ki yareti vegomer. heshivo al rishon rishon, sheamar lo, vattenaheg et benotay vegomer:
ohc: Vayyaan yaakov vegomer. perush, en ani machchish shebbarachti, uma sheamarta "lamma" vegomer, ki yareti mimmecha shemma tigzol vegomer, uma shehitbonanta lomar ki lesibba zo ganavti elohecha leval yaggid, laze ana "im asher" vegomer, ki taana zo shel genevat hatterafim ki ze yaggid shebboreach hu hi taana hannishmaat, laze nishba lo aleha biklala kedin hammacharim al hassafek.

rashi: Lo yichye. umeotah kelala meta rachel badderech (Bereshit Rabba)
Ma immadi. mishshellecha:
ohc: Lo yichye. kedin ben noach, veim tomar en tzarich leamrah halo mishpato charutz, nitkavven lomar sheen lo taana lomar ki netunim hemma lo o shechuchim hemma etzlo:
Lo leishsha. maggid hakkatuv beamro lo vegomer, ki akeret habbayit hi rachel, ki hi bat zugo.

rashi: Veet asher haya miknecha itti. et cheshbon miut miknecha shebba leyadi mittechilla, kamma hayu:
El hammaklot. el marot hammaklot:
Akuddim. meshunnim bimkom akidatam, hem karsulle yedehem veraglehem:
Halo nochriyyot nechshavnu lo. afillu veshaa shedderech bene adam latet neduneya livnotav – bishat nissuin – nahag immanu kenachriyyot, ki mecharanu lecha bischar happeulla:
Et kaspenu. sheikkev deme sechar peullatcha:
Vattachalef et maskurti. hayita meshanne tenay shebbenenu, minnakod letalu, umeakudim livruddim:
Ani yedaticha. natatti lev ladaat tzarkecha vesippakticha:
Taluvot. en lo dimyon, ufitrono lefi inyano: tel sheovin bo kol tova veen motzin:
targum: Ana sofket tzorchechon bemadbera beara dahavetun taavin bah lechol midaam:

rashi: Vehammitzpa asher amar vegomer. vehammitzpa asher behar haggilad, kemo shekkatuv vayyaavor et mitzpe gilad (Shoftim 11), velamma nikret shemah mitzpa? lefi sheamar echad mehem lachavero, yitzef Adonai beni uvenecha im taavor et habberit:
Ki nissater. velo nire ish et reehu:
Olim veyordim. olim techilla veachar kach yordim? malachim shelliuuhu baaretz en yotzim chutza laaretz, vealu larakia veyardu malache chutza laaretz lelauoto:
ohc: Vayyachalom vehinne vegomer. taam amro vehinne: leheyot sheen hachalom muchlat bivchinat hatztzedek ki chalomot shav hem, gam sheal kol panim yihye bahem teven ki hem bemare hashshiamum, laze amar "vehinne" – perush ki haddevarim belo shiamum vedimyonot ella kol davar nigle etzlo umevoar keyom yair, veen ze dome lishar hachalomot sheroe davar veeno machlit biriyyato ma shehu roe. velaze timtza sheddikdek lomar bechol perat uferat mehannigle elav bachalom "vehinne", gabbe reiyyat hassullam amar vehinne sullam, gabbe reiyyat hammalachim amar vehinne malache vegomer, gabbe gilluy shechina amar vehinne Adonai, hakkavvana baze ki hayta nevua mammash.

rashi: Vayyifga bammakom. lo hizkir hakkatuv beeze makom ella bammakom – hannizkar bemakom acher, hu har hammoriyya, shenneemar bo vayyar et hammakom merachok:

Vayyifga. kemo ufaga biricho ufaga bedabbashet (Yehoshua 16 25) verabbotenu pershu leshon tefilla (berachot 26), kemo veal tifga bi (Yirmeyahu 7), velamadnu shettikken tefillat arvit. veshinna hakkatuv velo katav vayyitpallel, lelammedcha shekkaftza lo haaretz, kemo shemmeforash beferek gid hannashe (chullin 91):
Ki va hashshemesh. haya lo lichtov vayyavo hashshemesh vayyalen sham, ki va hashshemesh mashma sheshshaka lo chamma pitom, shello beonatah, kede sheyyalin sham:

Vayyasem meraashotav. asaan kemin marzev saviv lerosho, sheyyare mippene chayyot raot; hitchilu merivot zo et zo, zot omeret alay yaniach tzaddik et rosho vezot omeret alay yaniach; miyyad asaan hakkabba even achat, vezehu shenneemar vayyikkach et haeven asher sam meraashotav:
Vayyishkav bammakom hahu. leshon miut; beoto makom shachav aval 14 shanim sheshshimmesh bevet ever lo shachav ballayla, shehaya osek battora:
ohc: Vayyifga bammakom. peshato shel mikra sheppaga bemakom echad shel yishshuv, uchemo shettimtza sheggamar omer hakkatuv levassof, dichtiv: "veulam luz shem hair" (Bereshit 28:19), hare ki ir hayta, vayyalen sham bair hahi.

Veamro ki va hashshemesh, lomar shezzulat ze haya holech hu lehaggia limchoz cheftzo bemitzvat aviv veimmo. verabbotenu zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 68:9) pershu bammakom hayyadua har hammoriyya, dichtiv (Bereshit 22:4) "vayyar et hammakom" vegomer, veze derech derash binkuddat hahe. vedivrehem zichronam livracha kichtuvim vechimsurim etzlenu, veen setira lidvarenu uchemo shepperesh Rashi shenneekar har hammoriyya uva lesham, ki hu ze makom hamekuddash.

Vayyishkav bammakom hahu. hodia ze lomar "vayyachalom" vegomer, veamar bammakom hahu, ki lo hashshechiva hi davar hassovev lachalom, ella letzad hammakom hahu ki haya makom mekuddash kemo sheamar levassof.

Od yirmoz beamro vayyishkav bammakom al derech amram zichronam livracha (chullin tze:) shekkippel haaretz tachtav, laze amar "vayyishkav bammakom hahu" perush kullo shachav bo, keamro (Bereshit 28:13) "asher atta shochev aleha":

rashi: Lo yavuzu vegomer venimtza yeshallem vegomer noef ishsha vegomer. shelashtam mechubbarim bedibbur echad. im yignov haggannav geneva en levazzoto kol kach kemo hannoef, lamma ki leraavon nafsho hu ose veulay en lo ma yochal, ucheshennimtza yesh lo takkana betashlumin, ulechol hayyoter yeshallem shivatayim kelomar tashlume kefel harebe vaafillu chamishshim al echad, veyesh mefarshim shivatayim kemo gonev shor vechelav utevacho shemmeshallem chamishsha vakar vetashlume kefel al hakkelim (Shemot 21:37) hare shiva: et kol hon beto yitten. vaafillu tzarich limkor kol asher lo al ze mikkol makom yesh lo takkana umittechilla mechamat raav asa, aval:
targum: La lemitramaru leganava deganev detisba nafsheh metul dechafen:

rashi: Veneesfu. regilim hayu leheasef, lefi shehayta haeven gedola:
Vegallu. vegollim, vetargumo umeganderin, kol leshon hove mishtanne ledabber bilshon atid uvilshon avar, lefi shekkol davar hahove tamid kevar haya veatid lihyot:
Veheshivu. targumo umetivin:
Eevodcha sheva shanim. hem yamim achadim sheamra lo immo veyashavta immo yamim achadim (Bereshit Rabba); veteda shekken hu, shehare chetiv vayyihyu veenav keyamim achadim (Bereshit 29):

Berachel bittecha hakketanna. kol hassimanim hallalu lamma? lefi shehu yodea bo shehu rammay, amar lo, eevadcha verachel, veshemma tomar rachel acheret min hashshuk, talmud lomar bittecha, veshemma tomar achalif lelea shemah veekra shemah rachel, talmud lomar hakketanna; veaf al pi chen lo hoil, shehare rimmahu:
ohc: Vayyeehav yaakov et rachel. perush, lo letzad yafyah ella letzad ma sherachel bat zugo.

O yomar al derech amram zichronam livracha (shabbat ko:) bedin ziuug talmid chacham shetztzarich shettihye lo ishsha naa keneged yetzer hara, vahagam ki yishtanne yaakov lemaaliyyuta shemmushelal miyyetzer hara, im kol ze hattora telammed leadam daat.

Eevadcha sheva shanim. tzaddik ze yechavven tamid lehachenia atzmo sheva, vegam behishtachavayato leachiv sheva peamim (Bereshit 33:3), vehu sod (Mishlei 24:16) "sheva yippol tzaddik vakam" achare naflo. veulay shennatan shavyah bema sheshshibed atzmo sheva shanim shehu yoter mikkede shene eved ivri (Shemot 21:2).

Berachel bittecha hakketanna. "berachel" velo belea, "bittecha" velo rachel acheret min hashshuk, "hakketanna" shello tachlif shemot benotecha vetikra laggedola rachel, "hakketanna" ani omer velo haggedola, velo yoil lecha shinnuy hashshem shettikra lah rachel.

rashi: Nichashti. menachesh haya, nissiti benichush shelli sheal yadcha baa li veracha; keshebbata lechan lo hayu li vanim, shenneemar vehinne rachel bitto baa im hatztzon (Bereshit 29:6), efshar yesh lo vanim vehu sholeach vitto etzel haroim? achshav hayu lo vanim, shenneemar vayyishma et divre vene lavan (sham 31):
Hael bet el. kemo el bet el, hahe yetera, vederech mikraot ledabber ken, kemo ki attem baim el haaretz kenaan (Bamidbar 34):
Mashachta sham. l ribbuy ugedulla keshennimshach lammalchut, kach vayyitzok shemen al roshah – lihyot meshucha lemizbeach:
Asher nadarta li. vetzarich atta leshallemo, sheamarta yihye bet elohim, shettakriv sham karbanot:

ohc: Vayhi vaerev vegomer. tzaar gadol garam behateaat hatztzaddik vegaram pizzur tokef hakkedushsha, vetze ulemad (Zohar vayyishlach 176) ki ze sibba shenneekra kedushshat habbechor asher bo yitkabbetzu malchut uchehunna veshekel kaful bayyerushsha, uletzad hammaase shechashav yaakov berachel veasa peullato belea, nitpazzeru bechinot hakkedushsha vattechelash gevurat hakkodesh:
Vayyikkach et lea. ulay shello ratzta lerammot yaakov, ulekachah beal karchah o beritztzuy devarim, vezulat ze lo haya tzarich lomar ella "vayyave lea vitto elav":

Vayyave otah. heerim lahaviah beyado, velo mesarah lo lishluche haav velo lishluche habbaal, kede shello yihye lo zeman lehakkir bah kodem, veheviah beyado, veen mehammusar lechatan lehizdammen lefanav, vesham amad lavan ad samuch leviato eleha lehameit lo zeman hahakkara.

Vayyavo eleha. taam shello hirgish bah hu lachashashat tzaddik veyashar veneeman ruach, leval yikkashel bemichshol haenoshi asher yitauu taava kodem kerov eleha, veyattifu mimmennu tzichtzuche tuma kodem hatechalat mitzva. umi lanu gadol miyyaakov avinu, edut lo battora (Bereshit 49:3) "reshit oni", veayyen ma shekkatavnu sham, asher al ken hirchik harot bah vetechef umiyyad ba eleha lishmor chumo bal yechallel berito berit kodesh, vegam achar gemar bia lo hikkir bah ki kibba hannerot kemishpat leohave shemo (orach chayyim 240) ad or habboker.

rashi: Vayyivrach yaakov sede aram vegomer. keadam sheomer nachazor al harishonot sheddibbarnu lemala "vayyasar el malach" (Hoshea 12:5), veod zot asiti lo hutzrach livroach sede aram yedatem ech shemartiv:
Uveishsha shamar. et hatztzon:
targum: Neviya amar lehon hala yaakov avuchon azal lechakle aram ufelach yisrael beitteta uveitteta netar ana:

rashi: Bacha. hammalach:

Vayyitchannen lo. kesheamar lo "lo ashallechacha ki im berachtani" (Bereshit 32:27), hammalach haya mevakkesh mimmennu: "hannach li achshav, sofo shel hakkadosh baruch hu liggalot alecha bevet el, vesham yimtzaennu vesham yedabber immanu, vehu vaani naskim lecha al habberachot shebberachcha yitzchak". veoto malach saro shel esav haya (Bereshit Rabba 77:3), vehaya mearer al habberachot:
targum: Veitravrav im malacha vichil becha uvea mineh bevet al itgele alohi vetaman yemalel imana:

rashi: Veshavti. kemo sheamar li vahashivoticha el haadama:
Veshalom. shalem min hachet, shello elmad middarche lavan:

Vehaya Adonai li lelohim. sheyyachul shemo alay mittechilla vead sof, shello yimmatze pesul bezari, kemo shenneemar asher dibbarti lach; vehavetacha zo hivtiach leavraham, shenneemar lihyot lecha lelohim ulezaracha acharecha (Bereshit 17:7):
ohc: Vehaya Adonai li lelohim. vead atta eno lelohim chas veshalom. verashi zichrono livracha peresh shello yimmatze pesul bezari, veen ani yodea hechan ramuz davar ze beamro "vehaya" vegomer. veod havetacha zo tamid hi teluya veomedet, veematay yihye ketz haggevul laasot haeven matztzeva. vehannachon hu shennitkavven lomar sheyyityached elav shem Adonai lelohim kederech shennityached al avotav (Bereshit 28:13) "elohe avraham elohe yitzchak", gam yeamer alav "elohe yaakov", vehu amro li lelohim perush: li beyichud. vedavar gadol dibber yaakov baze, vetimtza shekken haya, dichtiv (Bereshit 33:20) "vayyikra lo el elohe yisrael" veachar kach shillem nidro asher nadar laasot even hazzot.

rashi: Nokva. ketargumo paresh agrach:
Hachi achi atta. leshon tema, vechi bishvil sheachi atta taavdeni chinnam:
Vaavadtani. kemo vetaavdeni; vechen kol teva shehi leshon avar hosif vav beroshah, vehi hofechet hatteva lehabba:
ohc: Vayyomer lavan vegomer hachi achi vegomer. kashe, mi amar lo chinnam hu ovdo? veod, lu yehi kidvarav, uma bechach im ovdo chinnam? veim retzono lomar shehu "sone mattanot yichye", halo matzinu sheohev haggezel, umikkol shekken sheyyihye chafetz bannittan lo beratzon!

Achen siftotav barur millelu ki lo ba ella lehameit secharo shel yaakov, vehu al derech ma shekkatav harambam (hilchot sheluchin veshuttafin perek 6 uferek 8) shekkol shello hitna haroe im baal habbayit yittol secharo bechelek happikkadon shelish harevach uvaagalim useyachim shene shelishim. laze chash lavan ki tamo shel yaakov shello berer sheddato littol shelish baggedolim ushene shelishim baagalim vegomer vayyecherad harammay al haddavar, vehen emet im haya yaakov keachad hassechalim lo yakpid alav shennitkavven laze az o sheyyitten dato achar kach, veyalim lavan enav mimmennu leavdo chinnam, ella lema shekkadam lo shehodia sheyyaarim gam hu im hearum laze ratza legallot, vehu amro hachi achi atta arum kemoti, kederech amro (Bereshit 29:12) "achi aviha hu" uchemo shennoda lo mimmaasav asher sipper lo. vaavadtani chinnam perush hayeamen shettaavod chinnam, ha vadday shettavo betaana levassof vetikkach ma sherauy lakachat bammishpat, laze ani rotze shettegalle datecha "haggida li" vegomer, vechol tenay shebbemamon kayyam.

rashi: Avina. hivchanti veraiti:
targum: Vachazet veshavre veistakkelet bitlae utemahet bachasir raayona:

rashi: (Vattikra shemo reuven rabbotenu pershu, amra reu ma ben beni leven chami shemmachar habbechora leyaakov, veze lo mecharah leyosef velo irer alav, velo od shello irer alav ella shebbikkesh lehotzio min habbor) (berachot 7):
ohc: Vattahar lea vegomer vattahar od vegomer. raiti latet lev beseder hashshemot, ki min harauy lehakedim hasarat hassina veachar kach sibbat haahava, vehi amra barishon atta yeehavani uvashsheni hasarat hassina. od, ma hi kavvanatah beamrah (Bereshit 29:34) "happaam yillave", vechi mikkodem lo nitlavva lah?

Achen hatztzaddeket aleha hashshalom, letzad shekkadam lah hammaamar shealav chalta beeneha ki hi chelko shel esav, vahagam sheraata shennisset leyaakov, en davar ze matzdik belibbah ki hi bat zugo. velaze kesheraata shennittan lah ben amra vadday ki letzad rachame Adonai aleha letzad shello hayta ahuva, ki hatztzaddikim yekayyemu mitzvat chachamim (avot 1:6) ladun lechaf zechut, velaze hayta tamid dana lechaf zechut velo ala al datah ki hayta senua, uchemo shepperashti bappasuk (Bereshit 29:31) "vayyar Adonai" vegomer, velo chen hayta datah, vezo hi middat hameushsharim. asher al ken keshennittan lah ben rishon amra ki ze ba lehashelim hechaser shehi haahava, uchesheraata shehosif Adonai venatan lah ben sheni, amra lemafrea toa hayiti bema shechashavti shello haya li ella mechussar haahava, vahare shama Adonai, perush ma shello hevanti ani ki senua anochi, laze natan shenayim, echad lehasir hassina veechad lehachenis haahava, velaze amra (Bereshit 29:33) ki shama Adonai ki senua vegomer. ucheshennatan lah ben shelishi amra meatta en taam baddavar, ella hare ze ba lelammed ki lo bederech taut hayu nissueha ki im ishto zot, vehu amrah happaam yatzdik lehitlauot lah betorat ishut, ki im tzad hasarat hassina unetinat haahava mishshum kelimmati asa Adonai, haya maspik bishne banim, umeatta bishlosha have chazaka ki ani bat zugo, venissueha meAdonai yatza haddavar.

Od nitkavvena beamrah yillave ishi, ki gam bizman yetziatah meolam hazze lo tippared mimmennu, lihyotah bat zugo, uchemaamaram zichronam livracha (zohar mishpatim kav.) ki hazzugot yitlauu baolam haelyon bitmidut. veamra hattaam ki yaladti lo shelosha banim, uvishlosha have chazaka ki bat zugo ani.

Od shetztzafta beruach hakkodesh shearba nashim yihyu leyaakov, uchefi ze olim lah kefi hacheshbon shelosha, ucheshennittan lah ben revii amra (Bereshit 29:35) happaam ode et Adonai, ki ad atta haya ose lah mishpat hatztzarich, aval happaam hazzot en ze ella hafelagat tovato yitbarach uveracha al rov tova.

rashi: Ki kol haosher. ki ze meshammesh bilshon ella; kelomar, mishshel avinu en lanu kelum, ella ma shehitztzil hakkabba meavinu shellanu hu:
Hitztzil. leshon hifrish, vechen kol leshon hatztzala shebbammikra leshon haferasha, shemmafrisho min haraa umin haoyev:
ohc: Asher hitztzil vegomer lanu vegomer. perush: Adonai hitztzil mamonenu shehu chayyav lanu miyyado, shelleshon hatztzala yeamer al gezela miggazlan, vehu amro lanu perush: mishshellanu sheggazal.

rashi: Vattignov oti. ganavta et dati:

ohc: Ulelavan shete vanot vegomer. nitkavven hakkatuv lomar shehayu nikkarot umefursamot shehaggedola hi lea vehakketanna hi rachel, shello haya yachol lomar ki haggedola hi hakkerua rachel. gam dikdek lomar "haggedola" "hakketanna" lomar ki lo hayu begeder lehachelifam veyaase ketanna gedola, viramme leyaakov betet lo lea veyomar ki hi hakketanna sheshshemah rachel, ki haggedola hayta gedola beyoter vehakketanna ketanna beyoter. vehu amro haggedola, perush shehayta lea gedola bifne atzmah, lo beerech rachel levad hayta gedola mimmenna beshana o shenatayim, shehahekker eno barur kol kach, verachel gam ken hayta ketanna beyoter bifne atzmah, lo beerech lea levad, kemo shettomar ki lea hayta bat esrim shana vamala verachel kevat chamesh kevat sheva, umeatta en makom lelavan lerammot yaakov bitnao.

rashi: Netzor beni mitzvat avicha:
targum: Tur beri pukedana daavuch vela tite minimosa deimach:

rashi: Aseret monim. en monim pachot measara:
Monim. leshon sechum, kelal hacheshbon vehen asiriyyot; lamadnu shehechelif tenao 100 peamim:
ohc: Vaavichen vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma hu hahittul shehaya mehattel bo, veim avarat hadderech, ze gazlan mikre.

Veulay ki lavan hirgish mippaam rishona sheraa sheyyaldu hatztzon beribbuy min hannogea leyaakov bechelko, laze nitchakkem veamar: bevadday halo davar hu. laze haya omer lo min echad bitchilla, veachar sheyyechemu hatztzon haya chozer bo ben ibbur leleda velokeach leatzmo min sheamar, umeyached leyaakov min acher, velaze lo yikkare ella hittul sheppeamim omer kach ufeamim vechulei.

rashi: Andem. leshon kesher hu, kemo "eendennu atarot li" (Iyov 31:36):
targum: Ketorinun belibbach tedira ucheruch inun betzavrach:

rashi: Vayyatztzeg. targumo vedaitz, leshon techiva uneitza hu vilshon arammi, veharebe yesh battalmud datzah ushelafah, datz beh mide, datzah kemo deatzah, ella shemmekatztzer et leshono:
Barhatim. bimrutzot hammayim, babberechot haasuyot baaretz lehashekot sham hatztzon:
Asher tavona vegomer. barhatim asher tavona hatztzon lishtot sham hitztzig hammaklot lenochach hatztzon:

Vayyechamna. habbehema roa et hammaklot vehi nirtaat laachoreha vehazzachar rovah veyoledet kayyotze vo. rabbi hoshaya omer, hammayim naasin zera bimehen velo hayu tzerichot lezachar, vezehu vayyechamna vegomer (Bereshit Rabba):
VaAdonai elohe hatztzevaot Adonai zichro. kaasher hayiti meaz ken ani atta, veim heyitem holchim immi betamimut keyaakov avichem (Bereshit 25:27), hayiti noheg immachem kaasher nahagti immo:
targum: Neviya emar lehon hu Adonai elohe tzevaot deitgele al avraham yitzchak veyaakov uchema daamir al yede moshe dachraneh lechol dar vedar:

rashi: Roe ruach. leshon 'rea, mitchabber ledivre ruach lehaavoda zara. veshemen shellahem lemitzrayim movilim latet shochad lemitzrayim laazor oti:
targum: Bet yisrael daman lidruach zera vealol chatzad kol yoma kadvin uviza masgan ukeyam im atturaa akimu vekurebana lemitzrayim movlin:

rashi: Bime ketzir chittim. lehaggid shivchan shel shevatim; sheat hakkatzir haya velo fashat yado vaggezel lehavi chittim useorim, ella devar hahefker, sheen adam makpid bo:
Dudaim. sigli, esev hu (sanhedrin 99), uvilshon yishmael yasmin:

ohc: Vayyomer lahen roe anochi vegomer. perush, veim tomar sheyyesh lo taam nachon ki hu roe ki shellecha gadol mishshello ufaratzta meod, laze amar velohe avi haya immadi vezo beracha meet Adonai.

rashi: Dalakta. radafta, kemo al heharim delakunu (Eicha 4), uchemo middelok achare felishtim (Shmuel 1 17):
ohc: Vayyichar leyaakov vayyarev. perush, letzad shebba lichlal kaas ba lichlal meriva, vezulat ze lo haya meriv.

Vayyarev belavan. perush, beerech lavan haya haddavar nikkar shehu meriva, aval im hayu haddevarim leadam acher lo tikkare meriva. vechen timtza sheamru zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 74) veze leshonam: kafdanutam shel avot velo anvetanutan shel banim vechulei piyyusim yaakov mefayyes lechamiv" vechulei ad kan. veze mechuvvan lidvarenu. veulay yechavven od shello rav immo bichnufeyat anashim ella beyichud immo, vehu amro vayyarev belavan perush: beyichud immo shello yikkalem betochachto.

Ma pishi vegomer. perush: bishlama im miyyamecha matzata bi avel sheppashati lecha, kiur ze shel haggeneva befesha, velo levad befesha ella afilu beshogeg, vehu amro ma chattati shettachshedeni begannav. vegilla dato yaakov ki taam hakepadato hayta sheraahu memashshesh kol nechasav vechelav, uletzad heder yediato bignevat hatterafim yachshov ki lo haya mechappes chippush mechuppas ella lirot im lakach devar ma mishshello, veheerim lomar shegganvu lo terafav sheyyihye lo sibba lechappes bechol hammekomot. laze hochicho minnayin nichnas lo tzad hassafek bo shehutzerach lechappes.

rashi: Vetorati keishon enecha. shachor shel ayin shehu dome lachoshech, kemo ishon layla:
targum: Netar pikuday vecheye venimuse hech bavta deayna:

rashi: Yosef Adonai li ben acher. yodaat hayta vinvua sheen yaakov atid lehaamid ella shenem asar shevatim, amra yehi ratzon sheoto shehu atid lehaamid yehe mimmenni, lechach lo nitpallela ella al ben acher:
Hatachat. vechi vimkomo ani?
Asher mana mimmech. at omeret sheeese cheabba, ani eni keabba, abba lo hayu lo vanim, ani yesh li banim; mimmech mana velo mimmenni:
ohc: Vayyichar af vegomer. hattaam lefi shehotzia mippiha devar kelala sheamra "meta anochi", vedivre hatztzaddikim afilu beseder ze yaasu roshem, vetze ulemad (Bereshit Rabba 74:9) mimma shekkillel hu al tenay vechulei, laze chara appo. velaze dikdek lomar berachel perush bishvilah, gam lefi sheamra "hava li" vegomer velo amra hitpallel alay.

rashi: Bayyom hashshelishi. shehare derech sheloshet yamim haya venehem:
Et banav veet nashav. hikdim zecharim linkevot, veesav hikdim nekevot lizcharim, shenneemar vayyikkach esav et nashav veet banav vegomer:
El eshet reehu. kemashmao. veaf al avodat gillulim yesh ledarshah (Shemot Rabba 33:7), shehi meyuchedet laggoyim velo lecha:
targum: Hechna ma deael al ittat chavreh lemegur imah la nizke kol man dekarev bah:

rashi: Beohel yaakov. hu ohel rachel, shehaya yaakov tadir etzlah; vechen hu omer bene rachel eshet yaakov uvechullan lo neemar eshet yaakov:
Vayyavo beohel rachel. kesheyyatza meohel lea chazar lo leohel rachel kodem sheyyechappes beohel haamahot, vechol kach lamma? shehaya makkir bah shehi mashmeshanit:
Uvenavi heela Adonai vegomer. veal sheattem mevazzin et hanneviim umaligin bedivrehem (divrei hayamim 2 36:16), halo benavi heela vegomer:
targum: Veaf kad nechatu avahatchon lemitzrayim neviya shelach Adonai vaasek yat yisrael mimitzrayim veal yede neviya itnetar:

rashi: Velakachat gam et dudae beni. bitmiha, velaasot od zot likkach gam et dudae beni; vetargumo ulemesav:
Lachen yishkav immach hallayla. shelli hayta shechivat layla zo, vaani notna lach tachat dudae venech, ulefi shezzilzela bemishkav hatztzaddik lo zachta lehikkaver immo (nidda 31):
ohc: Hameat kachtech vegomer. kavvanat lea hi al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 98) ki keviut mittato shel yaakov haya etzel rachel, velaze amra "hameat kachtech et ishi", perush: chelek haodef etzlech hu nigra mechelek lea. veamrah velakachat vegomer techavven lomar ki bechinat halleda tithavve merov zikkuk umehatmadat shechivat habbaal, uchemaamaram zichronam livracha (chullin 11:) bechamma mekomot, umaase haddudaim hem segulla lalleda (Zohar 1:157.), laze amra day lach kichat ishi bitmidut etzlech kannizkar, velamma tosif kachat dudae veni?

Vetaam yaakov shehaya ose hefresh ben shete nashav, letzad sheen alav chiyyuv lea zulat ona haamura battora (Shemot 21:10) "lo yigra", ki lo nesaah birtzono uvidiato uchemaase shehaya, ma sheen ken rachel ishto zot uvah avad paam rishona usheniyya.
Lachen yishkav vegomer. yerae ki birtzon rachel haya haddavar taluy, veomeret lachen – perush, al netinatech li dudaim vechulei:

O yirtze leshon shevua, mishshum shehem devarim sheen niknim ella bishvua, ki lo hiknat lah davar sheyyesh bo mammash, veayyen ma shekkatavti befasuk (Bereshit 25:33) "hishshava li" bemecher bechorat esav.

rashi: Vehakkesavim hifrid yaakov. hannoladim akudim nekuddim hivdil vehifrish leatzman veasa otan eder eder levaddo, veholich oto haeder haakud lifne hatztzon, ufene hatztzon haholchim acharehem tzofot alehem; vezehu sheamar vayyitten pene hatztzon el akod, shehayu fene hatztzon el haakudim, veel kol chum shemmatza betzon lavan:
Vayyashet lo adarim. kemo shepperashti:
ohc: Pene hatztzon el akod. taam shello amar "el nakod" o "el talu", ulay ki yoter yechemu hatztzon el min ze mehav acherim.

Vayyashet lo adarim vegomer. nitkavven baze kede shettamid lo yihyu hatztzon mistakkelin ella beotan minim velo bishar minim, shebbaze lo yeldu kelal ki im meoto hammin, sheim lo chen yitztarech yaakov latet mitztzono lelavan keshetteladna min sheeno akod vetalu vechulei:

rashi: Vayyikra lerachel ulelea. lerachel techilla veachar kach lelea, shehi hayta akeret habbayit shebbishvilah nizdavveg yaakov im lavan, veaf baneha shel lea modim baddavar, shehare boaz uvet dino mishshevet yehuda omrim kerachel uchelea asher banu shetehem vegomer – hikdimu rachel lelea:
Dina. pershu rabbotenu sheddana lea din beatzmah, im ze zachar lo tehe rachel achoti keachat hashshefachot, vehitpallela alav venehpach linkeva (berachot 60):
Yegar sahaduta. targumo shel galed:
Galed. gal ed:
Yashku haadarim. mashkim haroim et haadarim, vehammikra dibber belashon ketzara:
ohc: Vehaeven gedola. perush hakkatuv yodia shehaeven gedola hi, veim haya omer "veeven gedola" lo haya hammashmaut shemmechavven hakkatuv lehaggid gedullatah, ella shemmaggid shehayta al pi habbeer even gedola lishlol ketanna, ma sheen ken meamro "vehaeven gedola" lo ba hakkatuv ella lehaggid hafelagat gedullatah, umechuvvan haddavar lehodia ezer elohi shebbechoach yaakov dichtiv "vayyagel et haeven", vedarshu zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 70:12) keadam hammaavir pekak meal pi tzelochit.

Lelea vitto shifcha. kashe lamma hutzrach lomar "lelea vitto" velo hispik bema sheamar besamuch "vayyitten lavan lah", umuvan haddavar ki al lea hu omer. ma tomar, sheen muvan – im ken lamma katav tevat "lah" mikkodem. od lamma amar "shifcha" velo amar "leshifcha".
