Achen yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha: zilpa uvilha naflu birushsha lerachel ulelea mikketubbat immam, vehu sheamar hakkatuv lelea vitto shifcha, perush, modia hakkatuv ki shellah hi shifcha veyarsha otah meimmah. velaze dikdek hakkatuv lomar vitto, lirmoz ki letzad shehayta bitto hi shekkanta shifcha zo mikketubbat immah, lo shehi kanta otah meemtzaut davar acher. ulederech ze yeduyyak gam ken amro vayyitten lavan, shello haya tzarich lehazekir shemo umuvan meamro "lelea bitto" ki belavan dibber hakkatuv, ella lomar shemmattana zo enah mattana kefi haemet ki shellah hayta mikkodem, ella lavan hu shemmachshivah begeder mattana, veze ramuz betevat "vitto".

rashi: Hamekushsharot. ketargumo habbakkirot, veen li ed bammikra; umenachem chibbero im achitofel bakkoshrim (Shmuel 2 15), vayhi hakkesher ammitz (sham), otan hammitkashsherot yachad lemaher ibburan:
ohc: Vehaya bechol yachem vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma yaase yaakov kacha? bishlama ma sheasa battechilla behatztzagat hammaklot haya letzad hahechreach, shezzulat ze haya yagea larik kemo shekkatavnu. lo chen achar shehayu batztzon akuddim unekuddim vegomer, lo haya lo littol hu hamekushsharot vechulei, shennimtza kefi ze hu notel yoter mechatzi revach, veeno min haddin, shekkol shello hitna im baal hatztzon, min hassetam en laroe littol ella shelish harevach, uchemo shekkatavnu beferush pasuk (Bereshit 29:15) "hachi achi atta", vechan en leyaakov lehatztzil meharammay ella davar shennogea lo baddin min hassetam, veroani ki notel yoter mechatzi.

Veulay ki tzon hamekushsharot lo hayu yoldot hakkol akuddim vegomer, ella al harov, vehaya lavan notel chelek echad bamkushsharot vechol chelek haatufim, vehaya maggia lechelko shene shelishim. vahagam sheamar hakkatuv "vehakkeshurim leyaakov", perush rov hakkeshurim, o shennitkavven lehatztzil shear gezelot shehaya ose lo.

rashi: Vehinne haattudim. aappi shehivdilam lavan kullam shello yitabberu hatztzon dugmatan, hayu hammalachim meviin otan meeder hammasur beyad bene lavan laeder shebbeyad yaakov (Bereshit Rabba):
Uveruddim. ketargumo ufatztzichin, payysheyr belaaz, chut shel lavan makkif et gufo saviv, chavarburot shello fetucha umefulleshet mizzo el zo; veen lehavi ed min hammikra:
Veal tikkachacha. veal tittol chachmatcha mimmecha beafappe eneha, shekkoretzet bahem, beafappeha:
targum: La terug shuferah belibbevach vela teshargeninach bigvinataha:

rashi: Kedabber efrayim retet. keshekkinne yaravam lammakom vedibber keneged shelomo devarim kashim uvirada (sanhedrin ka 2), shehare melech gadol haya shelomo:
Nasa hu beyisrael. mishsham zacha lehinnase lihyot melech yisrael (Melachim 1 12:20):
Vayyesham babbaal. kevan sheala ligdulla, vayyesham baavoda zara:

Vayyamot. nichrat bet yaravam (Melachim 1 14:10), vechen bet achav (Melachim 1 21:21). veyonatan tirgem: "kad memallel chad midvet efrayim retita achid lehon leammayya, mitravrevin havo beyisrael, vechaddu dechavu befulechan tauta mitkattelin":
targum: Kad memalel chad mibbet efrayim retita achid lehon leammaya mitravrevin havo veyisrael uchedu dechavu ad diflachu letaavata mitkatlin:

rashi: Vayyevk. lefi shetztzafa veruch hakkodesh sheenah nichneset immo likvura. davar acher lefi shebba beyadayim rekaniyyot; amar, eliezer eved avi abba hayu veyadav nezamim utzemidim umigdanot vaani en beyadi chelum; lefi sheradaf elifaz ben esav bemitzvat aviv acharav lehargo vehissigo, ulefi sheggadal elifaz becheko shel yitzchak, mashach yadav. amar lo ma eese latztziuuy shel abba? amar lo yaakov tol ma shebbeyadi, veheani chashuv kammet:
Vayyizbach yaakov zevach. shachat behemot lemishte:
Leechav. leohavav sheim lavan:
Leechol lechem. kol devar maachol karuy lechem, kemo avad lechem rav (Daniel Adonai), nashchita etz belachmo (Yirmeyahu 11):

Naftule elohim. menachem ben saruk persho bemachberet tzamid patil, chibburim meet hammakom nitchabbarti im achoti lizkot levanim. vaani mefarsho leshon ikkesh ufetaltol (Devarim 32) – nitakkashti vehiftzarti fetzirot venaftulim harebe lammakom, lihyot shava laachoti:
Gam yacholti. hiskim al yadi; veunkelos tirgem leshon tefilla, kemo naftule elohim nitpalti bakkashot hachavivot lefanav; nitkabbalti, veneetarti chaachoti:
Niftalti. nitkabbela tefillati, umia yesh rabbim bilshon notarikon:

ohc: Vayyar Adonai ki senua lea. yechavven lomar ki Adonai levaddo hu sheyyada vehikkir ki hi senua, lo chen hi, shello hirgisha besinatah, ella shehayta choshevet sheenah ahuva levad, kaasher avaer middevareha besamuch. verabbotenu zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 71:2) amru senua – shehayu omrim zo ishto shel sone shehu esav, dichtiv (Malachi 1:3) "veet esav saneti", vattikkare al shemo. uchefi ze im lo hayu lah banim hayu matzdikim haddevarim ki lo bat zugo shel yaakov, laze vayyiftach rachmah. veamro verachel akara perush: kule hay veulay yasir sinatah, shezzo enah yoledet vezo yoledet.

rashi: Od sheva shanim acherot. acherot hikkishan larishonot, ma rishonot beemuna af haacharonot beemuna, veaappi shebberammaut ba alav (Bereshit Rabba):
ohc: Vayyavo gam el rachel. taam amro gam shete peamim, veulay sheyyechavven lerabbot shebba betosefet keviut etzlah, vehu amram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 98:4) shehayta mittato bikviut etzel rachel, velaze amar vayyavo gam el rachel. veamro vayyeehav gam et rachel perush millevad tosefet haamur od hosif lah sheahavah yoter millea. vetimtza ki kefi hatteva hahatmada temaet haahava, uchemo sheamar hakkatuv (Mishlei 25:17) "pen yisbaacha useneecha", vehaharchaka tolid hattaava, vehu sod (Mishlei 9:17) "mayim genuvim yimtaku", velaze ramaz hakkatuv beamro vayyavo gam el rachel betosefet keviut, veaf al pi chen gam ahav otah velo nitmaata haahava mitztzad ze, haggam shehaya matmid etzlah velo etzel lea. veshiur tevat millea hu milleehov lea:

rashi: Veanta bi vegomer. im tachshedeni sheani notel mishshellecha kelum, taane vi tzidkati ki tavo tzidkati vetaid al sechari lefanecha, shello timtza veedri ki im nekuddim uteluim, vechol shettimtza vahen sheeno nakod o talu o chum, beyadua sheggenavtiv lecha uvigneva hu sharuy etzli:
Shuv el eretz avotecha. vesham ehye immach, aval beodcha mechubbar lattame i efshar lehasherot shechinati alecha (Bereshit Rabba):

Vayyetze yaakov. al yede shebbishvil sheraot benot kenaan beene yitzchak aviv halach esav el yishmael, hifsik hainyan befarashato shel yaakov, uchetiv vayyar esav ki verach vegomer, umishsheggamar chazar lainyan harishon:

Vayyetze. lo haya tzarich lichtov ella vayyelech yaakov charana, velamma hizkir yetziato? ella maggid sheyyetziat tzaddik min hammakom osa roshem, shebbizman shehatztzaddik bair, hu hodah hu zivah hu hadarah; yatza mishsham, pana hodah pana zivah pana hadarah. vechen vattetze min hammakom haamur benoomi verut (Rut 1):
Vayyelech charana. yatza lalechet lecharan:
ohc: Vayyetze yaakov vegomer. taam shello hispik behodaat halichato bapparasha hakkodemet dichtiv (Bereshit 28:7) "vayyishma yaakov vegomer vayyelech" vegomer, lehodia asher paga badderech kodem haggio limchoz cheftzo, uletzad shehifsik bainyan chazar lomar "vayyetze" vegomer. ella tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar vayyelech vegomer. uma gam sheppegiato bammakom hayta kodem haggio lecharan, velo haya lo lehakedim hameuchar. od lamma amar charana velo amar lecharan, vahagam sheamru zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 148) "kol teva" vechulei, im kol ze yechavven hakkatuv al davar beshannoto lifamim.

Achen hattora techavven lesadder kol ma sheavar al yaakov meet tzeto. veze techilla laddavar vayyetze yaakov vegomer, perush: lo asa ella yetzia velo hutzerach lalechet beraglav, vehaholech hu charana, vehu amro vayyelech charana, perush: charana hu shehalach mimmekomo lehakebil pene yaakov.
Od yirmoz lehodia ki kesheyyatza yaakov mibbeer sheva techef halach charono shel esav, vehu amro vayyelech charana.

Uledivrehem zichronam livracha sheshshalach esav elifaz acharav vechulei, yirtze beamro vayyelech charana lirmoz al halichat elifaz acharav becharon. veulay ki laze samach laddavar "vayyifga bammakom" lirmoz ki raa atzmo betzaar vehutzrach litfilla:

rashi: Kaasher yalda rachel et yosef. mishshennolad setano shel esav, shenneemar vehaya vet yaakov esh uvet yosef lehava uvet esav lekash (Ovadya 1), esh belo lehava eno sholet lemerachok, mishshennolad yosef batach yaakov behakkabba veratza lashuv:
Sachor secharticha. natatti lerachel secharah:
Ballayla hu. hakkabba siyyeo, sheyyatza mishsham yissashchar (Bereshit Rabba):
ohc: Vattetze lea vegomer. taam asotah kacha velo min hammusar, lefi ma shepperashti betevat "lachen" sheamra rachel shehu "al ken", chashsha lea shettachzor bah rachel velaze kadma veyatza. ulefi ma shepperashti "lachen" shevua, letzad shello dikdeka rachel lomar hallayla hazzot, chashsha shettidche otah lelayla acheret, vahare zo zeriza veniskeret.

Od yesh latet taam lelea, ki middat chasidut asta shello hinnicha ad sheyyikkanes oto tzaddik leohel rachel vetotziennu mishsham, ki yesh baze hakepada vetzaar gadol lerachel vekina gedola. laze kadma kodem sheyyikkanes etzlah, veen ze ella midda tova vachasida, vechol megammatah shel otah tzaddeket lehaamid nite naaman. vaAdonai ed baddavar ki natan secharah dichtiv "vayyishma" vegomer (Bereshit 30:17), veayyen besamuch ma shepperashti (sefarim acherim shapeyresh Rashi) befasuk ze.
Sachor secharticha vegomer. perush: natatti sachar lazzulat baadcha. od nitkavvena shessachra shene devarim: lina vezika.
Ballayla hu. perush birtzono vedato shehiskim al haddavar.

rashi: Ki vead ishsha zona ad kikkar lachem. lide aniyyut vechoser kol tov:
Nefesh yekara tatzud. nefesh shehayta yekara kodem lachen, baa vetzada legehinnom (sota 4:):
targum: Metul dedamya milta dezanyata hech geritzta delachma veittat gavra nafsha yakirta tzayda:

rashi: Hannotarot. haruot shebbahen, hacholot vehaakarot sheenan ella shirayim, otan masar lo:
Mittov ad ra. kol tovatan shel reshaim raa hi etzel hatztzaddikim (yevamot 103):

Ki im bet elohim. ara elazar beshem rabbi yose ben zimra, hassullam hazze omed biver sheva veemtza shippuo maggia keneged bet hammikdash, shebbeer sheva omed bidromah shel yehuda, virushalayim bitzfonah, baggevul shebben yehuda uvinyamin, uvet el haya batztzafon shel nachalat binyamin, baggevul shebben binyamin uven bene yosef; nimtza sullam sheraglav biver sheva verosho bevet el maggia emtza shippuo neged yerushalayim; uchelappe sheamru rabbotenu sheamar hakkabba tzaddik ze ba levet meloni veyippater belo lina, veamru yaakov keraah lirushalayim bet el vezo luz hi velo yerushalayim, umehechan lamdu lomar ken? ani omer shenneekar har hammoriya uva lechan, vezo hi kefitzat haaretz haamura bishchitat chullin, shebba bet hammikdash likrato ad bet el, vezehu vayyifga bammakom. veim tomar kesheavar yaakov al bet hammikdash, maddua lo ikkevo sham? ihu la yehav libbeh lehitpallel bammakom shehitpallelu avotav, umin hashshamayim yeakkevuhu? ihu ad charan azal, kidamrinan beferek gid hannashe; ukera mochiach vayyelech charana; ki meta lecharan amar, efshar sheavarti al makom shehitpallelu avotay velo hitpallalti bo? yehav dateh lemehedar vechazar ad bet el vekaftza lo haaretz. hay bet el lo hassamuch laay ella lirushalayim, veal shem yihye bet elohim kerao bet el, vehu har hammoriya shehitpallel bo avraham, vehu sade shehitpallel bo yitzchak, kedichtiv lasuach bassade; dehachi amrinan bifsachim "el har 4 veel bet elohe yaakov" – may shena yaakov? ella lo keavraham shekkerao har, dichtiv behar 4 yerae, velo keyitzchak shekkerao sade, dichtiv lasuach bassade, ella keyaakov shekkerao bayit (ad kan perashi meduyyak):
Ma nora. targum ma dechilu atra haden, dechilu shem davar hu, kemo sucheltanu uchesu lemilbash:
Veze shaar hashshamayim. mekom tefilla laalot tefillatam hashshamayma. umidrasho, shebbet hammikdash shel mala mechuvvan keneged bet hammikdash shel matta:
ohc: Vayyira vayyomar vegomer. perush: hirgish belibbo shehaya yare meatzmo, veamar kamma mora bammakom hazze, venatan taam beamro en ze ki im bet elohim, dikdek lomar shem elohim ki hu mekor hammora, dichtiv (Kohelet 3:14) "vehaelohim asa sheyyiru" vegomer, vedavar yadua ki shem elohim yafchid levav enosh.
Veamro veze shaar vegomer, perush: makom hamechuvvan kenegdo lemala hu shaar hashshamayim, velaze amar paam sheniyya "veze".

Od nitkavven latet taam lemaalat hammakom shennishtanna lemala "en ze ki im bet elohim" asher kadma elav hayyedia ki bachar lo yah bayit lishkon shamma, veamar ki hu ze hammakom. vehochiach od ki hu ze bet habbechira, keamro "veze shaar hashshamayim", ki raa shehayu malachim olim veyordim, vekadma hayedia etzlo ki hammakom hammekuddash hu mechuvvan keneged shaar hashshamayim.

rashi: Babbeten akav et achiv. kol ze asiti lo, achazo beakevo siman shehu yihye lo gevir (Bereshit 27:29):
targum: Neviya emar lehon hala yaakov ad dela ityelid amir deyisge min achuhi uvetukefeh itravrav im malacha:

rashi: Vayyifgeu vo malache elohim. malachim shel eretz yisrael bau likrato lelauoto laaretz:
ohc: Vayyifgeu vo malache vegomer. tzarich ladaat kavvanat amro vayyifgeu vo. gam amro vayyomer yaakov vegomer ma chiddush modia hakkatuv sheamar yaakov ken. gam yaakov ma chiddesh bidvarav. gam en yadua kavvanat amro machanayim. verabbotenu zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 74:17) darshu, yeuyyan sham divrehem shehu derash.

Ufeshat hakkatuv hu, leheyot ki shalach Adonai malachim bidmut anashim lehiddamot lifne esav kaasher hochiach sof hammaase, laze hikdim lehodia hammaase shemmimmennu hirgish yaakov heyotam malachim, veamar shello ba hammachane kederech haanashim shekkodem yihyu nirim haloch vekarev ad sheyyaggiu etzel habbaim etzlo, ella techef umiyyad tzamchu lefanav, vehu amro vayyifgeu vo perush reiyya rishona hayta happegia bo etzlo, "vayyomer yaakov kaasher raam" bederech ze, "machane elohim", en elle anashim ella malachim, "vayyikra shem hammakom machanayim" perush shete machanot, echad shel anashav shehayu immo laaroch milchama vehashsheni shel malachim bidmut anashim ki bau leezrat Adonai lidido yaakov bechir Adonai.
Chassalat parashat vayyetze

rashi: Atta. bet yehu sherau kol zot yosifu lachato:
Kitvunam. ketavnitam:

Zovche adam agalim yishshakun. komre hammolech omrim leyisrael mi shezzoveach beno laavoda zara, keday hu lihyot noshek haegel, shehare doron chaviv hikriv lo. kach pershu rabbotenu besanhedrin (sanhedrin 63, 2). umeyushshav hu al leshon hammikra yoter mittargum shel yonatan:
targum: Uchean mosifin lemechete vaavadu lehon mattecha mikkaspehon kidmutehon tzalmanin oved umanin kulehon lehon inun matan neviye shikra davchin leovad yede enasha toraya leeglaya nachsin:

rashi: Lishmarcha meeshet ra. hattora tishmarcha meishsha shel minhag ra. veal karchacha lo dibber shelomo ishsha raa, ella keneged avodat gillulim shehi shekula keneged hakkol. sheim tomar: ishsha zona mammash, vechi kol secharah veshivchah shel tora sheshshomeret min hazzona levaddah?! ella al karchacha zo avodat gillulim, shehi chamura keneged hakkol:
Mechelkat lashon. mittechot enayim shel lashon nachriyya:
targum: Detinterach min itteta vishta umin sheiuta delishana denuchereta:

rashi: Makkal livne. etz hu, ushemo livne, kema detema tachat allon velivne (Hoshea 4), veomer ani hu shekkorin 302 belaaz, shehu lavan:
Lach. keshehu ratov:
Luz. veod lakach makkal luz, etz sheggedelin bo egozim dakkim, 156 belaaz:
Vearmon. kashetaneyyr belaaz:
Petzalot. killufim killufim, shehaya osehu menummar:
Macheshavef hallavan. gilluy loven shel makkel, keshehaya kolfo haya nire venigle loven shello bammakom hakkaluf:

Uvehaatif. leshon ichur, ketargumo uvelakkishut. umenachem chibbero im hammachalatzot vehammaatafot (Yeshayahu 3), leshon atifat kesut, kelomar mitattefot beoran vetzamran veenan mitauot lehityachem ay hazzecharim:
Vayyiggash yaakov vayyagel. kemi shemmaavir et happekak meal pi tzelochit; lehodiacha shekkocho gadol (Bereshit Rabba):
ohc: Vayhi kaasher vegomer. taam amro shalosh peamim achi immo lelo tzorech, lomar shekkol maasav hayu letzad heyoto achi immo velichvod immo. o letzad hachashad sheyyiruhu ose chesed im rachel vehu ish nachri, laze haya motzi mippiv taam haddavar: biroto rachel amar "bat lavan achi immo", hatztzon shel lavan achi immo, uveet hahashkaa gam ken, shebbaze hesir mealav chashad davar. uveet shennashak lo amar ki kevar amar, veod, bichyo yaggid alav ki achim hayu.

Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (avoda zara 26:) haummot lo maalin velo moridin, laze amar vayyashk et tzon lavan, vetaam (Mishlei 14:34) chesed leummim, letzad heyotam achi immo bishvil kevod immo hishka.

rashi: Et echav. kerovav:

Derech shivat yamim. kol otan 3 yamim shehalach hammaggid lehaggid lelavan halach yaakov ledarko, nimtza, yaakov rachok millavan shishsha yamim, uvashshevii hissigo lavan. lamadnu shekkol ma shehalach yaakov beshiva yamim halach lavan beyom echad (shenneemar vayyirdof acharav derech shivat yamim, velo neemar vayirdof acharav shivat yamim):
ohc: Derech shivat yamim. yesh lachkor lamma nishtanna yaakov bahalicha zo shello kaftza lo haaretz kemishpat leohave shemo, umatzinu sheafillu leeliezer eved aviv kaftza lo haaretz (Bereshit Rabba 59,11), umin hannachon elav yeot asot gam lehatztzilo meharodef velo haya massigo lavan. veulay ki higgid lo haadon baruch hu baze sheen tzarich livroach, ki hagam shehidbiko lavan hayuchal dabber davar elav afillu dibbur, vezulat ze haya mare chas veshalom ki lo yachol hatztzilo miyyad lavan, vegadol hannes hazze shehagam shehu baal bechira yimmana measot bechirato beyaakov.

Gam baze Adonai sibbev kamma sibbuvin keritat berit immo leval yazzik, shebbeemtzaut haddavar nitgabberu alav yisrael bime hashshoftim keshebba alehem vehu kushan rishatayim kemaamaram zichronam livracha (sanhedrin 105.). gam mizze nimshach kevurat rachel bammakom hahu kede shettihye letova ot begalut baneha, keamram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 21) betaam kevuratah shamma:

rashi: Benotay, benotay. shete feamim, af bilha vezilpa benotav hayu mippilegesh:
Im teanne et benotay. limno mehen onat tashmish (yoma 77):

Hen od hayyom gadol. lefi sheraa otam rovtzim, kassavur sherotzim leesof hammikne habbayta velo yiru od, amar lahen hen od hayyom gadol, kelomar im sechirim attem lo shillamtem peullat hayyom, veim habbehemot shellachem aappi chen lo et heasef hammikne vegomer (Bereshit Rabba):
ohc: Vayyomer hen od vegomer. taamo asher naasa shofet lahem, hu letzad tzaar baale chayyim devar tora (bava metzia lev:) vechash al hatztzon. veod ratza ladaat im taam akkavatam hi letzad sheen zeman lehashekot hatztzon velirot ki hair rechoka hi vehatztzon baytot henna, vedavar ze nogea lo ladaat derech ba vo, umitteshuvatam yada ki lo lesibbat richuk hair hem osim.

rashi: Dananni elohim. dananni vechiyyevani vezikkani (Bereshit Rabba):
Vayyasar. lavan bayyom hahu:
Et hatteyashim. izzim zecharim:
Kol asher lavan bo. kol asher hayta vo chavarburit levana:
Vayyitten. lavan beyad banav:
Terefa. al yede ari uzeev:
Anochi achattenna. leshon kolea baeven el hassaara velo yachati (Shoftim 20), ani uveni shelomo chattaim (Melachim 1 1) – chaserim, anochi achserenna, im chasra chasra li, shemmiyyadi tevakshenna:
(Anochi achattenna targumo dahavat shagya mimminyana, shehayta nifkedet umechusseret, kemo velo nifkad mimmennu ish 0, targumo la shega):
Genuvti yom ugenuvti layla. genuvat yom o genuvat layla, hakkol shillamti:
Genuvti. kemo rabbati vaggoyim sarati bammedinot (Eicha 1), meleati mishpat (Yeshayahu 1) ohavti ladush (Hoshea 10):
ohc: Terefa lo vegomer. kashe ech yutzdak lomar bedavar shennitraf leshon havaa? od lamma kafal lomar anochi achattenna miyyadi tevakshenna im hu haya meshallemah, ma makom levakkeshah miyyado?

Achen kavvanat yaakov hi lomar, ben davar shehu chayyav bo kefi haddin ben davar shehu patur lakach mimmennu lavan, vedikdek lomar "terefa" keneged zeev, vedikdek lomar "lo heveti" keneged derusat ari, uchemo chen timtza bilshon chachamim bemassechet metzia (bava metzia 93.) veze leshonam: tanu rabbanan: shomer shehinniach edro uva lair, uva ari vedaras zeev vetaraf, ad kan, amru leshon terefa bizev ki toref uvoreach letzad shemmefached, ma sheen ken haari shebbimkom shemmotzah dorsah sham veochlah umanniach sham or uferesh. uchemo chen ramaz yaakov shene inyanim beamro "terefa" keneged zeev, "lo heveti" keneged ari shemmanniach or uferesh shemmanniach bidrisa. veamar anochi achattenna keneged gader shehu chayyav bo, shehu terefat zeev, kegon zeev echad sheeno ones vechayyav shomer sachar (bava metzia av.). veamar miyyadi tevakshenna keneged gader sheni shehu derusat ari, sheen chiyyuv al yaakov leshallem shehu ones ufatur, ella sheharasha haya mitallem alav umevakkesh gam et zot miyyaakov. uchefi ze nizreka ruach hakkodesh bedivre Rashi zichrono livracha shekkatav veze leshono: terefa vechulei al yede ari uzeev, ad kan, vichavven lidvarenu venachon.

Veamro genuvti yom vegomer, nitkavven gam ken beinyan nizke bene adam, shehaya meshallem ben ma shehu chayyav hashshomer sachar ben ma sheeno chayyav, vehu amro genuvti yom ugenuvti layla, perush genuvti – haggeneva li hayta maggaat gam betzad happetur.
Vayyomer lavan lo yease chen vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma maane bilshono "lo yease" vegomer, vahalo tenay haya haddavar "eevadcha berachel", uma inyan hamminhag lechan bedavar shehaya tenay gamur?
Achen nitkavven lomar ki anshe hammakom michu beyado measot kaddavar hazze, vehu amro lo yease chen bimkomenu ki hi taanat rabbim.

Od nire ki taanato hi ki lo haya beferush bishat hattenay shehagam shello tinnase lea yitten lo rachel, uvaze en setira lamminhag mehattenay, ki leolam takdim lea lehinnase, uvimlot sheva shanim sheyyaavod yaakov, im kadma lea venisset – techef umiyyad yikkach rachel, veim lav yihye yoshev umetzappe ad shettakdim habbechira kemishpete haaretz, ki en battenay davar maggid shehitnu levattel hamminhag. umeatta kesheshshaalta "hava et ishti", chashavti sheal lea atta omer, ki hamminhag minhag yadua hu sheen latet hatztzeira kodem, umin hassetam al lea amarta, veen baze rammaut, ulecha haya mutal ladaat ki hi lea mibbeli tzorech hodaa, uvaze bittel taanat "rimmitani". uletzad shettachshov ki yesh hefresh benehem, lo chen hu, ki shekulim hem etzli velo eshal bead rachel ki im sheva shanim. veim letzad cheshkecha berachel vetakpid al haakkava, hinne hi netuna lecha techef umiyyad achar avor shivat yeme mishte shel lea, vehu amro malle shevua zot, perush shivat yeme mishte, vetechef etten lecha rachel bammukdam bead avoda shettaavod od sheva shanim, veze haya mevukkasho shel yaakov shekkibbel alav lo lehachezir lea chas veshalom.

Veyesh lanu ladaat ech lo chash yaakov mikkodem letaana zo sheen derech latet hatztzeira vechulei? yesh lomar shechashav sheal lavan legallot lo haddavar, vezulat ze en davar ze mehahakpada hameakkevet kesheyyirtze haav latet hatztzeira. uchesheshshaal "hava et ishti" min hassetam al rachel hu omer, vehaya lo lelavan lomar elav ki lo yachol latet lo rachel kodem shettinnase lea, vehaya haddavar taluy beyad yaakov: o lehametin ad shettinnase lea o lakachat lea. veen ze ella min hashshem "lavan haarammi", vechol taanotav shekkatavti yesh alehem setira ushemo yaggid alav.

Odennu medabber immam. hinne lefi seder hakkatuv hem hamedabberim elav, vehaya lo lomar "odam medabberim immo" ki achar teshuvatam baa. veulay ki letzad sheikkar sippur hainyan hiv hodaat haover al yaakov, laze tala haddavar beikkaro shehu yaakov.

O yechavven hakkatuv lomar shebbiat rachel hayta beod shehu medabber immam, kodem sheyyashivu oto davar baa, ella shehakkatuv gamar omer ma sheheshivuhu bitshuvatam, veachar kach hodia biatah, verasham zemanno ki hiv beet shehaya hiv medabber immam.
Im hatztzon asher leaviha. perush, kol hatztzon shehayu lo, hare ze edut leyaakov sheamar (Bereshit 30:30) "ki meat asher haya lecha lefanay" vegomer, ki bat ketanna noheget bam.
O yomar shekkol hatztzon hayta maspeket hi lahem, ki roa hi perush: bekia biriyyat hatztzon. uleferush rishon amro ki roa hi perush, veaf al pi chen hayu muat, vezulat ze safu tammu.
O yomar ki roa hi – nichesh nechashav vehiskil ki yatzlichu hatztzon biriyyatah, vezulat ze lo haya mezalzel bevitto yefat toar vifat mare lirot tzon.
Od yirtze al ze hadderech: verachel baa – velo tomar ki chas veshalom yatzanit hayta, ella letaam ki hi roa otam, velaze yatzta im hatztzon:

rashi: Achalani chorev. leshon esh ochla:
Vekerach. kemo mashlich karcho (Tehillim 147), targumo gelida:
Shenati. leshon shena:
Lo ashuv. middivre hattov asher amarti (Vayikra 26:44) "lo meastim velo gealtim" lihyot mashchit et efrayim:
Ki el anochi. hamekayyem devar tovati, veen middati lehinnachem al hattov:

Bekirbecha kadosh velo avo beir. acheret, kevar hivtachti lehasherot shechinati bekirbecha birushalayim, velo ashre otah od al ir acheret. veyesh mefaresh beir leshon 'sina, kemo (Shmuel 1 28:16) "vayhi arecha":
targum: La ebed tekof rugezi vela yatuv memri lechabbala bet yisrael are elaha ana memri lealma kayam velet ovade keovade bisra dedayrin al ara ken gezarit bememri devenechon shechinti kadisha vela achalef bekirva ochare od yerushelem:

rashi: Mikne kinyano. ma shekkana mitztzono, avadim ushefachot ugemallim vachamorim:
Baa im hatztzon. hattaam beAlef vetargumo atya; verachel baa – hattaam lemala babbet vetargumo atat; harishon leshon osa vehashsheni leshon asta:
ohc: Vayyomer lahem hashalom lo vegomer vehinne rachel vegomer. taam shello amru shalom lo kilshon hashsheela, leheyot sheyyesh bemashmaut divre yaakov shene devarim: echad, hu im shalem begufo uvemamono. vesheni, im hem shelemim immo. uferush devarav hashalom attem elav, velaze nitchakkemu veamru shalom, perush lechol ma sheatta shoel shalom. vetaam amram vehinne rachel teshuva lema shello shaal, ulay shello lehaarich immahem bishelot amru hinne rachel bitto velah tishal.
Od yechavvenu lomar ki letzad shelomo immahem, shehu sholeach bat ketanna im hatztzon, ma shello haya beyitro shehaya sholeach sheva benotav, veaf al pi chen hayu haroim megarshim otam (Shemot 2:17).

Od nitkavvenu lomar lo shalom, perush: lema shennogea legufo ulematztzavo immanu shalom, uchede shello yavin shertzonam lomar ki hu beosher uvinchasim, gamru omer vehinne rachel vegomer, umimmotza davar yeda ki lo amid binchasim hu ki tzarich levitto lirot, vegam shemmaspeket bat achat lirot tzono ki meat hem. vechavvanatam bedikduk haddevarim hi kede shello yotziu mippihem devar sheker bedavar sheatid lehitgallot. o shechashshu sheyyomar lahem lavan lamma hotziu alav kol osher, umittaam atzmo sheamar hakkatuv (Mishlei 27:14) "mevarech reehu bekol gadol" vegomer shello yitarchu etzlo harebe veyaani.
O efshar shekkavvanatam lehodia leyaakov ki lavan kilay hu bemamono, umezalzel beatzmo shettire lo tzono bitto hayyekara, umizze yakkish ladaat et haish umaasehu.

rashi: Veyochichu. vivarru im mi haddin, 499 belaaz:
ohc: Mishshashta et kol vegomer. perush, afillu kelim sheen bahem mechush terafim, kemo shettomar kelim shehem ketannim mehatterafim, o hammashal shehaya mechappes bichrichot sheyyachol lehakkir mibbachutz sheen bahem terafim, ha lamadta shechashado bilkichat kelim.
Ma matzata mikkol vegomer. perush, mikkol mine kele vetcha bedomim sheyyikkanes lecha bo hassafek lomar ki hu shellecha.

Sim ko neged vegomer. hakkavvana baze leheyot shemmikkodem keshettaan shebba levakkesh hatterafim amar elav "hakker lecha ma immadi vekach lach", lechashvo ki en mevukkasho ella terafav, uchesheraahu shehaya mechappes umedakdek bechol davar vedavar, amar: ha vadday shezze choshdeni, uchemo shekkatavti lemala, vechol happosel bemumo hu posel, vehinne hu noten enav lavo baalila. laze amar elav: sim ko neged achay veachecha veyochichu, perush, lemor simanim yatzdiku, velo heemin baache lavan levaddam ki chullam kayyotze vo.

rashi: Matzati on li. on – koach. umidrash aggada haya doresh rabbi shimon 127: "matzati on li" – matzati li shetar chov sheyyesh li malchut al yisrael, "vayyelchu gam echav vayyippelu vegomer hinnennu lecha laavadim" (Bereshit 50:18). "on li" – dine shetar, kemo "kotvin alav ono", uchemo "beoni echad uvetimi achat" bivreshit rabba (Bereshit Rabba 2 2). veze perusho: "vayyomer efrayim ach asharti matzati on li" – yaravam ben nevat shehaya mishshevet efrayim mitpaer beatzmo veomer: "ach asharti, matzati on li" – shetar echad shekkol yisrael avadim li, sheavi kana otam, dichtiv: "vayyelchu gam echav vayyippelu lefanav vayyomru hinnennu lecha laavadim", uma shekkana eved kana rabbo, vechol mamonam shelli. lefichach en bi chet im ettol kol asher lahem ki hem avday. ma ketiv acharav? "veanochi Adonai elohecha meeretz mitzrayim" (Shemot 20:2) – gedulla habbaa leavicha bemitzrayim meitti hayta. amar hakkadosh baruch hu: "hinnennu lecha laavadim" lo shachachta, aval "anochi Adonai elohecha" shenneemar baaseret haddibberot shachachta, sheheemadta shene agalim, echad bevet el veechad bedan. uleinyan peshuto shel mikra, atta omer "matzati on li" al yede oshek umozne mirma. "veanochi Adonai elohecha meeretz mitzrayim" – sham hivchanti ben tippa shel bechor letippa sheenah shel bechor, af ani hayyodea venifra mimmozne mirma haasuyin mibbeli havin umehattomen mishkelotav bemelach kede lerammot.

Kol yegiay lo yimtzeu li. tov lecha im amarta belibbecha: "kol mamoni lo yehe bo sippuk lechapper al avoni asher chatati". ken tirgem yonatan "navi amar lehon kol uterechon la yitkayyem lechon beyom tushelamat chovechon":

Lo yimtzeu. lo yaspiku, kemo (Bamidbar 11:22) "umatza lahem". velo yittachen lefaresh kol yegiay – kol hayegeim levakkesh avoni velo yimtzeu li avon, sheim ken haya rauy lichtov kol yagea belo yod velinkod betzere, aval atta eno leshon 'yagea ella leshon 'yegia:
targum: Vaamaru devet efrayim beram atarna ashkachna onas lana neviya emar lehon kol otarchon la yitkayem lechon keyom tushelmat chovechon:

ohc: Haattudim vegomer akuddim nekuddim uveruddim. tzarich ladaat ma hu perush beruddim, velu yihye sheyyihye min mimmin hannoladim batztzon, kevan sheen leyaakov chelek bo ki lo huzekar battenaim, im ken lamma yaruhu oto bachalom?

Veraiti leharav rabbi ibben ezra shekkatav ki berudim hem teluim, velo hevi harav hechreach laddavar. od, lefi ma sheamar "im ko yomar" vegomer (Bereshit 31:8), hareta ladaat ki lo haya notel yaakov ella o akuddim o nekuddim, umeatta lamma hayu olim al hatztzon minim sheenam lechelek yaakov?

Achen taam haddavar hu letzad ma shekkadam lanu bidiat lavan harammay, ki millevad tachbulotav umirmav gam hayu lo terafim asher yaggidu lo kol davar, uchemaamaram zichronam livracha (tanchuma), umin hassetam shaol yishal bahem veyeda haatzamim beveten hammelea umarehen. umeatta beemtzaut davar ze afsu kochot yaakov bechol min asher yitchakkem yafsiduhu hatterafim, asher al ken haone batztzar anahu. veyesh lecha ladaat ki min mare asher yihye bannoladim yithavve beet yachem veen metziut lehafcho achar kach zulat al yede nes atzum lehappech hatteva hippuch atzum, vedavar ze kashe beene el elyon laasoto. vetze ulemad middivrehem zichronam livracha bechamma mekomot (sota 2., shabbat 23.), veasa Adonai chachma shello lehitztarech lehappech seder teva habberia, vehu shehayu olim shelosha minim yachad vehaya bechol nolad venolad bechoach hahiyyuli mutbaim shelashtam yachad, uvaze safu tammu yediot hatterafim. veim yetziat hannoladim haya nigle bahem min asher yaskimu yachad ki hu ze chelek yaakov. velo yarchik datecha haddavar, ki yesh ofot sheyyahafchu gevanehem lechamma marot veze hu letzad shehitbia Adonai bahem ken, uchemo chen asa Adonai bannoladim betzon lavan lehatztzil ashuk miyyad oshek. veamro beruddim lefi ma shepperashnu matzinu reaya ledivre rabbi avraham ben ezra ki hu min talu, ki zulat ze dilma yomar lavan talu yihye secharcha, venimtza hannes levattala chas veshalom, ella vadday ki beruddim hu min talu. veulay letzad shelloven shello lavan harebe kabbarad nikra chen. umeatta nityashshev hakkatuv al nachon.

Ki raiti et kol asher lavan vegomer. hammalach higgid taam hannes, ki raa Adonai kol maasav vearmutav shel lavan, uma shehaya mitchakkem veshoel bitrafav, velo haya metziut lehatztzilo mimmennu zulat maase asher herahu olim al hatztzon, uchemo shepperashnu.

Gam ramaz lo ki chol maase shel lavan elav hem netunim, velaze lo amar "kol asher ose lecha lavan" lirmoz gam ken ki chol hannoladim yihyu lechelek yaakov, veen baze mishshum gezel ki Adonai shofet tzedek veyada kol asher rimmahu veonahu, vehotzi mizze venatan laze, vehu yishpot betzedek.
Lah leshifcha. dikdek lomar tevat lah, lomar shellah hi hashshifcha, uchemo shepperashti befasuk (Bereshit 29:24) "vayyitten lavan et zilpa".

O yirtze shehitna immah sheen zechut levalah bah, al derech ma shekkatav rambam (hilchot ishut 22) hannoten mattana leishsha al menat sheen levalah zechut bah en habbaal ochel perot, ki chol ma sheyyesh lidrosh belavan lignay darshinan.

rashi: Im yihye elohim immadi. im yishmor li havetachot hallalu shehivtichani lihyot immadi, kemo sheamar li vehinne anochi immach:
Ushemarani. kemo sheamar li ushemarticha bechol asher telech:
Venatan li lechem leechol. kemo sheamar ki lo eezavcha, vehamevakkesh lechem hu karuy neezav, shenneemar velo raiti tzaddik neezav vezaro mevakkesh lachem (Tehillim 37):
ohc: Vayyiddar yaakov neder lemor. perush shehotzi hanneder bisfatav, ki zulat ze neder ballev eno neder.

Im yihye vegomer. "im" ze titparesh al derech ma sheamru zichronam livracha (bava kamma perek 4 mishna Adonai) bappesukim (Shemot 21:30) "im kofer", "im kesef talve" (Shemot 22:24), sheeno safek ella vadday, ucheillu amar "kaasher yihye ze" vegomer (mechilta sof parashat yitro).

Od yirtze al ze hadderech, im taskim middat haddin al haddavar, vehu amro im yihye elohim, ki lo dibber elav ella mimmiddat harachamim, dichtiv "vehinne Adonai nitztzav vegomer hinne anochi immach", vedavar yadua ki middat harachamim taskim lehetiv umiddat haddin teakkev baddavar, laze amar "im yihye elohim" vegomer:

rashi: Malle shevua zot. davuk hu, shehare nakud bachataf, shavua shel zot, vehen shivat yeme hammishte, betalmud yerush bemoed katan (veie lomar shavua mammash, sheim ken haya tzarich lehinnaked befattach hashshin; veod sheshshavua leshon zachar, kedichtiv shiva shavuot tispar lach, lefichach en mashma shavua ella shiva, shateyynaa belaaz):
Venittena lecha. leshon rabbim, kemo nerda venavla venisrefa (Bereshit 11), af ze leshon venitten:
Gam et zot. miyyad leachar shivat yeme hammishte, vetaavod leachar nissueha:
Ligzoz et tzono. shennatan beyad banav derech sheloshet yamim beno uven yaakov:
Vattignov rachel et hatterafim. lehaferish et aviha meaza nitkavvena (Bereshit Rabba):
Yesh leel yadi. yesh koach vechayil beyadi laasot immachem ra, vechol el shehu l kodesh al shem izzuz verov onim hu:
Lo shikkelu. lo hippilu ibburam, kemo rechem mashkil (Hoshea 9), tefallet parato velo teshakkel (Iyov 21):
Veele tzoncha. mikkan amru ayil ben yomo karuy ayil, sheim lo chen, ma shivcho? elim lo achal, aval kevasim achal, im ken gazlan hu (bava kamma 65):
ohc: Ze esrim vegomer. taam amro esrim shana, ki letzad zeman muat yishtammer haggannav veharammay measot ra, aval lo leorech hazzeman, laze amar ze esrim shana vechullam shavim letova. vedavar ze en lakachat mimmennu hochacha im haya yaakov im adam bilti margish berammaut, laze amar immach – haraita bi miyyamecha avel, vehochiach hochachot mochichot kaasher avaer besiyyata dishmayya:

Rechelecha veizzecha vegomer. tzarich ladaat kavvanat yaakov baze, im lomar perate hahatzlacha – en ze mekoman shel devarim ellu. gam amro veele tzoncha vegomer mi yannichehu leachlan, veim lo yada adam vead atta mi yaid al haddavar?

Achen kavvanat yaakov hi leheyot ki derech roe gannav yitchakkem lignov beamro ki lo kol hatztzon yaldu, mehem yaldu umehem shikkelu, velokchim leatzmam. umeatta hochacha gedola amro yaakov rechelecha veizzecha lo shikkelu, uvaze en makom lachashad sheachalti vechulei, sheim haya chafetz leechol mishshello haya lo makom lomar lo kach vechach shikkelu mehatztzon. ume haya haddavar lishmor chasido mechashad, velo shikkela achat mitztzono kede shello yachshedennu sheachalo.

Vetaam amro ele tzoncha, hattora hotzia gedi bilshon ayil lilmod mikkan gedi ben yomo karuy ayil. veulay yechavven al pi ma shekkatav harambam behilchot gezela (hilchot gezela vaabaydah 2:14) veze leshono: haggozel tale venaasa ayil vechulei have shinnuy beyado ukenao af al pi shello nityaashu habbealim, ad kan. laze nitkavven lomar sheafillu bederech sheen yachol lehotzio miyyado kefi haddin lo asa, perush shello gazal mimmennu gedi vegadal etzlo venaasa ayil, ucheshehechzir lo hechzir gedi, venimtza achal ma sheggadal venaasa ayil.

rashi: Behithallechcha. bechayyecha:
Tanche otach. kemo tanhigcha:
Beshachbecha. bakkever:
Vehakitzota hi tesichecha. litchiyyat hammetim, laamod baddin:
Hi tesichecha. talitz baadecha (tanchuma, vayyetze 2):
targum: Bemezlach titdabber imach bemadmechach titneter alach vetitar hi teheve ratzyach:

rashi: Kishvuyot charev. kol chayil habba lammilchama karuy cherev:
Veanochi lo yadati. sheim yadati, lo yashanti bemakom kadosh kaze:
ohc: Vayyikatz vegomer achen vegomer veanochi vegomer. tzarich ladaat kavvanat amro achen, shennire ki nitgalla lo hannelam. od ma temiha zo veanochi lo yadati shennire shetztzarich hu ladaat kol nistar?

Veyitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (chullin tze:) "ki va hashshemesh" – shaka lo shello beonatah lishkav sham bevet malon hameushshar, veyaakov lo hirgish taam haarev shemesh shello bizmanno. laze keshebba hachalom berov inyan, az hukkar lo hannistar taam haarev shemesh, vehu amro "achen yesh Adonai" vegomer, velaze heeriv hashshemesh letzorech shechiva bammakom hazze.

Veamro yesh Adonai perush sham hu makom shebbo Adonai matzuy tamid yoter mikkol hammekomot, vaasher laze ratza Adonai ledabber itto sham midde avro shamma, veamar "veanochi lo yadati" kodem taam haddavar, ki im haya yodea haya mechin atzmo lannevua, ki hannevua tzericha hachana kayyadua. veefshar im haya mechin atzmo haya mitnabbe behakitz velo bachalom yedabber bo, velaze mitonen al ma shello hiskil al davar. verashi zichrono livracha peresh: veim yadati lo yashanti bemakom kadosh, ad kan. veim laze levad nitkavven nomar elav veim lo yashanta lo hayita cholem chalom nevui bechol hahavtachot, uvehechreach lehashelim hakkavvana bema shepperashti.

rashi: Vehaya leed. hakkabba:
Ki achi aviha hu. karov leaviha, kemo anashim achim anachnu. umidrasho, im lerammaut hu va, gam ani achiv berammaut, veim adam kasher hu, gam ani ven rivka achoto hakkeshera:
Vattagged leaviha. lefi sheimmah meta, velo haya lah lehaggid ella lo (Bereshit Rabba):
ohc: Vayyagged yaakov vegomer. perush: higgid lah shete bechinot hakkureva shehayu lerachel, achat kurevat hagguf, vehu amro ki achi aviha hu, vehashsheniyya kurevat hannefesh, vehu amro vechi ven rivka hu, vidua rivka betzidkoteha, vehatztzaddikim yismechu baddome.

Od yirmoz al derech amram zichronam livracha (Megila 13:) sheamra lo aviha rammay, vehu heshiv ki achiv hu berammaut. uchefi ze chash yaakov ki tomar alav, genay hu haddavar sheyyitnaheg tzaddik im rasha kerishato, laze amar vechi ven rivka, perush sheyyitchakkem alav bederech tzedek veemet lehotzi balo mippiv ulenatztzecho bemishpatav, vehu sod (Kohelet 7:12-13) "hachachma techayye vealeha" velo yerammehu bederech resha umius asher yikkalem baasoto kacha.
Im ko yomar. vahagam shettenay harishon haya sheyyittol nekuddim uteluim, lo amad baddavar ella achat mehenna hiskim latet lo.

Od taam haddavar hu letzad ki min ze shel akuddim lo huzekar battenay harishon, ba alav harasha betaana ki lo cheelle lechelek yaakov, velo hoda al haemet mehahochacha shennatal min ze. velaze befaam rishona hotzi mechelek yaakov akuddim, veachar kach haya metavvech immo lirtzono lehachelif min nekuddim shebbechelek yaakov bechelek akudim shehu shel lavan, vechozer chalila aseret monim. uleolam tenay harishon shel nekuddim uteluim bakkesavim uvaizzim amad bimkomo.

Veamro im ko yomar. leshon atid, lefi ma shepperashti beamro "hetel bi", yeduyyak al nachon, ki lo al amira shehaya omer battechilla hayta hanehagat halleda, ella al ma sheatid lomar baacharona achar ibbur hatztzon. vedavar ze lo haya letzad hishtaddelut yaakov, ella ki meAdonai hayta lo, uchemo shessipper achar kach sheraa bachalom vechulei.

rashi: Vayyissa yaakov raglav. mishshennitbasser besora tova shehuvtach bishmira nasa libbo et raglav venaasa kal lalechet, kach meforash bivra:
ohc: Vayyissa yaakov raglav. nitkavven baze ki ani haya velo haya lo lissa rak raglav, vaasher laze kol asher yihye lo bechezkat sheeno meussar vechayyav leassero shene maasrot, keamro "asser aasserennu", veamru zichronam livracha (ketuvot 50.) maaser batra kemaaser kamma, vehu hachomesh.
Od yirtze, ki lo hutzrach lalechet ella nasa raglav, vetechef halcha etzlo artza bene kedem, velaze lo amar "leeretz bene kedem":

Vetaam amro vene kedem velo amar lecharan, ki lo nizdammena lo charan ella eretz bene kedem shebbah hayta ir charan, ume hayta zot kede sheshsham tizdammen lo rachel veyeda ma sheyyada sham mimmenna vechol haover benehem ledivrehem zichronam livracha (Megila 13:).

rashi: Hichis efrayim. levoro, levazzot et neviav velivgod bo:

Tamrurim. hem lo, ki damav asher shafach behachatio et yisrael lehitztzamed laavoda zara, vehammachatio laadam kashe lo min hahorgo, kaasher anu lemedin meammon umoav shehitu et yisrael lehitztzamed levaal peor (Bamidbar 25:3), veanshan hakkatuv yoter mimmitzri vaadomi shettevaum bannahar veyatzu bacherev likratam (sifre Devarim 252:3):
Alav yittosh. alav yattilem hakkadosh baruch hu.
Vecherpato. shecheref et shelomo, kainyan shenneemar (Melachim 1 11:26): "vayyarem yad bammelech", shehochicho barabbim al asher bana shelomo et hammillo, kedimforash bechelek (sanhedrin ka, 2):
Yashiv lo adonav. hakkadosh baruch hu, shehare hu hera laasot yoter mimmennu (Hoshea 1:4):
targum: Margezin devet efrayim mosafin lemechti vechovat dam zakkay daashed alohi yetuv vechisudeh yetuv leh ribboneh:

rashi: Vayyarotz likrato. kassavur mamon hu taun, shehare eved habbayt ba lechan baasara gemallim teunim:
Vaychabbek. keshello raa immo chelum, amar shemma zehuvim hevi vehinnam becheko:
Vaynashshek lo. amar shemma margaliot hevi vehem befiv, bera:
Vaysapper lelavan. shello va ella mittoch ones achiv, veshennatlu mamono mimmennu:
ohc: Vayhi chishmoa lavan vegomer. amro vayhi leshon tzaar. remez shennitkavven leraa keamram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 70:13) sheyyatza legazlo vechippes matzpunav, vegam chibbeko ladaat et asher itto, vegam neshako im befiv margaliyyot. veamro shema yaakov ben achoto perush: lo higgida rachel ma sheamar lah yaakov ki hu achi aviha, ella heyoto ben rivka tzaddik ben tzaddeket. uvaze chashav machashavot lerammoto. vegam amro vayviehu el beto hattaam ulay mamono yavo acharav, vehevio leveto ad yaggiu nechasav.
Vaysapper lelavan et kol vegomer. sibbat boo, vetaam boo, vaasher avar alav im elifaz ki natal mimmennu hakkol beradfo acharav:

Od yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (Megila 13:) sherachel hodia et yaakov ki aviha rammay, laze nitchakkem lesapper lo kol haddevarim sheavaruhu, kede shebbaze yechdal mehareshia kesheyyeda ma shennitchakkem ad shellakach habbechora vehabberacha, yeda ki arom yarim lema sheyyitztarech. vegam hodio asher avaro mimmaase haeven, veze yaggid ki hu gibbor chayil. gam maase hashekaat tzono, veze yaggid chibbato bo vehanehagato hayyeshara immo.

rashi: Nichsafta. chamadta, veharebe yesh bammikra, nichsefa vegam kalta nafshi (Tehillim 84), lemaase yadecha tichsof (Iyov 14):
ohc: Veatta haloch vegomer. perush, leheyot shemmikkodem kibbel alav lamma nechba livroach shemmachaziko kevoreach, veachar kach chazar lomar "veatta", perush, leshon teshuva, keamram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 21), vehakkavvana: veim teshiveni davar ki lo varachta ella "haloch" kederech halicha halachta, ki nichsof nichsafta vegomer, velo kemo sheamarti lecha bederech bericha, im ken lamma ganavta et elohay? ella vadday ki letzad shehu hammaggid, lechashshat shemma yodieni veyaggid li shehalachta, ganavta oto, veze lecha haot shebbarachta.

rashi: Yafiach. leshon dibbur hu, ki chol dibbur beruach happe hu:
targum: Sahada deshikra demalel kadavuta uman derame tigre ben ache:

rashi: Ki ner mitzva vetora or. kemo shehaor meir laolam tamid, kach hattora omedet zechutah leolam el haadam; uzechut mitzva lefi shaa, keor hanner. davar acher: ki ner mitzva vegomer mitzvat haav hu ner: kol mi shemmekayyem mitzvat aviv, keillu notel ner beyado lehadelik bimkom choshech, veim avad shum davar, sham hu motzo leoro. vechen mi shehu mekayyem horaat immo, ora hi lo; vechen hu omer "al tittosh torat immecha" (Mishlei 1:8). vechen hu vadday, shemmikra ze medabber bemitzvat aviv veimmo, dichtiv "mekallel aviv veimmo yidach nero beeshun choshech" (Mishlei 20:20). veim ner shel adam yidach (kohe) kesheen mekayyem mitzvot, nimtza keshemmekayyem mitzvot, meir nero (rabbi yosef kera):
Vederech chayyim tochchot musar. tochchot hammusar hem mattim et haadam lechayyim, nimtza shehem derech hachayyim:
targum: Metul sheraga hu fukedana venimosa nohara veorcha dechaye umachsenuta umarduta:

rashi: Ba gad. ba mazzal tov, kemo gad gaddi vesanuk la (shabbat 67), vedome lo haorchim laggad shulchan (Yeshayahu 65), umia shennolad mahul, kemo goddu ilana (Daniel 4), velo yadati al ma nichteva teva achat; davar acher lamma nikret teva achat bagad, kemo bagadta bi, keshebbata el shifchati, keish shebbagad beeshet neurim:
Vechattal mashkim holech. "uchetala demohi pasik" (targum yonatan):
Kemotz yesoer miggoren. "kemotza denashva ruach meidra":
Yesoer. asher seara tissaennu:
targum: Bechen yehon kaanan tzafra uchetala demohi fesik kemotza denashva ruach meidra vechitnana mikkevat nura:

rashi: Ma eese laelle. ech taale al libbi lehara lahen:
ohc: Vayyaan lavan vegomer. amro "vayyaan" teshuva leamro "sim ko neged vegomer veyochichu", laze ana ki eno chafetz lehachelim banav uvenotav velo yaamod lemishpat immahem, vehen hen rammautav lomar ki yochiach shehaemet itto ella sheeno ose letzad kevod banav uvenotav.

Od ramaz sheech yitztaddek betaanato kesheyyomar kele veti hem ellu, peshita sheyyoter yada yaakov besimane kele lavan mimmennu, vehattaam ki habbanot benotay vehem bekiim besimane hakkelim vechaddome yoter mimmenni leheyotam tamid mishtammeshim bahem.

Od yirtze lehashiv al shemmishshesh kol kelav, ki letzad shehakkol hu machshivo keillu shello, letzad shehabbanot benotav vegomer, vehakkol shello, haya ose keadam haose beshello, ki illu haya machshiv oto leish nachri lo haya ose chen.

Velivnotay vegomer laelle vegomer. tevat "laelle" en lah mashmaut. veulay shechozer el "kol asher atta roe", veshiur hakkatuv hu al ze hadderech: velivnotay, perush uletzad benotay, ma ani yachol laasot leelle hannechasim gam letzad benehem. o yirtze al ze hadderech, velivnotay ma eese mehara, vahagam shehen hayyom choshvim atzman lenachrim veokrim mehem shem benotay, vehu amro laelle hayyom, perush shehayyom nikraim etzli "elle" letzad maasehen, af al pi chen benotay hem.

Livnehen asher yaladu. dikdek lomar "asher yaladu", shello leyaches habbanim achar immam, laze amar "asher yaladu", lomar ki ma shekkore otam benehem lo leyachasam acharehem, ki lemishpechotam levet avotam, ella letzad sheyyaldu otam kara lahem shem benehem. vahagam shehem divre lavan, im kol ze hattora telammed dinim beemtzaut hassippurim, kemo shettimtza shellamdu (yerushalmi moed katan 1:7:3) minnayin sheen mearvin simcha besimcha, dichtiv "malle shevua zot" vegomer, hagam shehem divre lavan.

rashi: Amaggencha. emsarcha beyad oyvecha, kemo "asher miggen tzarecha" (Bereshit 14:20):
Nichmeru. nitchammemu, leshon arammi, vechen "orenu ketannur nichmaru" (Eicha 5:10):
targum: Echden emserinach efrayim eshetzinach yisrael echden evadrinach beadma ashavinach kitzvoyim mitara memar keyami lekivli kachada itgollu rachamay:

rashi: Vayhi vabboker vehinne hi lea. aval ballayla lo hayta lea, lefi shemmasar yaakov simanim lerachel, uchesheraata rachel shemmachnisin lo lea amra: achshav tikkalem achoti, amda umasra lah otan simanim (Megila 13):
ohc: Vayhi vabboker. taam amro leshon tzaar, yaggid al asher nitztaer oto tzaddik al meniat rachel mimmennu.

Vehinne hiv lea. taam shekkatuv hiv beVav, lirmoz divrehem zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 70:12) shehayu anshe hammakom merannenim ballayla veomrim "hi lea", uvabboker hikkir haddibbur hahu sheheiruhu anshe hammakom ki lea hayta, gam yeduyyak tevat "vehinne" al nachon.
Ma zot asita vegomer. tzarich ladaat kavvanato bekovlanut "ma zot", veim al harammaut, hare hiv omer "velamma rimmitani", ze yaggid ki levad harammaut kadam lo od davar megunne.

Achen yaakov yikbol al shene devarim: haechad al hammaase shennatan lo lea bimkom rachel, vehashsheni sheasa haddavar bederech rammaut. umegalle dato baze shello haya makpid kol kach im lo haya ose rammaut ze, vehaya over alav hadderech beallamut veresha mimma sheasa lo harimmuy. vetaam hakepadato letzad ma sheyyatza lo mizze betauto, shennitkavven el rachel vehayta lea, veyatza mizze devarim bilti hagunim, uchemo shepperashti befasuk "vayhi vaerev" (Bereshit 29:23), vehatztzaddikim yakpidu lema shennogea el haruchaniyyut beyoter.

Od yechavven beamro velamma rimmitani, ki yesh baze genay layyoshevet becheko shettihye nesua bederech rammaut, veze yarchik chibbuv hazziuug, uletzad ki hechlit bedato shebbevadday tihye lo tamid leishsha hikpid al ze.

Od nitchakkem bedabbero kaddevarim haelle, letzad sheraa ki ma shehaya haya veen terufa laasher naasa, ki en min hammusar liton chazara. vehiskim bedato lakachat gam et rachel, laze lo haya maflig bahefresh shebben lea lerachel, shechash ki yagdil lavan baavodat rachel yoter, veyomar elav naase tenay mechadash, veyirtze lakachat yoter mishsheva shanim. laze amar velamma rimmitani, perush lamma asa haddavar bederech rammaut, ki haya yachol lehitratztzot belea belo emtzaut harammaut, ki chullan shavim letova.

rashi: Ufachad yitzchak. lo ratza lomar elohe yitzchak, sheen hakkabba meyached shemo al hatztzaddikim bechayyehem, veaappi sheamar lo betzeto mibbeer sheva ani Adonai elohe avraham avicha velohe yitzchak, bishvil shekkahu enav, vahare hu kammet; yaakov nityare lomar elohe, veamar ufachad:
Vayyochach. leshon tochacha hu velo leshon hochacha:
ohc: Lule elohe avi vegomer. taam shello hispik lomar "elohe avi avraham", nitkavven lomar shene inyanim: echad, lihyoto elohe avi amad li vehitztzilani miyyadcha bizchut avi. vehashsheni, lihyoto baal hayyecholet umashgiach veshofet betzedek umatztzil ashuk, vehu amro elohe avraham, perush: elohe sheppirsem elohuto vaamittato avraham vehodia baolam norotav, asher hu habbore hu hammashpia veshofet betzedek, vezulat ze im haya leavi elohim acher lo haya matztzil miyyadcha, ki kamma elohot yesh shello yoilu leovdehem, en kelohenu baruch hu.

Od yechavven lomar al ze hadderech elohe avi keneged zechut avot, veachar kach hizkir shete middot shehayu lo sheamdu lo, shehem middat hachesed umiddat haddin. keneged middat hachesed amar elohe avraham, keamro (Micha 7:20) "chesed leavraham", ucheneged middat haddin amar ufachad yitzchak. velaze lo amar elohe yitzchak, lirmoz al hammidda shennitkavven lah, vezulat ze haya omer elohe yitzchak, shehare matzinu she amar lo (Bereshit 28:13) "elohe yitzchak". vetaam shehizkir shete middot ellu lomar ki hifli chasdo immo, vegam asa lo mishpat im lavan, shehem shete middot, vezulat echad mehem lo haya maggio hattov leyaakov.

Et anyi vegomer. perush, sheim lo haya lo haoni, hagam shehaya haemet itto, haya Adonai maarich appo velatet lo secharo laolam haelyon, uletzad anyo kiyyem lo Adonai (Devarim 24:15) "beyomo titten secharo" venatan lo yegia kappo.

rashi: Veriv laAdonai im yehuda. alehem hu maggid et divre rivo asher asu lo achehem bet yisrael, velo yitmehu befakdo al yaakov kidrachav:
targum: Vedina kadam Adonai im devet yehuda uleasara al yaakov keorchateh ucheovadohi taknaya yatev leh:

rashi: Nitztzav alav. leshamro:

Velohe yitzchak. aappi shello matzinu bammikra sheyyiched hakkabba shemo al hatztzaddikim bechayyehem lichtov elohe peloni, mishshum shenneemar hen bikdoshav lo yaamin (Iyov 15), kan yiched shemo al yitzchak, lefi shekkahu enav vechalu vabbayit, vahare hu chemet veyetzer hara pasak mimmennu, tanchuma:
Shochev aleha. kippel hakkabba kol eretz yisrael tachtav, ramaz lo shettehe nocha likkavesh levanav ked ammot shezze mekomo shel adam (chullin sham):
ohc: Vehinne Adonai nitztzav alav. yirmoz gam al yaakov, al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 82:6) haavot hem merkava lashshechina, veleheyot shehu regel revii yomar bediyyuk "nitztzav alav" yoter meal avraham veyitzchak, ki hu ikkar haamadat hakkisse.

Elohe avraham avicha vegomer. taam amro "avicha" lelo tzorech, gam diyyek lomar "avicha" beavraham velo amar "avraham veyitzchak avotecha", nitkavven lemaet esav miyyerushshat avraham veasa yaakov hu hayyoresh avraham, lo shettaggia hayyerushsha leyitzchak umimmennu yirashenna yaakov, sheim ken taggia hayyerushsha leesav. vachashashat yishmael enah, ki kevar katavti (or hachayyim al Bereshit 16:21) shemmishpat eved yesh lo, dichtiv (Bereshit 21:13) "ben haama" velo bincha, vegufo kanuy leyitzchak, veen taanat esav bo ki yerushshat avraham nittena leyaakov velo leesav.

Vahagam shebben mumar yoresh et aviv devar tora (kiddushin 18.), kan keshennatan Adonai leavraham mattanot uverachot vechaddome, netanam lo al menat sheacharav leyaakov, keamro (Bereshit 21:12) "ki veyitzchak yikkare lecha zara" (nedarim lo.). vahagam sheshshem zera lo yarea lannachala sheyyoresh hagam sheeno nikra zaro, hare matzinu shezzera pasul yikkare gam ken zera, kidita besanhedrin (64:) "ki mizzaro natan lammolech" lerabbot zera pasul, hare sheyyikkare zera. ella distam zera hu kasher, ucheshemmemaet kan esav shello yikkare zera, miet afillu zera pasul lo yikkare lo, umimmotza davar atta lamed sheen lo bo yerushsha. uchemo sheggilla Adonai levassof shennoten leyaakov kol birchot avraham. uma shellamdu bashshas (kiddushin 18.) mippasuk "ki yerushsha leesav natatti" vegomer, hayeynu sheyyerashuhu banav leesav, lo sheesav yarash chas veshalom, ki peshita sheen lo chelek venachala beavraham.

rashi: Leragli. im ragli, bishvil biat ragli bat etzlecha habberacha, kemo haam asher beraglecha (Shemot 11), laam asher beraglay (Shoftim 8) – habbaim immi:
Gam anochi leveti. letzorech beti; achshav en osin letzarki ella banay vetzarich ani lihyot ose gam ani immahem lesamchan, vezehu gam:

targum: Aynay ramata velishana deshikra vide deshafchan dema zakkay:
Umin demishtechach peria chad beshiva vechuleh mazala devayteh yahev:
Libba dechashal machshevata raata veragle demistarhavan lemirhat levishta:
Ketor inun al etzbeatach ketuv inun al luach delibbach:
Deninterach min itteta chilonita umin nuchereta dishian milaha:
Beri netar memri ufikuday titshe gabbach:
E dilma mehalech givra alave gumere verigloy la mitkevin:
Keofa deate vigle ken yetun diglo leara demitzrayim ucheyona deyatva lego shochva ken yetuvun deitaltelu leara deattur vaativinun bishlam levattehon umemri yehe vesaadhon amar Adonai:
Metul demin kavaya zeerata deveti adket umin charakkin dedira:

bart: Hannose et haishsha ufaska immo. bishtar vekinyan, o sheamar leedim attem eday sheani mechayyev atzmi lazun et bittah sheyyesh lah meish acher:
Lichshettavo etzli. kelomar im hayiti mekayyem et immah hayiti zanah:

Molich lah mezonoteha limkom sheimmah sham. dekayma lan bat etzel immah ben gedola ben ketanna kol zeman shehaem rotza, vehabben ad shesh shanim etzel immo, vechayyav haav lefarneso vehu etzel immo im haem rotza:
Hashsheniyya. sheniyyot laarayot, shehen middivre sofrim:

En lahem ketubba. mane matayim. memaenet, mishshum demeatzmah yotza. sheniyya, kenasuha rabbanan mippene shehi margilato lenasah, sheenah nifsedet kelum bannissuin shehare enah nifselet bahen uveladah kasher. aylonit, mishshum demekkach taut hu:
Velo ferot. happerot sheachal habbaal en motziin mimmennu:

Velo mezonot. kegon im lavta veachla beodah tachtav veachar kach meana, en habbaal chayyav leshallem. aval chayyav bimzonoteha beodah tachtav. vehashsheniyya vehaaylonit en lahem mezonot beodan tachtav, vechol shekken im lavu veachlu sheen habbaal chayyav leshallem:

Velo velaot. shenneevdu uvalu legamre, ben minnichse melog ben minnichse tzon barzel, en hamemaenet yechola lehotzi miyyad balah. aval belaoteha hakkayyamim notelet leolam, ben hamemaenet ben hashsheniyya ben haaylonit, vaafillu zinneta lo hifsida belaoteha hakkayyamim. vehashsheniyya en lah belaot shel nichse melog, aval belaot shel nichse tzon barzel yesh lah:

Tol atta chittin shebbemakom peloni. hacha mayre shechilleku sade bekamoteha vaanavim hamechubbarim bakkerem hilkach yesh berera veamrinan zehu chelko hammaggio vehammeasser measser et shello vedayyo. uleel ayre shechilleku battalush vehatam en berera dechol kelach vakelach shel shuttafim hu vetzarich leasser demay al chelek chavero shebbeyado:
Aval lo yomar lo tol atta chittin vaani seorim. delekka lememar hacha zehu chelko hammaggio ella havo kemachlifim ze laze, venimtza ze hammeasser mocher chelko lemi sheeno measser:
Mea tevel umea chullin. shennitarvu:

Notel mea veechad. notel mea lehaferish mehen maaser rishon umaaser sheni kedin kol tevel, veechad notel min hammea (dilshem) [shel] chullin litrumat maaser keillu hayu tevel, shehachullin naasim kattevel atzmo leinyan terumat maaser bilvad aval lo leinyan maaser rishon umaaser sheni, venimtza ze mafsid al yede taarovet zo achat bilvad shemmafrish min hachullin. vetevel deayre veh hacha hu shehurema mimmennu teruma gedola aval lo huremu mimmennu maasrot velo terumat maaser:

Mea tevel umea maaser. shello hurema min hammaaser hazze terumat maaser, venitarvu, notel mea shel tevel lehaferish mehen hammaasrot kedifrishit leel, venotel achat min hammea shel maaser shehem naasim kattevel atzmo lehitchayyev bitrumat maaser, venisharu tishim vatesha, mafrish mehen terumat maaser lefi cheshbon shehem eser pachot asirit shel echad. veim lo nitarev hammaaser battevel lo haya mafrish ella asara litrumat maaser shebbahen, hasheta mippene shennitarvu battevel mafrish achad asar pachot asirit nimtza mafsid echad pachot asirit:

Mea chullin metukkanin umea maaser. rishon shello nittela terumato, shennitarvu, notel mea leshem maaser rishon kede lehaferish mehen asara litrumat maaser shebbahen, veeser notel min hammea chullin metukkanin keillu hayu hem maaser rishon daasara mehem litrumat maaser, venimtza mafsid asara. veha delo machmerinan hachi keshennitarev im tevel lehazekik hattevel lehaferish mimmennu asara litrumat maaser kemea shel maaser, mishshum shekkach hu haddin shekkol davar hammitarev chozer lihyot kitchillato, hilkach hammaaser chozer lihyot kattevel veen hattevel chozer lihyot kammaaser:

Mea tevel vetishim maaser vechulei‏ lo hifsid kelum. dechevan deikka battevel asara yeterim dayninan leh keillu yesh lo parnasa mimmakom acher. vechol tevel shennitarev bechullin, im yesh lo tevalim acherim sheyyachol lehaferish al ze hattaarovet mimmakom acher, eno mafrish ella lefi cheshbon shel hattevel bilvad, vehacha shehattevel yater eser al [hammaaser] chashvinan keillu hem mimmakom acher umafrish mehen lefi cheshbon shel tevel bilvad veeno mafsid kelum:
Kol zeman shehattevel merubbe. vehu sheyyihye merubbe eser, vehachi ita bayrushalmi:
Yesh baarachin lehakel ulehachamir vechulei. kullehu mefaresh lehu veazel lekamman befirkin:

Et hannae shebbeyisrael. afillu shave mea mane eno noten ella chamishshim sela, vehayenu lehakel. ulehachamir, shehammaarich et hakkaur shebbeyisrael afillu en shave ella chamesh selaim, noten chamishshim selaim im hanneerach mibben esrim vead ben shishshim:
Veavda derech sadehu. shehecheziku vah baale hassadot shebbimtzarav:

Yelech lo bakketzara. al karcham yittol lo derech lesadehu, aval yivror lo derech ketzara shello yarbe littol. uvizman shearbaa vene adam makkifim oto mearba ruchot mode admon lachachamim shekkol echad yachol lomar ayte reaya dedarkach gabbay ushekol. veim adam echad hikkifahu mearba ruchot modim chachamim leadmon demimma nafshach orcheh gabbeh hu. lo nechleku ella keshehikkifahu adam echad shebba mikkoach arbaa vene adam. admon omer, matze amar leh mimma nafshach orchi gabbach, vachachamim omrim matze amar leh hiach, i shattakta shattakta, vei lo, mehaddarna shetara lemarayhu velo matzet leishtaoye dina bahadayhu. vahalacha kachachamim:

Vechatva rishona lallokeach vechulei. uchegon shekkanu miyyadah. uvaggemara parech, vetema nachat ruach asiti levali. umeshane, kegon shemmachar habbaal sade zo leish acher kodem laze velo ratzta haishsha lachtom lo, velaze chatma, deim ita denachat ruach osa levalah hayta chotemet larishon:
Peshara. bitztzua. lo chullo laze velo chullo laze. uleshon poshrin hu, lo chammim velo karim:

Vechen baal chov. ushene lakochot. reuven noshe veshimon mane velo shete sadot, umecharan lishnayim zo bachamishshim vezo bachamishshim, vechatav baal chov lelokeach sheni din udevarim en li immach, baal chov notel miyyad harishon, shehare eno yachol lomar lo hinnachti lecha makom shettigbe mimmennu, shechovo keneged shenehem, velokeach rishon motzi miyyad hashsheni, uvaal chov chozer umotzi af zo min harishon, velokeach sheni mibbaal chov, vechozrin chalila ad sheyyaasu feshara:

Vechen ishsha vaalat chov. shehaya lah ketubbatah al balah umachar shete sedotav lishnayim veen bishnehem ella kede chetubbatah, vechatva lashsheni din udevarim en li immach, haishsha motzia miyyad lokeach rishon, vehu min hashsheni, vehashsheni min haishsha [vehaishsha min harishon] velokeach rishon miyyad hashsheni, vechozrim chalila:
Kol zeman shehi vevet aviha. vehayyorshim natnu lah mezonoteha sham:
Gova chetubbatah. keshettirtze:
Shettaase tova. minnichse yetomim, notenet lechem umelach lishchenoteha kede chetubbatah:

Vachachamim omrim. lo huzkeru chamesh veesrim shana lehafesidah ketubbatah bishvil hattova shettaase minnichse hayetomim, ella leinyan hammechila huzkeru, dehoil veshatka velo tava kol hashshanim hallalu machala, hilkach kol zeman shehi vevet balah en shetikatah mechila, shemmippene shemmechabbedim otah hi bosha litboa ketubbatah, aval bevet aviha mishsheshshatka esrim vechamesh shanim mechila hi:

Meta, yorsheha mazkirin ketubbatah. kelomar tzerichin litboa ketubbatah betoch esrim vechamesh shana. vedavka keshennishbea al ketubbatah kodem shemmeta hu deyorsheha yecholim litboa ketubbatah. aval im lo nishbea al ketubbatah, en yorsheha yorshim mikketubbatah kelum, sheen adam morish shevua levanav:
Velo nigala. lo gealuha miyyad hahekdesh, lo habbealim velo acher:
Hakkohanim nichnasim lah. kohanim shel mishmar shehayyovel pogea bo hen nichnasim letochah, vehi chaluta veyadam:

Venotnim et dameha. lahekdesh. degamar kodesh kodesh mimmakdish bayit, ketiv hacha bisde achuzza betzeto bayyovel kodesh, uchetiv bemakdish bayit (sham) veish ki yakdish et beto kodesh, ma bayit lo tetze miyyad hekdesh belo damim kedichtiv hatam veheericho hakkohen, devayit lo nafka lakkohanim ella nifde vedamim, af sede achuzza lo tetze miyyad hekdesh belo damim. hilkach ki farik lah acher, havu damim levedek habbayit hekdesh, vechi mate yovel nafka bechinnam lakkohanim, veim lo nigala yahave chohanim deme chamishshim shekalim veshakle lah:

Rabbi shimon omer nichnasin aval lo notnin. degamar kodesh kodesh mikkivse atzeret, dichtiv behu (Vayikra 23) kodesh yihyu laAdonai‏ lakkohen, ma hatam bechinnam af kan bechinnam. venicha leh denelaf sede achuzza mikkivse atzeret, detarvayhu meesrim vearba mattenot kehunna, velo nelaf mimmakdish beto deeno nittan lakkohanim leolam. verabbi yehuda nicha leh denelaf sede achuzza mimmakdish beto, detarvayhu kadshe bedek habbayit, velo nelaf mikkivse atzeret shehem kadshe mizbeach. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Sede retushin. sade azuva. kemo [hoshea 10] em al banim ruttasha:

Ad sheyyigalenna acher. ucheshettetze miyyado bayyovel yikkansu bah kohanim. vetaama derabbi eliezer, dichtiv vehaya hassade betzeto vayyovel kodesh, mashma keshettetze miyyad haggoel kedin shear adam hakkone karka sheyyotza bayyovel, behahu kaamar kera deteheve lakkohanim, aval betzeto miyyad hekdesh lo mashma, deakkatti lo ashmoinan kera dehekdesh paka mikkocho bayyovel:

Vechamma hu shave velo yad. mefaresh baggemara, sheen shamin oto kamma yafe cheshenniktea yado vechamma haya shave kesheshshete yadav shelemot. shemmi shenniktea yado, keshebbaim leshumo kamma haya shave techilla en shamin oto ella bezol, lefi sheroim oto mezulzal, veze haomer deme yadi alay hare lo niktea yado. lechach mefaresh, kamma hu shave velo yad, kegon im mecharo rabbo chullo chutz miyyado, sheyyado achat muchtevet lerabbo rishon, veshamin kamma hu yafe kesherabbo mocher kullo velo shiyyer mimmennu leatzmo kelum. vechamma shave pachot im shiyyer rabbo yado achat shello mecharah, dehashta eno mezulzal, vechach hu noten lahekdesh:
Ze chomer bannedarim mibbaarachin. deillu amar baarachim erech yadi veragli alay, lo amar kelum, ella im ken amar bedavar shehanneshama teluya vo:

Erki alay vamet yittenu hayyorshim. deerech davar katzuv hu. vedavka chesheamad baddin kodem shemmet, lefi sheeno chayyav baerech ella achar sheyyaamod lifne hakkohen, kedichtiv (Vayikra 27) veheemido lifne hakkohen. aval damay alay deeno ella ma sheyyeshumuhu bevet din vahare lo ba lide kach shehare met, af al pi sheamad baddin hu mechussar umdana velo yittenu hayyorshim:
Noten erech kullo. deerech nefashot ketiv:
Ze hakkelal. laatoye shear evarim shehanneshama teluya vahem:

Enah yotza miyyado bayyovel. lihyot mitchalleket lakkohanim ki hechi dei hava farik la eynash acharina dahava nafka bayyovel umitchalleket lakkohanim kedichtiv (sham) vehaya hassade betzeto vayyovel kodesh laAdonai:
Gealah beno yotza leaviv bayyovel. velo lakkohanim. dichtiv (sham) veim machar et hassade leish acher lo yigael od. leish acher, velo labben:
Gealah echad mikkerovav. shel makdish miyyad haggizbar, uva hammakdish ugealah miyyad kerovo, enah yotza miyyad hammakdish bayyovel lehitchallek lakkohanim:
Gealah kohen. miyyad gizbar:
Lo yomar hoil. veim gealah yisrael yotza li velachaveray bayyovel, achshav shehi tachat yadi sheggealtiha en lecha chohen rauy lah yoter mimmenni:
Shalosh aratzot lannissuin. sheim nasa ishsha beachat mehen, eno yachol lechofah latzet acharav meeretz el eretz:
Kerach. gadol meir. vehu mekom shevakim, umikkol sevivav bain sham lischora, vechol davar matzuy vo:
Aval lo meir lichrach. sheyyeshivat hakkerakkin kasha, mippene shehakkol mityashshevim sham vedochakim umekarvim habbattim zo lezo veen sham avir:
Velo mikkerach leir. devakkerach shechiche kol mile, bair lo shechiche kol mile:

Mippene shehannave hayyafa vodek. et hagguf umachalio, sheshshinnuy veset afillu letova techillat choli meayim. vahalacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel. veim ish meeretz haggalil nasa ishsha beeretz yehuda o ippecha, kofin otah latzet immo, sheal menat ken nesaah. uvechol makom motziim meir sherubbah ovde chochavim leir sherubbah yisrael, aval lo meir sherubbah yisrael leir sherubbah ovde chochavim:

Shum hayetomim. bet din hayyordim lenichse yetomim lemachran lehagebot levaal chov, shamin et hakkarka umachrizin sheloshim yom retzufim ze achar ze, kol harotze likkach yavo veyikkach. vei vau, machrizin shishshim yom kol sheni vachamishi, vehachi adif tefe. veaf al gav dechi chashavt kol sheni vachamishi shebbeshishshim yom mittechillat yom sheni shel hacheraza rishona lo mashkachat lehu ella tamne sere yome, mikkol makom hachi adif, kevan demashcha milleta tuva yade veshame:
Veshum hahekdesh. hammakdish sede mikna, shehi nifdet bedamim kemo shehi shava:

Babboker uvaerev. bishat hotzaat poalim uvishat hachenasat poalim. dei ikka devae lemizban amar lehu lappoalim bishat yetziatan reu li sade pelonit im hi yafa, uvishat hachenasat poalim kesheshshomea hahachraza nizkar veholech veshoalan. ucheshehen machrizin, omrim, sade pelonit shekkach vechach simaneha, vechach vechach metzareha, kach hi osa tevua vechach shamuha bet din. veim mochrim otah lichtubbat ishsha, omrim, hallokeach yikkach al menat sheyyitten hammaot lichtubbat ishsha. veim mochrim otah bishvil baal chov, omrim, al menat sheyyitten hammaot levaal chov. mishshum deikka lokeach denicha leh likkach kede lifroa leishsha denasba pureta pureta, veikka denicha leh tefe lifra levaal chov shennotel zuzim chaserim ushevurim, sheen derech socharim lehakepid bechach. af al gav dekayma lan deen bet din nizkakim lenichse yetomim lemachran, vehacha tenan shum hayetomim vechulei‏ demashma shebbet din mochrim nichse yetomim, ha amrinan deal shelosha devarim bilvad bet din nizkakim limkor benichse yetomim, al baal chov nachri shehaya avihem chayyav lo vehayta ribbit ochelet bahen, veal ketubbat ishsha mishshum deikka ravcha laytomim keshettigbe ketubbatah, dechol zeman shello gavta ketubbatah yesh lah mezonot min hayetomim, gavta ketubbatah shuv en lah mezonot. veal chov shehoda avihen bishat mitato sheyyesh lifloni etzlo mane, o shennidduhu bet din al chov ze umet benidduyo, o shello higgia adayin zeman periat hachov keshemmet, dela avid eynash defara bego zimneh. ucheshebbet din nizkakim lenichse yetomim al shelosha devarim hallalu, maamidim lahem appotroppos umochrim behacheraza, keditnan bematnitin. vehane mille vekarkaot. aval bemittaltelin, hasheta dekayma lan mittaltele deyatme mishtabede levaal chov, hare baal chov nishba vegove chovo min hammittaltelin veen tzerichin hacheraza, sheen machrizim lo al haavadim velo al hashshetarot velo al hammittaltelin:
Yaddirenna hanaa. al daat rabbim, neder sheen lo hattara, shello yachazirenna leolam. deshemma vearma megaresh lah kede shettigbe ketubbatah min hahekdesh:
Kenuneya. arma:

Rabbi yehoshua omer eno tzarich. lo felige rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua hacha im adam ose kenuneya al hahekdesh i lo, devishchiv mera tarvayhu modu divvadday leolam eno ose kenuneya al hahekdesh, deen adam chote velo lo. uvevari tarvayhu modu deose kenuneya al hahekdesh. ki felige, bishela, rabbi eliezer savar en nishalin al hahekdesh, afillu omer lo lechacham lo ledaat ken nadarti vehekdesh taut hu, afillu hachi en chacham mattir nidro, desavar rabbi eliezer hekdesh betaut have hekdesh, ulefi shehammakdish hazze eno motze chacham sheyyattirennu lechach ose kenuneya zo. verabbi yehoshua savar nishalin al hahekdesh, vechi amar lo ledaat ken nadarti vetaiti, mattirin lo, dehekdesh shebbetaut lo have hekdesh. hilkach en tzarich liddor hanaa, dei mishshum kenuneya avid, hava mitteshil al nidreh velo haya tzarich legarshah. vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua:

Hearev laishsha bichtubbatah. veen labbaal nechasim, vetzarich hearev lifroa ketubbatah. lo yifra hearev hakketubba ad sheyyaddirenna habbaal techilla shello yuchal lehachazir otah. dechayshinan shemma dato lehachezirah veleechol ketubbatah leachar shettigbe min hearev. ufesak hahalacha bedin hearev bichtubba meforash besof bava batra:
Kalkalot. sallim:
Maasrot zo vezo. maasrot sheani tzarich lehaferish mikkalkala zo yihyu munnachim bachavertah:
Harishona meussaret. umafrish min hashsheniyya hammaasrot shel shetehen:

Shel zo vazo veshel zo vazo harishona meusseret. aval hashsheniyya enah meusseret, demiyyad kesheamar shel zo vezo nitkena harishona veniftera min hammaasrot vechi hadar veamar shel zo vezo nimtza mafrish mizzo shekkevar nifteret al zo shehi chayyevet, veen mafrishin min happatur al hachiyyuv velo amar kelum, venotel min hashsheniyya hammaasrot shel shetehen:

Maasrotehen maasrot kalkala vachavertah. hammaasrot hamechuyyavot lishte chalkalot hallalu yihyu shel kalkala vachavertah, hare kara shem maasrot shetehen keachat, umafrish mizzo al zo umizzo al zo, divchol achat shiyyer tevel kede maasrot chavertah. aval eno mafrish alehen mimmakom acher, shehare kara shem vekava maasrot kol achat mehen bachavertah. perush acher veikkar, maasrotehen maasrot kalkala vachavertah kara shem umafrish meezo mehen sheyyirtze, dehachi mefarshinan lemilleteh, maasrotehen meeze mehen sheertze yihyu maasrot kalkala vachavertah:
Becholat hammachoz. sevivot hair, sheenah meshubbachat kol kach mippene midras haraglayim:
Cholot. sevivot. kemo mechol hakkerem [kilayim pd]:
Machoz. ir. perush acher machoz shem makom shello hayu sedotehen chashuvim:
Befardesot. makom sheyyesh bo harebe ilanot netuim:
Sevasti. shem makom. vehailanot sham meullim meod:
Noten. mi sheppode otan min hahekdesh, ben bealim ben ish acher:

Bet zera chomer seorim bachamishshim shekel kesef. im techillat hayyovel hi. veim lav, megarea mishshanim sheavru sela ufundeyon leshana. bet zera chomer seorim, makom rauy lizriat kor, dehaynu sheloshim sea shel seorim. vehu gadol mimmekom zeriat kor shel chittin. vehammakdish sede achuzza melea ilanot, keshehu podan pode hailanot beshavyan, vechozer ufode et hakkarka bet zera chomer seorim bachamishshim shekel kesef:

Uvisde mikna noten et shavyo. devisde mikna chetiv (Vayikra 27) vechishshav lo hakkohen et michsat haerkecha, veen michsat ella minyan damim, dehaynu chefi ma shehu shave, vechen hu omer (Bamidbar lo) vaharemota meches:

Echad sede achuzza veechad sede mikna. shehare neemar bisde achuzza vechishshav, veneemar bisde mikna vechishshav, ma bisde achuzza davar katzuv, af sede hammikna davar katzuv, dehaynu zera chomer seorim bachamishshim shekel kesef:
Uvisde mikna eno noten chomesh. devisde mikna chetiv michsat haerkecha, hikkisho hakkatuv laarachin, ma arachin en mosif chomesh, af sede mikna en mosif chomesh. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:

Venotnin lah mador. vechen kele tashmish vaavadim ushefachot shehayta mishtammeshet bahem bechayye valah. veim nafal habbayit en chayyavim livnot lah bayit acher, deat tehe yatva beveti tenan. vaafillu ratzta livnoto mimmamonah en shomin lah:
Im at etzlenu yesh lich mezonot. shebbirkat habbayit berubbah:

Vehalla hotzi shemmachar lo et hassade. hallove hotzi alav shetar mechira meucheret lishtar hahalvaa, veomer shetarcha mezuyyaf o farua, sheim hayiti chayyav lecha lo hayita mocher li et hassade, shehaya lecha ligbot chovcha:

Ze haya fikkeach shemmachar lo et hassade. lefi shehaya ze mavriach mittaltelav, velo haya lo mehechan yemashkenennu al chovo, veachshav yittol et hakkarka. uveatra dehallokeach yahev zuze vahadar katve shetar mechira kulle alma lo felige shehaya lammocher leakkev bechovo hammaot shekkibbel velo yichtov lo hashshetar, vechevan shekketavo hochiach sheen lo alav chov. ki felige beatra dechatve shetara vahadar yahev hallokeach zuze. admon savar, ibbae leh lemimsar modaa eni mocher lo ella kede sheuchal lemashkeno. vachachamim omrim, hay delo masar modaa ki yare shemma yishma haddavar veyimmana milliknot et hassade. vahalacha kachachamim:
Nimtza haomer befiv yater min haose maase. shehaomer lo matzati vetulim noten mea, vehaones demotzi vetulim al yede maase noten chamishshim:
Gezar din. shello likkanes laaretz:
Ze eser peamim. gabbe meraggelim ketiv, demashma al ze nitchattem gezar din:

Ufashat lo et haregel. leshon bizzayon, kelomar tol tit veavak shettachat raglay. perush acher, tele oti veragli al haetz, sheen li ma litten lecha. verambam peresh ufashat lo et haregel, shehalach badderech merachok:
Ad shettalbin roshah. ad shettazkin. veen kofin oto lo lichnos velo liftor:
Admon omer kulei. vahalacha keadmon:
Lo yimkor adam zetav. zetim shennitleshu min hailan velo huchsheru lekabbel tuma, kegon sheadayin lo hizziu zeat hammaatan shehi machshiratan lekabbel tuma:
Ella lechaver. lefarush hammuchzak letohorot, velo yimkerem lemi sheeno chaver, shello yidroch otam betuma:

Af limasser. af lemi shello kibbel alav ella leasser aval lo kibbel alav lihyot muchzak letohorot yachol lemachram, dechevan deakkate lo huchsheru emur shemma yochlem kodem sheyyazziu. veaf al gav derov zetim en omdin leachlan kach, baalila kol dehu dematzinan litlot talinan. verambam moke pelugetayhu devet shammay uvet hillel, devet shammay savre asur ligrom tuma lechullin shebbeeretz yisrael, uvet hillel savre muttar ligrom tuma lechullin shebbeeretz yisrael:
Utzenue vet hillel. vatikin hamedakdekim bemitzvot shehayu bevet hillel:
Mazgu lo et hakkos. beyom hashshabbat:

Omer vechulei. veen day lo bema shehitna meerev shabbat, aval tzarich lachazor velomar beshabbat keshebba leechol velishtot ma sheani atid leshayyer min hakkos vechulei. bayrushalmi parech im beomer meachshav tehe teruma hare hakkol mitarev yachad venaase medumma, veim beomer lichsheeshte ha lo have teruma ella leachar sheshshata venimtza shote tevel, umeshane beomer meachshav velichsheeshte tehe teruma, venimtza shello shata tevel vegam lo haya medumma:
Befiv. befi hakkos:

Ibbed et meotav. deamar, lo amarti lecha haleveni vaani efra. aval im hilva et haishsha maot limzonoteha al menat shetteshallem lo, hu tovah vehi tovaat et habbaal vishallem. veim habbaal toen hinnachti lah mezonot, vehi omeret lo hinniach verotza lehotzi mimmennu, nishba habbaal shevuat hesset veniftar, veyihyu hammaot chov aleha lichshettitalmen o titgaresh. uveha matnitin nammi halacha kerabban yochanan ben zakkay:

Afillu aviv met. beshaa shennitchayyev ze bekarban haya aviv goses venote lamut, umet veyarash mimmennu ribbo kodem shehevi karbano, eno mevi ella karban ani, kemo shehaya beshaa shennitchayyev bakkarban:

Sefinato vayyam. lo shehayta sefinato teuna missechorot shello beribbo, deim ken ashir hu. ella shehayta sefinato muskeret laacherim beribbo sachar, vehu en beyado ella otah sefina. umishshum secharah lav ashir hu, deen sechirut mishtallemet ella besofah, venimtza sheachshav ani hu. umishshum hassefina atzmah lav ashir hu, dehay tanna savar keman deamar lekamman sheim haya hammaarich chammar noten lo hakkohen chamoro veeno notlo lahekdesh, veim haya ikkar manniach lo tzemed bekaro dehi parnasato, vehachi nammi manniach lo sefinato:

Omer ani af baarachin ken. illu mitreme af baarachin dumeya dekarbanot, have chekarbanot, deha deamart daarachin enan kekarbanot, mishshum delo damu ahadade, demippene ma ani sheheerich ashir noten erech ani lefi hesseg yad, lefi sheen heashir chayyav kelum, velo dami limtzora. veze sheamar al heashir, lo nitkavven ella lefi middat shenotav shel ashir sheppechutim o yeterim al shenotav shello, hilkach niddon behesseg yad. aval ashir sheamar erki alay dahave chayyav erech shalem, dumeya dimtzora [ashir], veshama heani veamar ma sheamar ze alay, noten erech ashir:

Hachi garsinan haya ani veheeshir o ashir veheeni meshallem erech ashir. haya ani veheeshir kodem netina, meshallem erech ashir, asher tassig yad hannoder amar rachamana, vahare yado masseget. ashir veheeni nammi tassig yad hannoder ketiv, vahare hayta masseget beet shennadar:
Rabbi yehuda omer afillu ani veheeshir vechazar veheeni noten erech ashir. dichtiv (Vayikra 27) veim mach hu meerkecha, ad sheyyehe vemachuto mittechillato vead sofo. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Sheeno maamin levaal habbayit. al hammaasrot:
Vechosech gerogeret echat. nimna milleechol gerogeret achat keneged otah shel terumat maaser shehifrish, shello yehe gozel et baal habbayit:
Lo yachsoch. veyikne gerogeret achat veyochal, sheim lo yochal mariv atzmo umemaet misseuddato venimtza memaet bechach melachto shel baal habbayit, shello yuchal laasot melacha:
Lo yachsoch mippene shehu tenay bet din. shettehe terumat maaser mishshel baal habbayit umaaser sheni mishshel poel, hilkach chayyav baal habbayit litten lo haggerogeret shehifrish litrumat maaser:

Kol kinnuye nedarim kindarim. baggemara mokminan deresha dematnitin chassore michassera vehachi katane, kol yedot nedarim kindarim, kol kinnuye nedarim kindarim. ellu hen yedot nedarim, haomer lachavero muddar ani mimmecha mufrash ani mimmecha vechulei. ellu hen kinnuye nedarim, konam, konach, konas vechulei. yedot nedarim, kemo bet yad shel keli sheochazin oto bo, kach yedot nedarim shebbahem hannedarim neechazim. kinnuye nedarim, kemo hamechanne shem lachavero [bava metzia noach:] sheeno ikkaro shel shem:
