Muddarni mimmecha. im amar echad milleshonot hallalu, muddar ani mimmecha sheeni ochel lecha vesheeni toem lecha, o mufrash ani mimmecha sheeni ochel lecha vesheeni toem lecha, o meruchak ani mimmecha sheeni ochel lecha veeni toem lecha, hu yedot nedarim veasur leechol velitom immo. aval im amar lo muddar ani mimmecha bilvad, en bemashmaut devarav ella shello yedabber immo. umufrash ani mimmecha bilvad, mashma shello yissa veyitten immo. umeruchak ani mimmecha bilvad, mashma shello yeshev bearba ammotav. veeno asur leechol immo ella im ken peresh veamar im kol echad milleshonot hallalu, sheeni ochel lecha vesheeni toem lecha:
Rabbi akiva haya chochech vechulei. kelomar mechakkech sefatav zo vazo velo ratza leesor beferush, aval haya nire middato shehaya oser:

Kenidre reshaim nadar benazir uvekarban uvishvua. im amar hare alay kenidre reshaim, shennidrehem nazir vekarban [u]shevua, im ochal kikkar zo, veavar vaachalah, chayyav lihyot nazir sheloshim yom ulehavi karban ola vechayyav malkot keover al shevuat bittuy, shehare hizkir benidro nazir vekarban ushevua. uma sheamar kenidre reshaim, lefi sheharshaim hem shennodrim venishbaim, lo hakkesherim, shehakkesherim yereim shello laavor al bal teacher venizharim shello lehotzi shevua mippihem, ulefichach kenidre kesherim lo amar kelum:

Kenidvotam nadar benazir uvekarban. im amar kenidvot kesherim hareni nazir vahare ze karban im ochal kikkar zo, vaachalah, chayyav benazir uvekarban, shehakkesherim peamim nodrim benazir leafroshe meissur. umitnaddevim bekarban shemmeviim karbanam lefetach haazara umakdishin otah sham kede shello yavou vah lide michshol. unedava hi kesheyyomar hare zo. veneder, hare alay. lefichach hakkesherim mitnaddevim aval enam nodrim, ki hechi dela letu lide takkala:
Eser shurot shel eser eser kadde yayin. mesuddarim baaretz, shebbechol inyan shettimne ben mimmizrach lemaarav ben mitztzafon ledarom timtza eser shurot shel eser eser shehen mea kaddot:
Shura hachitzona achat maaser. chavit achat shebbashshura hachitzona kavati maaser al kaddot acherot sheyyesh li:
Veen yadua ezo. chitzona, shehare yesh kan arba shurot chitzonot learba ruchot:

Notel shete chaviyyot baalachson. achat lemiktzoa deromit mizrachit usheniyya lah bemiktzoa maaravit tzefonit, shekkol chavit shebbammiktzoa nimnet lishte ruchot, vimalle mishshetehen chavit achat vetihye maaser:
Chatzi shura hachitzona achat maaser. veim amar chavit achat shebbachatzi shura hachitzona bah kavati maaser al kaddot acherot sheyyesh li:
Veen yadua ezo. chatzi shura mearba shurot hachitzonot:
Notel arba chaviyyot mearba zaviyyot. mippene sheyyesh bechol zavit mishshete chatzaim shebbishte shurot hachitzonot hassemuchot lah, umemalle mearbatan chavit achat vetihye maaser:
Shura achat maaser vechulei. veim amar chavit achat shebbeshura achat meellu eser shurot bah kavati maaser veen yadua beezo shura hi:

Notel shura achat baalachson. kelomar notel eser kaddot mishshura achat mimmiktzoa deromit mizrachit ad miktzoa maaravit tzefonit, o mimmiktzoa deromit maaravit ad miktzoa mizrachit tzefonit umemalle mikkol haeser chaviyyot chavit achat vetihye maaser. umippene ma notel baalachson veeno notel shura achat kullah beyosher mimmizrach lemaarav o mitztzafon ledarom, dichshehu notel baalachson ben shettimne hashshurot kullan mimmizrach lemaarav ben shettimne otan mitztzafon ledarom nimtza notel chavit achat mikkol shura veshura, ma sheen ken im haya notel shura achat baorech mimmizrach lemaarav o mitztzafon ledarom:

Sureya. hem aratzot shekkavash david shello hayu meeretz yisrael kegon aram naharayim vaaram tzova, ulefi sheadayin lo nichbesha kol eretz yisrael lefichach lo kadshu kikdushshat haaretz af al pi shehaya kibbush shel rabbim, uvemiktzat dinim hi keeretz yisrael uvemiktzat dinim hi kechutza laaretz. vehakkone perot besureya eno chayyav lehaferish mehen demay lefi sherov perot hannimkarim besureya michutz laaretz hen baim, hilkach ki amar meussarin hen neeman miggo dei vae amar shel chutz laaretz hen vehaya neeman keditnan beferek kamma mikkeziv ulehallan neeman, hasheta nammi ki amar shel eretz yisrael hem veissartim neeman:

Shehappe sheasar. kesheamar shel eretz yisrael hem vechayyavim bemaaser, hu happe shehittir kesheamar issartim, vechi hechi dimhemninan leh bemay deasar kesheamar shel eretz yisrael hem nehamneh nammi bema shehittir kesheamar issartim:
Mishshelli hen. min hassade sheyyesh li kan besureya, chayyavim leasser, divferot shel sureya gazru al haddemay kesheyyadua sheggadlu sham:

Veim yadua sheyyesh lo sade. en kan happe sheasar hu happe shehittir, dechevan sheyyadua sheyyesh lo sade missetama missadehu hevi happerot, velo haya neeman lomar michutz laaretz hem baim, hilkach ki amar issartim eno neeman delekka miggo:

Am haaretz sheamar lechaver kach li. kegon shehaya hechaver holech lashshuk liknot yarak leatzmo veamar lo am haaretz kach li gam ken agudda shel yarak, velakach chaver shete aguddot setam velo peresh zo li vezo leam haaretz, patur milleasser otah shennoten leam haaretz, deyesh berera keshennotnah leam haaretz shezzo hi otah shellakach mittechilla letzarko veen chaver machalifah beshello. perush acher min hayerushalmi, am haaretz sheamar lechaver kach li aguddat yarak, vehammocher chaver hu veyodea shezze hallokeach bishvil am haaretz hu lokeach, velo lakach hechaver leatzmo kelum, petura haagudda hazzot mimmaaser demay shekkevan shehammocher chaver veyodea shelletzorech am haaretz hu kone eno mocher lo ella im ken isser, dehachi amrinan leel perek 2‏ sheasur limkor leam haaretz ella im ken isser techilla. aval im kana hechaver achat leatzmo veachat leam haaretz venitarvu, chayyav leasser deshemma ma shemmachar lo leatzmo eno meussar, shehammocher lechaver eno tzarich leasser vehakkone alav muttal leasser kidamran leel perek 2:
Vaafillu hen mea. vaafillu nitarva achat shello bemea shel am haaretz:
Geluskan. kikkar lechem yafe:
Iggeret bikkoret. hacheraza. sheal yede hahachraza bene adam mevakkerim bah. uveha mode tanna kamma lerabban shimon ben gamliel. vahalacha ketanna kamma:
Hakkishshut. kishshuin shekkorin baaravi 247 uvelaaz 760:
Vehammelaffonot. nikraim baaravi 241 uvelaaz 355:
Rabbi yehuda omer kilayim. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Chazeret vachazeret gallim. hachassa haggedela baggannim vechassa haggedela beharim:
Ulshim. shel gannim veulshe sade, venikraim baaravi 71:
Kereshin. shel ginna uchereshe sade, vehem hannikraim baaravi 627 uvelaaz 592:
Kusbar. kach shemo baaravi 336 belaaz. targum yerushalmi kezera gad, kevar zera kusbar:
Veharmutza. delaat mara shemmemattekim otah beremetz kelomar beefer cham sheyyesh bo rishfe esh lefichach korin lah remutza:
Ufol hammitzri. 187 belaaz:
Vehecharuv. min kitnit, vekorin lo charuv lefi shettarmilav shehazzera betocho hen dakkin vaakummin kecharuvin, vehu mimmin pol hammitzri:
Ben min haerusin. sheen lah mezonot umocheret lichtubbatah:
Ben min hannissuin. shehi mocheret limzonot:
Mocheret shello bevet din. kelomar shello vevet din mumchin. umikkol makom tzericha limkor bifne shelosha sheyyihyu vekiin beshumat karka:

Rabbi shimon omer min hannissuin. shehi mocheret limzonot, mocheret shello vevet din, shei efshar lah lihyot yoshevet umitanna ad sheyyizdakku lah bet din. aval min haerusin sheen mechiratah ella lichtubba, enah mocheret ella vevet din. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Almana nizzonet minnichse yetomin. ben karkaot ben mittaltelin. ditnay chetubba hu, veat tehe yatva beveti umittazzena minnechasay:

Veen chayyavin bikvuratah. shehabbaal chayyav bikvuratah tachat yerushshatah, veachshav sheyyorsheha govin ketubbatah miyyorshe habbaal, hem yikberuha. umimmela shaminan sheim meta velo nishbea al ketubbatah, sheachshav en yorsheha govin ketubbatah, al yorshe habbaal muttal lekavrah:

Tol atta avodat kochavim vaani maot. af al gav dachalufe avodat kochavim veyen nesech asurim bahanaa, hacha share ad shello vau leyado, mishshum dirushat ger et aviv enah min hattora ella middivre sofrim. velo dami lechaver veam haaretz sheyyarshu et avihem am haaretz daafillu kodem shebbau leyado asur lomar lo tol atta chittim vaani seorim, dehatam haveya yerusha deorayta vahave keillu va leyado:
Yeled. mibben esrim vead ben shishshim, dahave erko chamishshim shekalim:
Noten kizman haerech. dichtiv (Vayikra 27) keerkecha yakum, eno noten ella kizman haerech:

Yom sheloshim kilmatta. im amar erech peloni katan alay, veoto katan haya beoto yom ben sheloshim, have chilmatta velo amar kelum. deen erech lefachut mibben chodesh. dehachi ketiv [sham] veim mibben chodesh:
Mibben shishshim shana vamala. mashma sheshshalma shenat shishshim veaz hu niddon keshishshim, aval bishnat shishshim niddon keyeled:

Hen im asinu. bitmiha. kelomar, vechi chen hu, im asinu [shenat] shishshim kilmatta lehachamir deerech gadol yesh lefachut mibben shishshim chamishshim sela, uleyoter mibben shishshim eno ella chamishsha asar:
Kilmatta mimmenna lehakel. deerech yoter al ben esrim, gadol hu mippachut mibben esrim. vechen beven chamesh. kedichtive vikrae:

Rabbi eliezer omer. leolam shenat chamesh ushenat esrim ushenat shishshim kilmatta, ad shettishlam kol hashshana vechodesh veyom echad mishshana haacheret. deyalef gezera shava lemala lemala mibbechor, neemar kan mibben shishshim shana vamala, veneemar bivchor adam (Bamidbar 18) ufeduyav mibben chodesh vamala, ma lehallan chodesh veyom echad, sheen bechor nifde pachut mibben chodesh veyom echad, af kan ad sheyyosif al shishshim chodesh veyom echad. ushenat chamesh ushenat esrim yalfinan bigzera shava shana shana mishshenat shishshim, kidyalef tanna kamma leel. veen halacha kerabbi elazar:
Echad measser. neeman al hammaasrot:
Veechad eno measser. eno neeman al hammaasrot:
Hammeasser measser et shello. metakken hachetzi mikkol ma sheggadel bakkerem shel shenehem:

Vechelko bechol makom shehu. bayrushalmi mefaresh dehachi kaamar, vechelko shel chavero dehaynu shel ze sheeno measser bechol makom shehu demay hu. umishshum deen berera chayshinan shemma chatzi chelko shel hammeasser beyad chavero sheeno measser vachatzi chelek chavero beyado, hilkach af al pi shekkevar tikken hachetzi mikkol ma sheggadel bakkerem chayyav letakken betorat demay chatzi chelek chavero shebbeyado:
Pegam. shamin kamma adam rotze litten ben shifcha betula leshifcha beula lehassiah leavdo sheyyesh lo korat ruach hemennu:
Lefi hamevayyesh vehammitbayyesh. adam nikle shebbiyyesh, bashto merubba. vehammitbayyesh, lefi chashivuto bashto:

Hammazmin et chavero. omer meerev shabbat vechulei. vehecha dehitna meerev shabbat muttar lehaferish beshabbat, aval lo hitna asur ditnan safek chashecha measserim et haddemay, ha vadday chashecha lo. vehacha mayre behizmino chavero velo hiddiro, dei hiddiro ha amrinan leel perek 4‏ ochel immo beshabbat rishona af al pi sheeno maamino al hammaasrot. i nammi hatam beshabbat rishona shel bachur shennasa vetula vehacha bishar shabbatot:

Hare hu maaser. uteruma gedola eno tzarich lehaferish delo nechshedu amme haaretz aleha kidfarshinan beferek kamma. veal echad mimmea shemmafrish lemachar omer hare hu maaser rishon, ushear maaser dehaynu tisha shehu chayyav adayin kede sheyyehu asara lemea moded lo haechad, veachar kach omer ze haechad sheasiti techilla maaser asuy terumat maaser al tisha hassemuchim lo:
Maaser sheni. yihye bitzfono o vidromo umechullal yihye al hammaot, venimtza lemachar sheen tzarich lehaferish ki im terumat maaser bilvad, veochel veshote et hashshear:
Min haddemay al haddemay. dilma hay meussar vehay lo meussar:
Teruma. veen tzarich letakken et hatteruma kevan desafek hu verov amme haaretz measserim hen:

Min havvadday al haddemay teruma velo teachel. dahave dumeya demafrish min hannakuv al sheeno nakuv min hachiyyuv al happatur, sheim haddemay meussar nimtzet hatteruma tevel deorayta, hilkach lo teachel:

Hachocher sade min haoved kochavim. kenas kansu chachamim lechocher sade min haoved kochavim sheyyehe measser ma shennoten lo, kede shello yehe shum yisrael chocher sade mimmennu vetishshaer bura beyado, umittoch kach yitztarech lemachrah leyisrael bedamim muatim. uvimkabbel baarisut lo kansu, sheyyoter chafetz haoved kochavim bachachirut mibbaarisut:

Sade shel avotav. sheggezalah haoved kochavim meavotav, ukenasuhu sheyyitztarech leasser kede sheyyidchak atzmo veyiknenna min haoved kochavim, shemmittoch shehi chaviva alav shehayta shel avotav lo yanniach lekabbelah min haoved kochavim beyoter min harauy lah, uchesheyyichbad alav hammaaser yiknenna. uchevateh derabbi yehuda kayma lan, delo paleg tanna kamma aleh:
Memashkenin otan. gizbar nichnas levetam venotel beal karcham:

Chayyave chattaot vaashamot. kevan dilchappara atu lo mashhe lehu, veen memashkenin otan. vechattat nazir, hoil velav lechappara atya veenah meakkavto millishtot yayin, shekkevan shennizrak haddam shel echad min hakkarbanot huttar hannazir lishtot yayin ulehittame lammetim, zimnin defasha umashhe la, hilkach memashkenin oto al chattato:

Chayyave olot ushelamim. af al gav deola mechapperet al ase veal lav hannittak laase, hoil velav chova hi la chashiv la kappara veate leshihuye, hilkach memashkenim otan. veyesh mechayyave olot sheen memashkenim otan, kegon olat metzora, lefi shehi meakkevet tohorato, lo ate leshihuye:
Kofin oto ad sheyyomar rotze ani. hecha devet din memashkenim oto tzarich sheyyomar rotze ani:
Vechen atta omer begitte nashim. kol mi sheddino shekkofin oto legaresh, velo ratza legaresh, bet din shel yisrael makkin oto ad sheyyomar rotze ani, venoten hagget vehu kasher:

Benotehen nizzonot minnechasim bene chorin. velo mimmeshubadim, sheen motziim limzon haishsha vehabbanot minnechasim meshubadim, mippene tikkun haolam, sheen hallakochot yodim kamma yaalu hammezonot ki hechi delizaharu lehanniach lahem makom ligbot:
Vehi nizzonet. otah habbat:
Shehi chevaalat chov. sheyyesh lah alehen shetar mezonot:
Kol zeman sheat immi. velo im amut o tamuti o agarshech:
En pochatin mishshenem asar leviyyim. tisha letisha kinnorot, ushenayim lishte nevalim, veechad letziltzal:
Duchan. kemin itztabba shehaleviyyim omdim aleha:
En katan nichnas. en levi katan nichnas laazara leshum avoda, kegon lechabbed et haazara ulehagif et haddelatot:
Ella veshaa shehaleviyyim omdim. al hadduchan bashshir, az nichnasim leviyyim ketannim leshorer immahem:
Velo hayu. otam ketannim omrim benevel vechinnor, ella bappe:
Kede litten teval. litten tavlin binimat haleviyyim. lefi shekkol hakketannim dak vetzalul umetabbel et kol haggedolim:
Lo olin. otan ketannim leminyan shenem asar leviyyim hatztzerichim ladduchan:
Veen olin. al haitztabba hammuchenet ladduchan. ella baaretz hayu omdim:
Vetzoare haleviyyim hayu nikraim. shehayu metzaarim et haleviyyim haggedolim, sheen yecholim levassem ulehanim kolam kemotam:

Hallokeach yayin mibben hakkutim. kodem sheggazru al yenan, vehaya yenan vadday tevel. vehacha ayre belokeach erev shabbat ben hashshemashot o shellakach mibbeod yom veshachach lehaferish ad ben hashshemashot, veaz asur lehaferish ditnan safek chashecha en measserin et havvadday, hilkach asur likboa lo makom, dikviut makom chashuv kehaferasha veasur ben hashshemashot, umishshum hachi lo katane besefa umaaser sheni mechullal al hammaot, dechevan deeno rashshay likboa lo makom bitzfono o vidromo i efshar lechallelo, aval likrot shem deamar sheani atid lehaferish share, dechulle hay lo gazur ben hashshemashot:

Sheani atid lehaferish. hacha lo katane sheani atid lehaferish lemachar kidkatane leel gabbe hammazmin et chavero, dedavka kesheeno metakken ella ma sheochel veshote hittiru lehaferish lemachar mimmotar achilato ushetiyyato hannishar beshule hakkos, aval letakken et kol hannod beshabbat lo hittiru. vehacha eno kore shem litrumat maaser kemo babbava shel demay uchedilel gabbe hammazmin et chavero, mishshum degabbe demay dimasseran vehen shello kore shem litrumat maaser kede letakken et hammaaser uleachlo, aval kan shehu tevel vadday tzarich litten hammaaser lallevi vehallevi yikra shem litrumat maaser:

Vaasara maaser rishon vetisha maaser sheni. lav davka, shehare leachar shehifrish mimmea shene luggin litruma gedola venishar tishim ushemona lo yihye hammaaser ella asara luggin pachot chomesh umaaser sheni shemona luggin ushemone asiriyyot vechomesh asirit:

Mechel veshote. matchil veshote. perush acher mozeg veshote, mechel kemo mehel, leshon savech mahul bammayim (yeshaya 1). usetam matnitin atya kerabbi meir deamar af bidorayta yesh berera veze shennishar beshule hakkos have keillu hufrash mittechilla. veenah halacha ella kayma lan devidrabbanan yesh berera aval bidorayta en berera, hilkach bevadday tevel lo yochal velo yishte ad sheyyafrish:
Hemit ben chorin noten et shavyo. dichtiv (Shemot 21) im kofer yushat alav venatan pidyon nafsho, deme nezek:
Chaval baze uvaze. ben beeved ben beven chorin, velo hemito. meshallem nezek shalem:
Chetzyi alay. have keerech roshi veerech kevedi, dahave davar shehanneshama teluya vo:

Deme chetzyi alay noten deme chullo. dichtiv (Vayikra 27) neder beerkecha nefashot, hikkish neder leerech, ma erech amar erech chetzyi alay noten erech kullo, af neder amar deme chetzyi alay noten kullo:
Ze hakkelal. laatoye chol haevarim shehanneshama teluya vahem, sheim amar deme chatzi oto evar alay, kegon sheamar deme chatzi libbi alay, o deme chatzi chevedi alay, noten deme chullo:

Hallokeach sade meaviv, met aviv veachar kach hikdishah hare hi chisde achuzza. shehare ad shello hikdishah nafla lo birushsha. hilkach im ba lifdotah, pode bet kor bachamishshim shekel kisde achuzza, veim lo gealah hu ugealah acher, yotza lakkohanim bayyovel:

Hare hi chisde mikna. devatar shaa shehikdishah azlinan. veim ba lifdotah, pode sade veshavyah kedin sede mikna, veim lo gealah hu ugealah acher, chozeret lo bayyovel. shehare beshaa shehikdishah lo haya gufah shello, daatida hayta lachazor leaviv bayyovel kedin shear mechirot, vechishar makdish sede mikna hu shehaggoalah miyyad haggizbar machazirah bayyovel laasher lo achuzzat haaretz, dehaynu leaviv shel ze, veze yoresh et koach aviv. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Sede mikna. shehikdishah ugealah acher, enah yotza lakkohanim bayyovel, sheen adam makdish davar sheeno shello, vekarka lo hayta shello ella ad hayyovel:
Kohanim uleviyyim makdishim leolam. vaafillu bishnat hayyovel atzmah. aval yisrael shehikdish sadehu bishnat hayyovel atzmah, enah mekuddeshet:

Vegoalin leolam. ma sheen ken beyisrael sheeno pode leachar hayyovel, kedichtiv (Vayikra 27) veim machar et hassade leish acher lo yiggael od. aval kohen o levi shehikdish karka sheyyarash meavotav hare ze goel leolam, vaafillu avar aleha hayyovel velo nifdet goalah leachar hayyovel, kedichtiv (sham 25) geullat olam tihye lalleviyyim:
Harishona kodemet lashsheniyya. otah shezzeman ketubbatah mukdam kodemet lashsheniyya shezzemannah meuchar. vechen kullam:

Harishona nishbaat lashsheniyya. im sheniyya toenet hishshavi li shello gavit mishshel bali kelum, dilma lo yishshaer li mimma sheegbe chetubbati. veaf shelishit tomar ken lashsheniyya, ureviit lashshelishit. aval harviit nifraat shello vishvua, uchegon sheen sham yoresh o vaal chov acher sheyyashbiah:

Ben nannas omer kulei. pelugetayhu detanna kamma uven nannas mefaresh baggemara, kegon shennimtzet sade achat meellu hassadot sheggavu hashshalosh nashim harishonot, sheenah shello, shennoda sheggezalah vesof sheyyavou vealeha veyitteluha, ucheshebbaa harviit ligbot ketubbatah missade reviit baa zot veomeret lah lemachar yavo hannigzal veyittol sadehu miyyadi, retzoni shettishshavi li shello gavit ketubbetich bechayye habbaal. tanna kamma savar baal chov meuchar shekkadam vegava, ma sheggava lo gava, hilkach lamma tishshava, im yavo hannigzal veyitrof mizzo tachazor hi al harviit vetittol mimmenna ma sheggavta, dehavya lah reviit baal chov meuchar. uven nannas savar, baal chov meuchar shekkadam vegava, ma shegava gava, veim tachazik zot en hashshelishit yechola lachazor aleha, ulechach tishshava lah shello gavta minnichse valah kelum. vahalacha ketanna kamma. umimmela shaminan sheim tafsa mittaltelin shetztzericha lishshava ledivre hakkol, kevan sheen din kedima bemittaltelin uma shegava gava:
Vehu bevet hammidrash. beerev shabbat umityare shemma yikdash alav hayyom velo yuchal leasser:
Bayit ze karban. levedek habbayit:
Venafal habbayit. kodem shehechzik bo gizbar:
Met hashshor vechulei‏ chayyav leshallem. velo amrinan en damim lammetim ella veadam bilvad:
En lo vichsut ishto uvanav. sheen ellu nechasim shello:
Shetztzevaan lishman. leshem ishto uvanav:
Velo vesandalim chadashim. revuta ashmoinan deaf al gav daadayin lo naalu otan hare hen bechezkatan mishsheat lekicha:

Af al pi sheamru avadim nimkarim bichsutan leshevach. kesut yafa shellahen meshabbecham umaale et demehen. kegon gabbe nichse yetomim sheim tillakach leeved kesut bishloshim dinar hu mashbiach mane al damim sheshshave achshav:
Laitlis. leyom hashshuk:
Lakkerach. shedderech socharim lavo sham vekonim hammargaliyyot beyoker:
En lahekdesh ella mekomo. bemargalit:

Usheato. beeved, dichtiv (Vayikra 27) venatan et haerkecha bayyom hahu, shello yashhe. kodesh laAdonai, mashma kol davar shehu kodesh laAdonai‏ kegon setam hekdeshot shehen levedek habbayit, kullan yihyu notnim bayyom hahu miyyad, shello yashhe otan. vetaama katav harambam dezimnin deatu leashhoyinhu kede lehashebiach veatu lide peseda, umehay taama nammi en mistakkerim beshel hekdesh:

Met hannoder vehanniddar yittenu hayyorshim. vehu sheamad baddin kodem shemmet, kidfareshna leel. vesefa itztericha leh: damav shel peloni alay, met hannoder yittenu hayyorshim. demahu detema af al gav deamad baddin, hoil umet hannoder kodem sheyyashumu hanniddar, lo ishtabud nichseh, kamashma lan umdana gilluy milleta vealma hu, vehoil veniddar kayyam amdinan leh:

Mishshel yisrael al shel oved kochavim. hay tanna savar en kinyan leoved kochavim beeretz yisrael lehafekia min hammaaser, verabbi meir hi, veenah halacha, dekayma lan yesh kinyan leoved kochavim beeretz yisrael lehafekia min hammaaser dichtiv (Vayikra 25) vehaaretz lo timmacher litzmitut, ha im nimkera tzemuta hi:
Al shel kutim. perot hakkutim vadday tevel mochrin otan. deaf al pi dichsheochlin perotehen issure meassere, keshemmochrin enan measserin, delo chayshe al lifne ivver lo titten michshol:

Rabbi elazar oser mishshel kutim al shel kutim. dezimnin dimasser lenafsheh venimlach umochro, veshemma haechad meussar vehaechad lo, venimtza mafrish min happatur al hachiyyuv. uvazzeman hazze hakkutim asaum keovde chochavim gemurim lechol divrehem:
Hesseg yad bannoder. torat din hassagat yad, sheani niddon baarachin kefi hesseg yado, batar noder azlinan, velo vatar niddar, kedimfaresh lekamman:

Vehashshanim banniddar. yeled sheheerich erech zaken, noten erech zaken, delo azlinan batar shanim denoder. vetanna dekare lemaarich noder, lishna dikra nakat, dichtiv (Vayikra 27) al pi asher tassig yad hannoder yaarichennu hakkohen. veayde deamar hesseg yad bannoder amar nammi hashshanim banniddar:
Vehaarachim banneerach. ketzav haerech dezachar unekeva, batar neerach azel, velo batar maarich, kedimfaresh lekamman deish sheamar erech ishsha felonit alay noten erech ishsha:
Vehaerech bizman haerech. kedimfaresh lekamman, sheim heerich atzmo cheshehaya pachot mibben esrim dahave erech katan, vekodem netinato haya ben esrim, eno noten ella keshaa sheheerich:
Konam konach konas hare ellu chinnuyin lekarban. leshonot shel goyim hem, veyesh mehem mi shekkore lekarban kach veyesh mi shekkore kach, uvechol lashon sheyyomar meellu hu matpis bekarban:
Nadar bemota. kelomar nishba bemota, vehu chinnuy shel momta, shehi shevua bilshon targum:
Hachittin vehazzunin. korin lo baaravi 74:

Enan kilayim ze vaze. lefi shekkeshehishchitu dor hammabbul et darkam hayta haaretz gam hi mazna et peroteha vehayu zorim chittim umotzia zunin, hilkach lo have kilayim im hachittim. aval im shear mine tevua have kilayim, veaf al gav delo chazi lemaachal adam, mikkol makom kevan shemmolichim oto mimmakom lemakom lemaachal yonim havu kilayim:

Hasseorim veshibbolet shual. kol hashshenuyim bammishna zug zug enam kilayim ze vaze, echad mizzug ze veechad mizzug ze hem kilayim ze vaze. veha deamrinan bimnachot [daf 9.] hakkussemin min chittim veshifon min seorim, hanne mile leinyan challa shemmitztarfin ze im ze leshiur challa, aval leinyan kilayim havu kilayim ze vaze:
Veshibbolet shual. seorim midbariyyim uvelaaz 68:
Kusmin. bilshon laaz 191:
Shifon. belaaz 104. umishshum dechusmin veshifon damu lahadade enam kilayim ze vaze:
Vehassappir. yesh omrim 521 belaaz. verambam peresh shekkorin lo baaravi 341:
Happurkedan. rambam peresh shehu zera dak shekkorin lo baaravi 96:
Vetofeach. hu kitnit sheggargerav agullim levanim vekorin lo 406. vaani shamati shettofeach hu shekkorin lo 96:
Vehashsheuit. korin lah baaravi 54:
Enam kilayim ze vaze. im zara kol echad im ben zugo:
Hamekabbel zetim leshemen. yisrael shekkibbel zetim mikkohen o millevi:
Keshem shecholkin bachullin kach cholkim batteruma. veaf al gav dilel labbealim, hacha shane delo kibbel karka ella ilanot, verabbanan lo avde zetim kekarka:
O lemachatzit sachar. sheyyimkor hashshemen vichalleku harevach laemtza:
Hammaasrot labbealim. derabbi yehuda aved zetim kekarka. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Lachullin sheochal lach. hallamed nekudda fattach, umashma lo chullin yihye ma sheochal lach ella kodesh:
Lo chasher. yihye, ella pasul. vehayenu kadashim deshayyach behu kashrut ufaslut:

Velo deche. lo muttar. kemo el kamtza dachan, baavoda zara [daf 37]. veaf al gav dilshon muttar veasur shayyach nammi gabbe nevela uterefa, vaanan kayma lan sheen matpisin ella bedavar hanniddar vehanniddav, hoil veyesh bemashmaut muttar gam bekadashim, ha tenan setam nedarim lehachemir, dechevan dedato lehatepiso beneder amrinan al davar hanniddar nitkavven:
Tahor. im amar lo tahor ma sheochal lach:
Tame notar piggul. im amar tame ma sheochal lach, vechen kullam: asur. shekkol ellu devarim hannohagim bakkadashim hem:
Keimmera. kasse shel karban:
Kaddirim. kelishkat haetzim o chelishkat hattelaim:
Kaetzim. kegizre etzim shel maaracha:
Kaishshim. kakkarbanot sheal haesh:
Kammizbeach. kakkarbanot sheal gabbe hammizbeach:
Kahechol. kakkarbanot shebbahechol:
Kirushalayim. kakkarbanot shebbirushalayim. perush acher, kechomot yerushalayim, dekasavar shechomot yerushalayim mishsheyare hallishka ka atu:

Beechad mikkol meshammeshe hammizbeach. kegon mizlagot mizrakot umachtot. im amar kammizlagot sheochal lach, o chammizrakot sheochal lach, vechen kullam, af al pi shello hizkir karban, hare ze chenoder bekarban:
Rabbi yehuda omer haomer yerushalayim. belo kaf, lo amar kelum. vetanna kamma paleg aleh. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Veechad kol haadam. pode vet kor bachamishshim shekel, ben shehu shave elef shekalim ben sheeno shave ella chamishsha shekalim:
Shehabbealim notnim chomesh. kedichtiv (sham) veim gaol yigal et hassade hammakdish oto vegomer:
Vehoda vakkankannim. rekim belo shemen. uchegon shetteano chavero asara chadde shemen yesh li etzlecha:
Admon omer. yesh bemashmaut taana zo shemen vechaddim, ucheshehoda lo bechaddim rekim have hodaa vemiktzat vechayyav shevua:

Vachachamim omrim. en bemashmaut taana zo ella shemen bilvad shiur asara chaddim, ucheshehoda lo bechaddim rekim, ma shetteano lo hoda lo uma shehoda lo lo teano, veen kan hodaa vemiktzat mimmin hattaana veeno chayyav shevua. vahalacha keadmon:
Memashkenin otan. gizbar nichnas levattehem venotel beal karchan:

Mazon uchesut umitta sandalim utefillin. al kullan meshayyerim lo maot liknotan im en lo. dichtiv (Vayikra 27) veim mach hu meerkecha, vedarshe rabbanan likra hachi, veim mach, taase sheyyishshaer hu, sheyyihye lo havaya vechiyyut, meerkecha, middeme haerech. umashma hu yesh lo havaya vechiyyut middeme haerech, aval lo leishto velo levanav:
Mikkol min vamin. mikkol ummanut shetztzericha arbaa vachamishsha kelim:
Maatzadim. 251 belaaz. shemmachlikim bah pene halluach:
Megera. keen sakkin aroch male pegimot. uleshon mikra, massor, 74 belaaz:
Tzimdo. tzemed bakar. sheellu hen kele ummanuto. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer, detzemed bakar vachamor nechasim ninhu, vela chashive kele ummanut:
Haorer al hassade vechulei. reuven mearer al hassade shebbeyad shimon veomer lo, levi shemmachar lecha gezalah mimmenni, vehu chatum al shetar hammechira shekkatav levi leshimon shemmachar lo:

Admon omer yachol hu sheyyomar. ma shello irarti beshaa shellakachta sade zo millevi vechatamti ed betoch hashshetar, lefi shellevi adam chazak vekashe lehotziah miyyado venoach li shettehe beyadcha sheotzienna mimmecha bedin:

Ibbed et zechuto. dehoil vechatam hoda sheen lo esek bah. veen halacha keadmon. vedavka keshechatam bah beed hu diflige admon vachachamim, aval im hu chatum bedayyan lekayyem et hashshetar, hakkol modim shello ibbed et zechuto, mippene sheyyachol lomar lo hayiti yodea ma shekkatuv bashshetar, shehaddayyan hachotem al hahenpek lekayyem et hashshetar en tzarich sheyyeda ma shekkatuv bashshetar ella sheyyakkir chatimat haedim bilvad:
En makdishin. sede achuzza:

Pachot mishshete shanim. dichtiv bemakdish sede achuzza (Vayikra 27) al pi hashshanim hannotarot, veen shanim pachot mishshetayim. hammakdish sede achuzza beshana rishona shel yovel uva legaalah, noten bevet kor chamishshim sela, kedichtiv (sham) zera chomer seorim vegomer. veim hikdishah eser shanim o esrim achar hayyovel, mechashshevim hashshanim hannotarot ad yovel habba, venoten sela ufundeyon lechol shana, kedichtiv (sham) veim achar hayyovel yakdish sadehu vechishshav lo vegomer‏ venigra meerkecha, vehayenu gerua, sheeno noten chamishshim shelemim. vehammakdish shete shanim lifne hayyovel, pode otah bishte selaim ushene fundeyonim, kedichtiv al pi hashshanim hannotarot, vechach hacheshbon ole shel geullat sede achuzza lechol shana sela ufundeyon, shehare im hikdishah beshana rishona shel achar hayyovel haya fode bachamishshim shekel, tze mehen learbaim vetesha shanim habbaim ad yovel habba arbaim vetesha selaim, nimtza sela lechol shana vesela yoter, veze hassela hayyoter chillekuhu lefundeyonim, sheyyesh bechol sela arbaim ushemona pundeyonin, hare sela ufundeyon leshana pachot pundeyon. uma shehitzrichuhu litten sela ufundeyon leshana, lemt shanim 49 selaim umt pundeyonin veyesh kan pundeyon echad yoter al chamishshim shekel sheamra tora, oto happundeyon hu kalbon lifrotrot, kelomar bishvil hahechrea shetztzarich litten lechol shekel veshekel bifne atzmo. i nammi, af al pi shehassela eno ella arbaim ushemona pundeyonot, chayyav litten arbaim vetisha, dehaynu sela ufundeyon learbaim vetesha shana, lefi shehannoten pundeyonim likkach sela min hashshulchani noten arbaim vetisha pundeyonim, vehayenu kalbon lifrotrot. vehammakdish sede achuzza pachot mishshete shanim lifne hayyovel en kan gerua, veim ba legaalah noten chamishshim shelemim, degabbe gerua ketiv al pi hashshanim hannotarot venigra, umiut shanim shenayim. veetza tova kamashma lan matnitin sheyyehe adam chas al nechasav velo [yakdish] pachot mishshete shanim, shello yafsid arbaim ushemona selaim:

Velo goalin achar hayyovel. lav achar hayyovel samuch layyovel kaamar, ella hay achar afillu achar esrim o sheloshim shana kae. vehachi kaamar, habba ligol beemtza hayyovel velitten sela ufundeyon leshanim habbaim, vehaya omed benisan shehu emtza shana, lo yomar chatzi sela vachatzi fundeyon ani noten mishshana zo, ella noten sela ufundeyon shalem. vehayenu dekaamar en goalin pachot mishshana, dechamma dela nafka la kulla shatta lo miggara la kelal velo yahev geullat chatzi shana ella geullat shana shelema. uma taam, lefi sheen mechashshevim chodashim im hahekdesh. habba ligol sadehu chamesh shanim vachetzi lifne hayyovel, en mechashshevin otan shishsha chodashim sheyyatzu mishshana shishshit, ella noten shesh selaim veshishsha fundeyonim, dichtiv (Vayikra 27) vechishshav lo hakkohen et hakkesef al pi hashshanim hannotarot, shanim atta mechashshev vei atta mechashshev chodashim, kelomar kol ma shennotar chishshuv shanim, laasot chodesh hannotar shana, vei atta mechashshev hechodashim sheyyatzu, ligroa min hashshekel ufundeyon bishvilam:

Aval hekdesh mechashshev chodashim. kelomar, im revach shel hekdesh hu shennachshov otah yetziat chatzi shana sheyyatza, kegon dimkaddeshah befalga dearbaim ushemona layyovel, dei chashvat lehahu yetzia have leh pachot mishshete shanim lifne hayyovel velo mipparka vegerua ella vachamishshim, vei amart deen mechashshevim otan chodashim sheyyatzu, hava hacha shete shanim lifne hayyovel, veikka feseda dehekdesh delo shakel ella shete selaim ushene fundeyonim, hacha vadday mechashshevin otan kitzia gemura veen kan shete shanim lifne hayyovel, velo mipparka vegerua ella vachamishshim shekel, dichtiv vechishshav lo hakkohen, mikkol makom:
Bishat hayyovel. bizman shehayyovel noheg. aval bizman sheen hayyovel noheg, pode otah beshavyah kishar hekdeshot:
Zera chomer seorim. makom sheyyecholim lizroa bo kor seorim keshezzorim bemappolet yad uvizria benonit, lo sheyyihye hazzera mekubbatz beyoter velo mefuzzar umeforad harebe:

Nekaim amukkim vechulei. vehu sheyyihyu meleim mayim sheen reuyin lizria. aval im enan meleim mayim, hoil vachazu lemidi, af al gav deen nimdadin immah mitchashshevin beappe nafshayhu, venifdin lefi cheshbon chamishshim selaim levet kor:

Pachot mikkan nimdadin immah. veaf al pi shehen meleim mayim velo chazu lizria, hoil veen amukkim asara. vechen selaim hoil veen gevohim asara al shem hakkarka hen nikrain veenan chashuvim bifne atzman:
Ella noten et kullo keechad. dichtiv (Vayikra 27) vechishshav lo hakkohen et hakkesef, ad sheyyehe chullo kesef keechad:
Vachachamim omrim ze gove shetar chovo. vahalacha kachachamim:
Chaver. hanneeman letohorot veen tzarich lomar lemaasrot:
Sheyyarshu et avihen am haaretz. uferot shehinniach havo demay uvechezkat temeim:
Tol atta ballach. shehuchshar lekabbel tuma vaani bayyavesh shello huchshar lekabbel tuma, lefi sheasur lechaver limkor leam haaretz lach veyavesh keditnan leel beferek sheni:
Min echad merubbe umin echad muat. kegon shelosha maatzadim umegera achat:
Notnim lo shenayim min hamerubbe. vehashshelishi notel haggizbar:

Vechol sheyyesh lo min hammuat. mannichim lo, velo zavninan leh achariti. dechi hechi dead hasheta saggi leh behachi, hasheta nammi tisge leh. demahu detema ad hasheta havu eynashe moshle leh, mishshum dahava leh min echad merubbe leoshole leacharine, hasheta shehaggizbar lakach hamerubbe lo mashkach man demoshil leh, hilkach nezaven leh achariti, kamashma lan:
Hammaasrot labbealim. beha afillu rabbanan diflige ale derabbi eliezer modu, dechevan desade shel bealim mekom maaser shiyyure shayreh:
Hakkartani. leshon kirya, kelomar haish hayyoshev bakkirya bakkefarim. shekken derech bene hakkefarim lekabbel sade mibbene hakkerachim:
Yachol hu hakkartani vechulei. hilkach kol echad notel chelko bemaaser sheni. vechen halacha:
Mishshene mekomot. sheshshene hammochrim hodiuhu shehu tevel:

Ella letzorech. kegon shennitarev lachavero chullin muatin betevel merubbe, sheen letevel ze takkana ad sheyyeasser alav mimmakom acher. vedavka lechaver muttar limkor tevel, aval lo leam haaretz. veam haaretz shennitarev lo chullin betevel ketzad hu ose, holech etzel chaver vehu lokeach lo tevel mimmakom acher umeasser lo:

Shave matayim bemane nitkabbela chetubbatah. deamrinan lah at afsadt. veshave mane bematayim af al gav dehi hirvicha lo matzet lememar ana arvache, shehashsholeach shelucho lashshuk lischora velakach bezol hakkol levaal hammaot. velo shaminan mehacha ella vedavar sheen lo kitzva, kegon karka sheddarko lehimmacher beomed ze befachot veze beyater, aval davar sheyyesh lo kitzva vekana hashshaliach befachot, lo itberira lan dina mehacha. vechazina lerabbevata deifligu vah. umaskana lefum may dechaze lan, shecholkin hashshaliach vehameshalleach:
Michrah batel. sheoto dinar en lah reshut limkor, nimtza shekkol hammecher taut, shehare bevat achat haya:
Leolam michrah kayyam. vehi tachazir et haddinar layyorshin, dema hifsidatan. ad sheyyehe baonaa kede sheillu lo hayta haonaa haya mishtayyer sade bat tisha kabbin, shehu shiur sade:
Uveginna bat chatzi kav. shehu shiur ginna. veen halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:
Machra chetubbatah. mane matayim:
Lo timkor et hashshear. hattosefet, ella vevet din. umatnitin rabbi shimon hi deamar en mocheret shello vevet din ella limzonot, vezo hoil vegavta miktzat ketubbatah en lah mezonot:
Vachachamim omrim mocheret hi. lichtubba, afillu lifrakim. veaf al pi chen mocheret hi bentayim limzonot, shello ibbeda mezonoteha, veaf al pi sheggavta ketzat ketubbatah:
Vechotevet. bishtar hammechira, limzonot macharti:

Ugerusha lo timkor. lichtubba, ella vevet din. detaama may amur rabbanan almana ben min haerusin min hannissuin mocheret shello vevet din, lefi sheen adam rotze shettitbazze ishto bevet din, vezo hoil ugerusha hi lo ichpat leh. vahalacha kachachamim sheishsha mocheret ben lichtubba ben limzonot shello vevet din mumchim, vaafillu hitkabbela miktzat ketubbatah mocheret limzonot ad shettitkabbel kol ketubbatah. ucheshemmocheret, ben lichtubba ben limzonot, tzericha shevua veenah tzericha hacheraza:
Hamekabbel sade. lemechetza lishlish velirvia kederech haarisin:

Cholek lifnehem. veeno tzarich leasser chelek baal hassade, aval manniach lifnehem chelek sechar hakkarka kesheeno meussar, velo chiyyevu chachamim lammekabbel sheyyeasser al chelko shel baal hassade veyitten lo ma sheppasak immo keshehu meussar, mippene yishshuv eretz yisrael, kede shello yimmanu millekabbel hassadot baarisut:
Hachocher. mekabbel hassade bedavar katzuv, kach vechach korin leshana, ben shehi osa harebe ben shehi osa meat:

Torem venoten lo. aval lo measser, dechol chocher al menat ken yored lassade sheyyitten lo chachiruto mipperot haggedelim bassade betivlam, umihu mishshum deen lehashehot hatteruma, dei efshar laggoren shetteaker ella im ken nitrema, mishshum hachi torem venoten lo, umistabber dimnakke lo hatteruma mechachiruto, demay shena teruma mimmaaser:

Amar rabbi yehuda. ematay saggi lachocher sheyyitrom levad veeno measser, keshennoten lo chachiruto meotah sade umeoto hammin. aval im natan lo missade acheret af meoto hammin, o mimmin acher af meotah sade, kegon shezzara miktzat hassade min acher keshiur chachiruto, chayyav af leasser, dedami leforea chovo. i nammi en daat [hammachkir] lekabbel perot tevulim ella keshepporea lo meotah sade umeoto hammin:

Hakkol maalin. et kel bene veto adam kofe laalot immo lirushalayim, vaafillu im kana eved ivri yelech haeved acharav al karcho, vaafillu minnave hayyafe lenave hara, vaafillu meir sherubbah yisrael leir sherubbah ovde chochavim:
Veen hakkol motziin. veen motziin shum adam:
Echad haanashim veechad hannashim. im hu omer laalot vehi omeret shello laalot, tetze belo chetubba. veim hi omeret laalot vehu omer shello laalot, yotzi veyitten ketubba:

Kappotkiyya. hi kaftor. vekorin lah baaravi 445. umeoteha gedolot veshoklot yoter mishshel eretz yisrael. umishshum dichtubbat ishsha middivre sofrim, hekellu vah lifroa otah bappachut shebbammaot. verabban shimon ben gamliel savar ketubba deorayta, umishshum hachi azel bah lechumra. velet hilchata kevateh:
Shene dayyane gezelot. shehayu gozrin gezerot al haggazlanim vekonsim alehem kenasot:
Shene devarim. sheen chachamim modim lo:
Tishshava bassof. kesheyyishmeu vo shemmet vetavo ligbot ketubbatah, tishshava shello ikkeva veyadah mishshel balah kelum:
Velo tishshava battechilla. bishat geviyyat mezonot. verambam peresh, tishshava bassof, kesheyyavo balah veyachchishenna veyomar hinnachti lach mezonot, tishshava shello hinniach lah kelum:

Rabban yochanan ben zakkay omer. vahalacha kemoto. vedavka achar shelosha chodashim litziat habbaal poskin mezonot laishsha im tava mezonot, aval kodem zeman ze lo, shechazaka en adam manniach beto rekan veyotze:
Atzitz nakuv. keli shemmesimin betocho afar vezorim bo, im nakuv kede shoresh katan shehu pachot mikkazzayit hare hu kaaretz uferotav tevel gamur deorayta:
Taram min haaretz. afillu lechattechilla nammi matze litrom, umishshum sefa nakat leshon diavad:

Teruma veyachazor veyitrom. demin happatur al hachiyyuv hifrish velav teruma hi, hilkach yachazor veyitrom, umikkol makom kevan shekkara lah shem teruma notnah lakkohen delo lete lezilzule bitruma. veen tzarich lehotzi aleha teruma umaaser kemo besefa, mishshum demiddeorayta lav tevel hu, aval min hannakuv al sheeno nakuv demin hachiyyuv al happatur hifrish, hatteruma haveya tevel deorayta, hilkach lo yochal ad sheyyotzi aleha teruma umaasrot:

Keshem shecholkin bachullin kach cholkim batteruma. keshennotel baal hassade mechetza ushelish urevia mimma shehotzia hassade notel gam ken mechetza ushelish urevia min hatteruma vehammaasrot hammutalot aleha venotnan hu lechol kohen velevi sheyyirtze:
Af hammaasrot shellahen. im hamekabbel kohen kol hatteruma shello, veim levi hu kol hammaaser shello:
Sheal menat ken. yardu lekabbel sade zo baarisut. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer, deaf al gav deal menat ken yardu bema kanu:
Vehayta alav ketubbat ishsha. kegon shekkadmu gerushin lahekdesh, deachshav lekka kenuneya:

Ella happode fode. baalah pode otan min hahekdesh bezol bedavar muat kede lifroa laishsha chetubbatah, devadday lo chayel alayhu hekdesh shehare enan shello. vehay davar muat, gezera shemma yomru hekdesh yotze lechullin belo pidyon:

Hikdish tishim vehaya chovo mea. af al gav dechovo yoter al hekdesho, lo amrinan hay lav addata dehane nichseh ozfeh ella hemone hemneh hilkach lo gave mehekdesh, ella amrinan addata dehane nichse ozfeh, vegave minnayhu. vead kamma, ad palga. aval im hannechasim shehikdish en shavin chatzi hachov, lo gave minnayhu, devadday lav addata dehane nichse ozfeh, deen adam asuy liknot karka beyoter mippi shenayim mimma shehi shava:
Uvinchasim muatim. sheen bahem parnasa shenem asar chodesh lizcharim velinkevot. verambam peresh, kol sheen bahem lefarnes habbanim vehabbanot ad sheyyibbagru habbanot, karuy nechasim muatim:
Bishvil sheani zachar hifsadti. kelomar, bishvil sheani zachar verauy lirash binchasim merubbim hifsadti binchasim muatim. veen halacha keadmon:

Haomer mishkali alay kulei, im kesef kesef. im peresh kesef noten mishkalo kesef, veim peresh zahav, noten mishkalo zahav. veha kamashma lan deim lo peresh ella amar setam mishkali alay, patar nafsheh bechol dehu, uvilvad sheyyihye davar shekkemoto ragil lihyot nishkal bammakom hahu. vaafillu zefet vaafillu betzalim uregilim anshe hammakom lemachram bemishkal, veamar echad meanshe hammakom hahu mishkali alay setam velo peresh, hare ze noten mishkalo zefet o vetzalim veniftar:

Umaase veimmah shel yirmatya. mefaresh baggemara dematnitin chassore mechasra vehachi katane, veim adam chashuv hu, af al gav delo feresh amdinan leh lefi chevodo, umaase nammi beimmah shel yirmatya, ishsha sheshshemah kach, sheamra mishkal bitti alay vealta lirushalayim, ushekaluha venatna mishkalah zahav, lefi shehayta amuda veosher:
Mishkal yadi alay. heach hu shokel yado, deim rotze machbid veim rotze mekel:

Umachnisah ad marpeko. 116 belaaz. mishshum devindarim hallech achar leshon bene adam, uveoto zeman hayu korin yad lazzeroa ad hammarpek. ucheshemmachnis hayyad letoch chavit melea mayim yishshafchu min hammayim shebbechavit kefi mekom hayyad shehichnis betochah ad hammarpek, vechozer umachnis bechavit basar vegidin vaatzamot shel chamor, shemmishkal besar chamor kemishkal besar adam, vihe beoto vasar gidin vaatzamot kefi ma sheyyesh bayyad, sheen mishkal atzamot vegidin shave lemishkal basar, venoten letochah ad shettachzor vetitmalle chemo shehayta, dehashta ikka nefach keshiur yado, veshokel habbasar vehaatzamot vehaggidim hahem vehu mishkal yado:

Heach efshar lechavven basar keneged basar. shemma yesh bivsar chamor shennoten letoch hechavit yoter gidim vaatzamot mimma sheyyesh bayyad, o pachot, venimtza sheen hammishkal mechuvvan. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
